<dictionary><direction from="lojban" to="La Bangu"><valsi word="﻿a" type="conjunction for nouns"><definition>''and/or''</definition>
<notes>:'''ei mi tavla la alis a la kevin''' — ''I need to speak to Alice or Kevin (or to both of them).''
:Related words: '''ja''', '''a''', '''e''', '''ji''', '''o''', '''u'''
</notes></valsi><valsi word="a'a" type="interjection"><definition>attention, '''a'acu'i''' — inattentiveness, '''a'anai''' — avoiding</definition>
<notes>:'''a'a ko ca'o skicu''' — ''I'm listening, go on talking!''
:'''a'a cu'i ko denpa lo nu mi jai gau mulno ti''' — ''Eh, just a second, let me finish this.''
:'''a'a nai mi na tirna''' — ''La, la, la, I'm not listening.''
:Related words: '''jundi''', '''rivbi'''
</notes></valsi><valsi word="a'e" type="interjection"><definition>alertness, '''a'enai''' — exhaustion</definition>
<notes>:'''a'e ba vlile tcima''' — ''It's going to be a storm.''
:'''a'enai mi ba klama lo ckana''' — ''Yaaaawn, I'm going to bed.''
:Related words: '''sanji''', '''cikna''', '''tatpi'''
</notes></valsi><valsi word="a'ei" type="interjection"><definition>''Come on!'' (call, instigation, invocation)</definition>
<notes>:'''a'ei klama lo zdani''' — ''Let's go home.''
:'''do a'ei co'u denpa''' — ''C'mon, what are you waiting for?''
</notes></valsi><valsi word="a'i" type="interjection"><definition>''Oomph!'' (effort, endeavor), '''a'icu'i''' — no special effort, '''a'inai''' — repose</definition>
<notes>:'''a'i mi ca'o ralte''' — ''I'm trying to hold it!''
:'''a'i cu'i ti frili''' — ''Ah, this is easy.''
:'''a'i nai cikre ta''' — ''Nah, why bother fixing it.''
:Related words: '''gunka''', '''slunandu''', '''guksurla''', '''troci''', '''selprogunka'''
</notes></valsi><valsi word="a'o" type="interjection"><definition>hope, '''a'onai''' — ''Gah!'' (despair)</definition>
<notes>:'''a'o vamji fa lo nu zukte''' — ''I hope, it's worth doing it.''
:'''a'onai mi co'u ponse da''' — ''Gah, I lost all my property.''
:Related words: '''pacna'''
</notes></valsi><valsi word="a'u" type="interjection"><definition>''Hmm... I wonder ...'' (interest), '''a'ucu'i''' — ''Ho-hum'' (disinterest), '''a'unai''' — ''Eww! Yuck!'' (repulsion)</definition>
<notes>:'''a'u ro jbopre cu stati prenu''' — ''Interesting, all Lojbanists are smart people.''
:'''a'u ma krinu''' — ''Hm, what is the reason?''
:'''a'u cu'i do se zdani ka'ai lo nanla''' — ''It's none of my business that you live with a boy.''
:'''a'u nai panci fa lo kalci''' — ''Yuck, that smells like shit!''
:Related words: '''cinri''', '''selcni'''
</notes></valsi><valsi word="abu" type="pronoun"><definition>letter 'A'</definition>
<notes></notes></valsi><valsi word="aftobuso" type="verb"><definition>x<sub>1</sub> entity is a bus, coach</definition><notes>
Comment: to specify passengers, engine, towns and cities etc. used in combination with '''karce''', '''carce''', '''marce''', '''tcadu'''
:'''lo aftobuso''' — bus, coach
:'''ma se stuzi lo tcana pe lo aftobuso pe li mu''' — ''Where is the stop of bus number 5?''
:'''lo aftobuso pe li xo cu klama lo muzga''' — ''What's the number of the bus that goes to the museum?''
:'''lo aftobuso karce be lo litru cu clani''' — ''Tourist's bus is long.''
:Related words: '''sorprekarce''', '''sorpeka''', '''trene''', '''taksi'''</notes></valsi>
<valsi word="ai" type="interjection"><definition>''I'm gonna ...'' (intent), '''aicu'i''' — indecision, '''ainai''' — unintentionally, accidentally</definition>
<notes>:'''ai mi vitke do''' — ''I'm going to visit you.''
:'''a'icu'i mi klama lo zarci''' — ''I'm indecisive to whether I should go to a shop.''
:'''ainai mi pu darxi do''' — ''I didn't mean to hit you.''
:Related words: '''termu'i''', '''terzu'e''', '''seljdi''', '''selcu'a'''
</notes></valsi><valsi word="akti" type="verb"><definition>x<sub>1</sub> entity is running service x<sub>2</sub> property of x1</definition><notes>
:'''lo akti''' — active, in action, working, in operation, '''lo se akti''' — active operation
:'''gau ko ta to'e akti''' — ''Turn that off.''
:'''gau ko ta akti''' — ''Turn it on.''
:'''mi jai gau ba akti fai le minji''' — ''I will get the machine running.''
:'''lo zarci ca akti''' — ''The shop is open.''
:'''le minji ca akti lo ka cupra lo purmo''' — ''The machine is now in operation producing flour.''
:Related words: '''cando''', '''spofu'''</notes></valsi>
<valsi word="alna" type="verb"><definition>x<sub>1</sub> entity is an alder, a tree of genus Alnus of species x<sub>2</sub> taxon</definition><notes>
:'''lo alna''' — alder
:'''lo galtu jimcu be lo alna cu cpana lo do xance''' — ''The high sprigs of alder are on your hand.''
:Related words: '''tricu'''</notes></valsi>
<valsi word="ankabuta" type="verb"><definition>x<sub>1</sub> entity is a spider of species x<sub>2</sub> taxon</definition><notes>
:'''lo ankabuta''' — spider
:'''xu do terpa tu'a lo ankabuta''' — ''Are you afraid of spiders?''
:Related words: '''insekto''', '''cinki''', '''danlu'''</notes></valsi>
<valsi word="arte" type="verb"><definition>x<sub>1</sub> entity is a piece of artwork</definition><notes>
:'''lo arte''' — piece of artwork
:'''lo vi arte pu jai rinka so'i nu darlu''' — ''There've been a lot of debates caused by this artwork.''
:Related words: '''larcu''', '''finti''', '''pixra'''</notes></valsi>
<valsi word="arxokuna" type="verb"><definition>x<sub>1</sub> entity is a raccoon of species x<sub>2</sub> taxon</definition><notes>
:'''lo arxokuna''' — raccoon
:'''pa arxokuna cu zvati lo mi jukpa kumfa''' — ''There's a raccoon in my kitchen.''
:Related words: '''danlu''', '''mabru'''</notes></valsi>
<valsi word="asna" type="verb"><definition>x<sub>1</sub> event is a posture, stance, asana of body x<sub>2</sub> entity</definition><notes>
:'''lo asna''' — posture (of body), body position, stance (of body), asana
:'''ra co'a se asna lo ckape vi lo brafe'a''' — ''He took a dangerous pose near the abyss.''
:Related words: '''morna'''</notes></valsi>
<valsi word="au" type="interjection"><definition>''Wish ...'' (desire), '''aucu'i''' — ''meh'' (indifference), '''aunai''' — ''Nuh-uh!'' (disinclination, reluctance)</definition>
<notes>:'''au e'o tcati''' — ''I'd like some tea, please.''
:'''aucu'i do jai gau bredi fai lo cidja''' — ''You prepare the food or not .''
:'''aunai do cliva''' — ''I don't have any preferences. I don't want you to leave.''
:Related words: '''djica'''
</notes></valsi><valsi word="ba" type="preposition"><definition>''after ...'' (in time). Adverb: ''in future'', expresses future tense</definition>
<notes>:'''mi ba bevri''' — ''I will bring it.''
</notes></valsi><valsi word="ba'a" type="evidential"><definition>''I expect'', '''ba'acu'i''' — ''I experience'', '''ba'anai''' — ''I remember''</definition>
<notes>Comment: '''ba'a''' describes knowledge not yet know, '''ba'acu'i''' — knowledge being acquired at the moment of speaking, '''ba'anai''' describes already acquired knowledge. '''ba'a''' might refer to past events, which you simply don't have information about yet.
:'''ba'a lo mi mamta ca zvati le zdani''' — ''I expect my mother to be at home now.''
:'''ba'a le mi pendo pu jinga''' — ''I expect my friend to have won.''
:'''ba'acu'i lo se klani be lo sovda cu lacri lo tcika lo nu lo jipci cu jai gau cfari''' — ''In my experience, the number of eggs depends on when a hen starts.''
:'''ba'anai do na nelci lo laldo prenu''' — ''As I remember, you don't like old people.''
:Related words: '''bavykri''', '''lifri''', '''morji'''
</notes></valsi><valsi word="ba'e" type="left interjection"><definition>puts an emphasis on the following construct</definition>
<notes>:'''mi djuno lo du'u makau darxi ba'e la alis''' — ''I know who hit Alice (not someone else).''
:'''vajni ba'e mi''' — ''It's important for ME.''
:Related words: '''ba'e''', '''za'e'''
</notes></valsi><valsi word="ba'o" type="preposition"><definition>''in the aftermath'' (retrospective aspect)</definition>
<notes>:'''mi ba'o citka lo plise''' — ''I have eaten an apple.''
:'''mi'o ba'o tavla''' — ''We are done talking.''
:'''mi ba'o xagji''' — ''I'm no longer hungry.''
</notes></valsi><valsi word="ba'u" type="discursive"><definition>exaggeration, '''ba'ucu'i''' — ''to be precise, literally'', '''ba'unai''' — ''to put it mildly'' (understatement)</definition>
<notes>:'''do no ba'u roi jimpe fi mi''' — ''You never understand me.''
:'''le pa tadni pu noba'ucu'i roi jimpe lo ve ciksi be fo mi''' — ''The student literally never understood my explanations.''
:'''le terdi cu barda ba'unai''' — ''The Earth is bug, to put it mildly.''
:Related words: '''satci''', '''dukse'''
</notes></valsi><valsi word="bacru" type="verb"><definition>x<sub>1</sub> entity utters x<sub>2</sub> sound, text</definition><notes>, '''lo se bacru''' — uttered text or sound
:'''ko na cladu bacru''' — ''Don't talk loud.''
:'''ra bacru zo pano''' — ''He said "Ten".''
:Related words: '''krixa''', '''cusku''', '''casnu''', '''tavla''', '''voksa''', '''pinka'''</notes></valsi>
<valsi word="badna" type="verb"><definition>x<sub>1</sub> entity is a banana fruit or plant of species x<sub>2</sub> taxon</definition><notes>
:'''lo badna''' — banana
:'''ma jdima lo badna poi kilto lo grake''' — ''How much is the kilo of bananas?''
:Related words: '''grute'''</notes></valsi>
<valsi word="badri" type="verb"><definition>x<sub>1</sub> entity is sad about x<sub>2</sub> event, property of x1</definition><notes>
:'''lo badri''' — sad, '''lo se badri''' — sad event
:'''mi pu badri lo nu mi pu permite le fetsi lo ka zukte makau''' — ''I was sad of what I had allowed her to do.''
:Related words: '''klaku''', '''gleki''', '''betri''', '''cinmo''', '''junri'''</notes></valsi>
<valsi word="bai" type="preposition from '''bapli'''"><definition>''compelled by force ...''</definition>
<notes>:'''mi pu stali bu'u lo zdani bai lo ka bilma''' — ''I stayed at home forced by my illness.''
</notes></valsi><valsi word="bajra" type="verb"><definition>x<sub>1</sub> entity runs on surface x<sub>2</sub> entity using limbs x<sub>3</sub> entity</definition><notes>
:'''lo bajra''' — runner
:'''mi bajra vi'i lo mitre be li ciki'o''' — ''I ran three thousands meters.''
:'''xu do su'oroi senva lo ka bajra lo jdika grana lo xance be do''' — ''Have you ever dreamt of running on your hands on a narrow rod?''
:Related words: '''cadzu''', '''klama''', '''litru''', '''stapa''', '''plipe''', '''cpare'''</notes></valsi>
<valsi word="bakfu" type="verb"><definition>x<sub>1</sub> entity is a pack or bundle containing x<sub>2</sub> plural of entity held together by x<sub>3</sub> entity</definition><notes>
:'''lo bakfu''' — pack, bundle, '''lo se bakfu''' — content of a pack
:'''ti bakfu lo se dunda lo dasri''' — ''This is a gift packed with a ribbon into a bundle.''
:Related words: '''daski''', '''dakli''', '''tanxe'''</notes></valsi>
<valsi word="bakni" type="verb"><definition>x<sub>1</sub> entity is a cow or bovine of species x<sub>2</sub> taxon</definition><notes>
:'''lo bakni''' — cow
:'''mu bakni cu zvati lo purdi''' — ''There are five cows in the garden.''
:Related words: '''danlu'''</notes></valsi>
<valsi word="bakri" type="verb"><definition>x<sub>1</sub> entity is some chalk</definition><notes>
:'''lo bakri''' — chalk
:'''mi xebni lo bakri''' — ''I hate chalk.''
:'''ki'ubo ri punji lo purmo lo xance''' — ''It leaves powder on hands.''
:Related words: '''pinsi''', '''blabi''', '''jilka'''</notes></valsi>
<valsi word="baktu" type="verb"><definition>x<sub>1</sub> entity is a pail, bucket containing x<sub>2</sub> entity</definition><notes>
:'''lo baktu''' — bucket, pail, '''lo se baktu''' — contents of a bucket
:'''ko bevri lo baktu be lo festi fo lo dinju''' — ''Take the pail of bucket out of the house.''
:Related words: '''botpi''', '''patxu''', '''tansi''', '''lante''', '''lanka'''</notes></valsi>
<valsi word="balji" type="verb"><definition>x<sub>1</sub> entity is a bulb of plant x<sub>2</sub> taxon</definition><notes>
:'''lo balji''' — bulb (of a plant)
:'''ra pu sombo lo balji be lo flora lo purdi''' — ''She planted the flower bulb in the garden.''
:Related words: '''spati'''</notes></valsi>
<valsi word="balnema" type="verb"><definition>x<sub>1</sub> entity is a baleen whale of species x<sub>2</sub> taxon</definition><notes>
:'''lo balnema''' — baleen whale
:'''loi litru ru'i zgana lo melbi nu muvdu fa lo balnema''' — ''The tourists are watching the graceful movement of a baleen whale.''
:Related words: '''orka'''</notes></valsi>
<valsi word="balni" type="verb"><definition>x<sub>1</sub> entity is a balcony or shelf of structure x<sub>2</sub> entity</definition><notes>
:'''lo balni''' — balcony, '''lo se balni''' — building with a balcony
:'''mi cpana lo balni be lo mi zdani''' — ''I am on the balcony of my home.''
:'''i lo jvinu be fi lo balni cu melbi''' — ''The view from the balcony is beautiful.''
:Related words: '''kajna'''</notes></valsi>
<valsi word="balre" type="verb"><definition>x<sub>1</sub> entity is a blade of tool or weapon x<sub>2</sub> entity</definition><notes>
:'''lo balre''' — blade, '''lo se balre''' — a tool or weapon with a blade
:'''lo balre be lo dakfu cu kinli''' — ''The blade of the knife is sharp.''
:Related words: '''dakfu''', '''tunta''', '''tutci''', '''guska''', '''kinli''', '''katna'''</notes></valsi>
<valsi word="balvi" type="verb"><definition>x<sub>1</sub> event is later than or in the future of x<sub>2</sub> event</definition><notes>
:'''lo balvi''' — later event, future event, '''lo se balvi''' — earlier event, past event
:'''lo nu la kevin cu cliva pu purci lo nu mi tsuku le xotli''' — ''Kevin left, and that happened before my arrival to the hotel.''
:Related words: '''lidne''', '''cabna''', '''purci''', '''farna'''</notes></valsi>
<valsi word="bambola" type="verb"><definition>x<sub>1</sub> entity is a doll</definition><notes>
:'''lo bambola''' — doll
:'''lo nixli cu nelci lo va bambola''' — ''The girl likes that doll.''
:Related words: '''kelci'''</notes></valsi>
<valsi word="bambu" type="verb"><definition>x<sub>1</sub> entity is a bamboo of variety x<sub>2</sub> taxon</definition><notes>
:'''lo bambu''' — bamboo
:'''lo bambu cu torni lo brife''' — ''Bamboo bends before the wind.''
:Related words: '''spati''', '''tricu'''</notes></valsi>
<valsi word="bancu" type="verb"><definition>x<sub>1</sub> entity is beyond boundary x<sub>2</sub> same type as x1 from x<sub>3</sub> same type as x1 in x<sub>4</sub> property of x1 and x3 with '''kau'''</definition><notes>
:'''da lalxu gi'e bancu lo tcadu''' — ''There is a lake beyond the city.''
:'''lo tai fasnu cu bancu lo se kakne be mi''' — ''Such things are beyond my powers.''
:'''lo zdani cu bancu lo vu tricu ti lo ka darno ti''' — ''The house is beyond those trees from here in how far it is from here.''
:Related words: '''dukse''', '''ragve''', '''zmadu''', '''kuspe'''</notes></valsi>
<valsi word="bandu" type="verb"><definition>x<sub>1</sub> entity defends x<sub>2</sub> entity from threat x<sub>3</sub> property of x2</definition><notes>
:'''lo brife je lo carvi cu bandu lo dinju lo ka jelca''' — ''Wind and rain protect the house from burning.''
:Related words: '''ckape''', '''fanta''', '''fapro''', '''marbi''', '''rivbi''', '''zunti''', '''snura''', '''binra''', '''lunbe''', '''pulji'''</notes></valsi>
<valsi word="banfi" type="verb"><definition>x<sub>1</sub> entity is an amphibian of species x<sub>2</sub> taxon</definition><notes>
:'''lo banfi''' — amphibian
:'''lo remna cu simlu loka banfi''' — ''Humans look like amphibians.''
:Related words: '''danlu''', '''respa'''</notes></valsi>
<valsi word="bangu" type="verb"><definition>x<sub>1</sub> entity is a language used by x<sub>2</sub> entity to express x<sub>3</sub> proposition</definition><notes>
:'''lo bangu''' — language, '''lo se bangu''' — user of a language
:'''xu do se bangu la lojban''' — ''Do you speak Lojban?''
:Related words: '''tance''', '''cusku''', '''ve''' '''tavla''', '''valsi''', '''gerna''', '''jufra''', '''natmi''', '''slaka'''</notes></valsi>
<valsi word="banli" type="verb"><definition>x<sub>1</sub> entity is great, magnificent in x<sub>2</sub> property of x1</definition><notes>
:'''lo banli''' — something great
:'''lo xamsi cu banli lo ka se jvinu makau lo xotli kumfa''' — ''The sea looks magnificent from the hotel room.''
:Related words: '''barda''', '''nobli''', '''se''' '''sinma''', '''pluja''', '''misno''', '''vajni''', '''fasnu''', '''cizra''', '''traji''', '''mutce''', '''se''' '''manci'''</notes></valsi>
<valsi word="banro" type="verb"><definition>x<sub>1</sub> entity grows to size or into form x<sub>2</sub> entity from x<sub>3</sub> entity</definition><notes>
:'''i le spati ca'o banro lo tricu lo se katna jimca''' — ''The plant is growing into a tree from a cut off branch.''
:Related words: '''farvi''', '''zenba''', '''jmina''', '''barda''', '''makcu''', '''ferti'''</notes></valsi>
<valsi word="banxa" type="verb"><definition>x<sub>1</sub> entity is a bank owned by x<sub>2</sub> entity for banking functions x<sub>3</sub> event</definition><notes>
Comment: x2 can be a banking system
:'''lo banxa''' — bank, '''lo se banxa''' — bank owner, bank system, '''lo te banxa''' — function of bank
:'''ti banxa lo gugde lo ka canja fo lo kagni ije to'u ti banxa fi lo kagni''' — ''This bank owned by stated works with compaines, in short, this is a commercial bank.''
:Related words: '''sorcu''', '''zarci''', '''canja''', '''kagni'''</notes></valsi>
<valsi word="banzu" type="verb"><definition>x<sub>1</sub> event is enough for purpose x<sub>2</sub> event to take place</definition><notes>
Comment: ???sufsi???
:'''lo nu mi se bangu la lojban na banzu lo nu jimpe do''' — ''My level of speaking Lojban isn't enough to understand you.''
:'''lo nu do ca klama cu da'i banzu lo nu do tsuku ca le se tcika''' — ''Leaving now would be enough for you to arrive on time.''
:'''banzu lo se djica be mi''' — ''It's enough for me.''
:Related words: '''dukse''', '''claxu''', '''nitcu''', '''ricfu''', '''permite'''</notes></valsi>
<valsi word="bapli" type="verb"><definition>x<sub>1</sub> event forces, convinces x<sub>2</sub> event to occur</definition><notes>
:'''lo bapli''' — force
:'''lo tcima pu bapli lo nu ra stali lo zdani''' — ''The violent weather forced him to stay at home.''
:'''lo snuti pu bapli lo nu le prenu cu zenba co jundi''' — ''The accident convinced him to be more careful.''
:Related words: '''fanta''', '''rinju''', '''jimte''', '''jitro''', '''rinka''', '''krinu''', '''zukte''', '''randa''', '''danre''', '''bai''', '''marxa''', '''tinsa''', '''xarnu'''</notes></valsi>
<valsi word="barda" type="verb"><definition>x<sub>1</sub> entity is big, large in length/width etc. x<sub>2</sub> property of x1</definition><notes>
:'''lo barda''' — large, big
:'''lo tanxe pu barda lo ka se canlu''' — ''The box occupied large space.''
:'''lo nu penmi pu barda lo ka se ditcu''' — ''The meeting lasted for a large amount of time.''
:Related words: '''banli''', '''clani''', '''ganra''', '''condi''', '''plana''', '''cmalu''', '''rotsu''', '''banro''', '''xanto'''</notes></valsi>
<valsi word="bargu" type="verb"><definition>x<sub>1</sub> entity is an arch over or around x<sub>2</sub> entity</definition><notes>
:'''lo bargu''' — arch
:'''loi tricu cu bargu lo dargu''' — ''The trees form an arch over the road.''
:Related words: '''cripu''', '''kruvi''', '''korcu''', '''condi'''</notes></valsi>
<valsi word="barja" type="verb"><definition>x<sub>1</sub> entity is a bar serving x<sub>2</sub> entity to customers x<sub>3</sub> entity</definition><notes>
:'''lo barja''' — bar
:'''ti barja lo ckafi lo litru''' — ''This is a bar serving coffee to tourists.''
:Related words: '''gusta''', '''birje''', '''jikru''', '''sanmi''', '''vanju''', '''xotli''', '''ckafi''', '''se''' '''pinxe'''</notes></valsi>
<valsi word="barna" type="verb"><definition>x<sub>1</sub> entity is a mark or spot on x<sub>2</sub> entity</definition><notes>
:'''lo barna''' — mark, spot
:'''lo barna be lo kamju cu dergu sinxa''' — ''The mark on the pillar is a road sign.''
:Related words: '''sinxa''', '''pixra''', '''se''' '''ciska''', '''se''' '''prina'''</notes></valsi>
<valsi word="bartu" type="verb"><definition>x<sub>1</sub> entity is outside of x<sub>2</sub> entity</definition><notes>
:'''lo bartu''' — something outside, '''lo se bartu''' — something inside
:'''ei mi klama lo bartu be lo zdani''' — ''I should go out.''
:Related words: '''jibni''', '''nenri''', '''sruri''', '''lamji''', '''korbi''', '''calku''', '''vasru'''</notes></valsi>
<valsi word="basna" type="verb"><definition>x<sub>1</sub> entity emphasizes x<sub>2</sub> entity by action x<sub>3</sub> property of x1</definition><notes>, '''lo se basna''' — emphasis (something emphasized)
:'''mi pu basna lo nu lo nu ca'o gunka cu vajni vau lo ka cladu cusku''' — ''I emphasized the importance of continuing to work by saying it aloud.''
:Related words: '''pandi'''</notes></valsi>
<valsi word="basti" type="verb"><definition>x<sub>1</sub> entity is a replacement for x<sub>2</sub> entity; x1 is instead of x2 </definition><notes>
:'''lo basti''' — replacement (object), '''lo se basti''' — something replaced
:'''ma ba basti do''' — ''Who will replace you?''
:Related words: '''ba'i''', '''binra'''</notes></valsi>
<valsi word="batci" type="verb"><definition>x<sub>1</sub> entity bites or pinches x<sub>2</sub> entity on or at locus x<sub>3</sub> entity</definition><notes>, '''lo se batci''' — bitten
:'''lo gerku pu batci mi lo tuple''' — ''
The dog bit me in the leg''
:Related words: '''denci''', '''jgalu''', '''guska''', '''citka'''</notes></valsi>
<valsi word="batke" type="verb"><definition>x<sub>1</sub> entity is a button or knob on x<sub>2</sub> entity</definition><notes>
:'''lo batke''' — button
:'''ra pu ru'e jgari lo batke be lo kosta pe vo'a''' — ''He was holding a button of his coat.''
:Related words: '''jadni''', '''balji''', '''punji''', '''jgari''', '''lasna'''</notes></valsi>
<valsi word="bau" type="preposition from '''bangu'''"><definition>''in language ...''</definition>
<notes>Comment: x2 of '''bangu''' (user of language) refers to x1 of the clause in which '''bau''' is used. x3 of '''bangu''' (expressed meaning) refers to the clause in which '''bau''' is used.
:'''mi tavla bau la lojban''' — ''I talk in Lojban language.''
</notes></valsi><valsi word="bavmi" type="verb"><definition>x<sub>1</sub> entity is some barley of species x<sub>2</sub> taxon</definition><notes>
:'''lo bavmi''' — barley
:'''lo bavmi cu ralju se cupra bu'u''' — ''Barley is the main product here.''
:Related words: '''gurni'''</notes></valsi>
<valsi word="be"><definition>attaches nouns and prepositions to verb (by default starting from x2)</definition>
<notes>:ends with: '''be'o'''
:'''lo tixnu be mi cu melbi''' — ''My daughter is pretty.''
</notes></valsi><valsi word="be'e" type="vocative"><definition>request to send/speak</definition>
<notes>:'''be'e lo nobli do mulno xu''' — ''Pardon, Sir/Madam, are you finished?''
:'''be'e pendo''' — ''Hello, are you still there, friend?''
</notes></valsi><valsi word="be'i" type="preposition from '''benji'''"><definition>''sent by ...''</definition>
<notes>:'''ti se dunda be'i la kevin''' — ''This a present sent by Kevin.''
</notes></valsi><valsi word="be'o" type="terminator"><notes>:starts with: '''BE'''
</notes></valsi><valsi word="be'u" type="interjection modifier"><definition>lack/need, '''be'ucu'i''' — presence/satisfaction, '''be'unai''' — satiation</definition>
<notes>:'''u'ibe'u ko skicu lo drata lisri''' — ''Hehe, not that funny, tell me another story.''
:'''uibe'ucu'i do bevri re verba mlatu noi mi pu djica''' — ''Yay, you brought the two kittens whom I wanted.''
:'''u'ibe'unai ba'a mi ca farlu lo loldi''' — ''Ha-ha-ha, so funny, I can't laugh anymore, I might fall down to the floor now.''
:Related words: '''claxu''', '''nitcu''', '''mansa'''
</notes></valsi><valsi word="bebna" type="verb"><definition>x<sub>1</sub> entity is foolish in x<sub>2</sub> property of x1</definition><notes>
:'''lo bebna''' — fool, '''lo se bebna''' — foolish action
:'''ko na bebna lo ka ca'o cusku lo mintu''' — ''Don't be silly in repeating the same.''
:Related words: '''fenki''', '''xajmi''', '''prije''', '''fliba'''</notes></valsi>
<valsi word="bei" type="nolfamyma'o"><definition>separates sumti attached to selbri with '''be'''</definition>
<notes>:starts with: '''BE'''
:ends with: '''be'o'''
</notes></valsi><valsi word="bekpi" type="verb"><definition>x<sub>1</sub> entity is the back, dorsum, 'posterior' body-part of x<sub>2</sub> entity</definition><notes>

<valsi word="bu"><definition>noun or verb > letter pronoun</definition>
<notes>Comment: converts one word into a letter pronoun. From verbs: lujvo formed with '''zei''' are fine: '''xy''' '''zei''' '''kantu''' '''bu'''. From nouns: '''vy.''' '''bu''' (it denotes the letter "w" and thus isn't the same as '''vy.'''), '''zo a bu''', '''zoi ly.klama.ly. bu''', '''lo'u klam le'u bu'''. The following sequences are not grammatical: '''bu bu''', '''si bu''', '''sa bu''', '''su bu''', '''zei bu''', '''fa'o bu''', '''zo bu''', '''zoi bu''', '''lo'u bu'''.
:'''mi pilno vy bu vy bu vy bu''' — ''I use WWW.''
:'''la alis pu klama lo zarci ije ku'i mi na djuno lo du'u lo du'u abu pu te vecnu makau''' — ''Alice went to a store, but I don't know what A (Alice) bought there.''
</notes></valsi><valsi word="bu'a" type="verb"><definition>there exists some relation: 1st verb of '''bu'a''', '''bu'e''', '''bu'i''' series</definition>
<notes>:'''fau lo nu do djica lonu bu'a cu bu'a gau ko''' — ''If there is something you want to happen, make it happen.''
</notes></valsi><valsi word="bu'e" type="verb"><definition>there exists some relation: 2nd verb of '''bu'a''', '''bu'e''', '''bu'i''' series</definition>
<notes>:'''pa bu'a pa bu'e pa bu'i zo'u lo nu bu'a ka'e se jalge lo nu bu'e ca lo nu bu'i''' — ''There is an event X, an event Y and event Z such that X can lead to Y during Z.''
</notes></valsi><valsi word="bu'i" type="verb"><definition>there exists some relation: 3rd verb of '''bu'a''', '''bu'e''', '''bu'i''' series</definition>
<notes>:'''pa bu'a pa bu'e pa bu'i zo'u lo nu bu'a ka'e se jalge lo nu bu'e ca lo nu bu'i''' — ''There is an event X, an event Y and event Z such that X can lead to Y during Z.''
</notes></valsi><valsi word="bu'o" type="interjection contour"><definition>start emotion, '''bu'ocu'i''' — continue emotion, '''bu'onai''' — end emotion</definition>
<notes>:'''za'o ku do tsuku ui bu'o''' — ''At last you arrived, and I'm happy now!''
:'''uanaibu'ocu'i la alis cu simsa fi lo ka na zvati''' — ''What's going on, Alice is also not present.''
:'''u'i bu'o nai mi di'a gunka''' — ''Enough laughing, I'm back to work.''
</notes></valsi><valsi word="bu'u" type="preposition"><definition>''at'' (the same place as ...)</definition>
<notes>:'''mi xabju ze'a lo nanca be li ci lo bu'u dinju''' — ''I've been living for three years in this house.''
:'''le verba ca sipna bu'u le kumfa''' — ''The child is now sleeping in the room.''
</notes></valsi><valsi word="budjo" type="verb"><definition>x<sub>1</sub> entity is Buddhist in x<sub>2</sub> property of x1</definition><notes>
:'''lo budjo''' — Buddhist
:'''xu do budjo''' — ''Are you a Buddhist?''
:Related words: '''latna''', '''lijda'''</notes></valsi>
<valsi word="bukpu" type="verb"><definition>x<sub>1</sub> entity is some cloth</definition><notes>
:'''lo bukpu''' — cloth
:'''lo bukpu cu cpana lo jubme''' — ''The cloth is on the table.''
:Related words: '''mapni''', '''matli''', '''sunla''', '''slasi''', '''silka'''</notes></valsi>
<valsi word="bumru" type="verb"><definition>x<sub>1</sub> entity is covered by a fog or mist of liquid x<sub>2</sub> entity</definition><notes>
:'''lo bumru''' — foggy, '''lo se bumru''' — fog, mist
:'''lo xamsi cu bumru lo lenku dirgo''' — ''The sea is covered by a fog of cold drops.''
:Related words: '''djacu''', '''carvi''', '''danmo''', '''lunsa''', '''tcima''', '''gapci'''</notes></valsi>
<valsi word="bunda" type="verb"><definition>x<sub>1</sub> entity is x<sub>2</sub> number weight units in standard x<sub>3</sub> property of x1</definition><notes>
:'''lo vi tanxe cu bunda li pano lo ka ki'ogra''' — ''This box is 10 kilograms in weight.''
:Related words: '''grake''', '''junta''', '''tilju''', '''rupnu''', '''fepni''', '''dekpu''', '''gutci''', '''minli''', '''merli''', '''kramu'''</notes></valsi>
<valsi word="bunre" type="verb"><definition>x<sub>1</sub> entity is brown</definition><notes>
:'''lo bunre''' — brown
:'''lo bunre gerku cu tolcri lo blabi ractu''' — ''The brown dog found a white rabbit.''
:Related words: '''skari''', '''blabi''', '''xekri''', '''kandi''', '''carmi'''</notes></valsi>
<valsi word="burcu" type="verb"><definition>x<sub>1</sub> entity is a brush for doing x<sub>2</sub> event with bristles x<sub>3</sub> entity</definition><notes>
:'''lo burcu''' — brush, '''lo se burcu''' — purpose for a brush, '''lo te burcu''' — bristle of a brush
:'''ti burcu lo nu punji lo cinta vau lo cmalu''' — ''This is a brush for painting with small bristles.''
:Related words: '''komcu''', '''pinsi'''</notes></valsi>
<valsi word="burna" type="verb"><definition>x<sub>1</sub> entity is flustered, disconcerted by x<sub>2</sub> event</definition><notes>
:'''lo burna''' — flustered, '''lo se burna''' — befuddling event
:'''xu do burna lo ka pilno la lojban''' — ''Are you disconcerted of using Lojban?''
:Related words: '''cinmo'''</notes></valsi>
<valsi word="by" type="pronoun"><definition>letter 'B'</definition>
<notes></notes></valsi><valsi word="ca" type="preposition"><definition>''during ...'', ''simultaneousely with ...'' (in time). Adverb: ''meanwhile'', ''now'', ''currently'', expresses present tense</definition>
<notes>:'''loi rirni pu zvati lo barja''' — ''The parents were in the bar, meanwhile the children were alone at home.''
:'''cabo loi verba cu nonseka bu'u lo zdani''' — ''Be quite while I'm talking.''
:'''ko smaji ca lo nu mi tavla i ca lo nu cinmo lo ka nonseka vau do ko'oi morji lo se gleki be mi'o mokca''' — ''When you feel lonely, remember the happy moments we had together.''
</notes></valsi><valsi word="ca'a" type="preposition"><definition>''actually is or does...''</definition>
<notes>Comment: describes demonstrated activity.
:'''mi ca'a limna''' — ''I'm actually swimming.''
:'''la kevin ca ca'a jatna''' — ''Kevin is now acting as a captain.''
</notes></valsi><valsi word="ca'e" type="evidential"><definition>''I define''</definition>
<notes>:'''ca'e do zutse va''' — ''You sit there!''
:'''ca'e do klama ka'ai mi''' — ''You go with me!''
:'''ca'e lo se gunka cu mulno''' — ''The work is hereby done.''
:'''ca'e gusni''' — ''Let there be light!''
:Related words: '''mitcu'a''', '''mitsmu'''
</notes></valsi><valsi word="ca'o" type="preposition"><definition>progress of the event. ''be doing ...'' or ''being ...'' (progressive aspect)</definition>
<notes>Comment: unlike '''ru'i''' describes an event as progressing whether or not it is continuous..
:'''le verba ca'o citka''' — ''The child is eating.''
</notes></valsi><valsi word="ca'u" type="preposition"><definition>''to the front of ...'', ''between me and ...''</definition>
<notes>:'''lo snime cu mitre li pa ca'u lo do vorme''' — ''There is snow one meter thick in front of your door.''
</notes></valsi><valsi word="cabna" type="verb"><definition>x<sub>1</sub> event is current with x<sub>2</sub> event in time</definition><notes>
:'''lo cabna''' — present, current
:'''lo xamgu fasnu cu cabna lo xlali fasnu''' — ''Good and bad events happen at the same time.''
:Related words: '''zvati''', '''balvi''', '''purci''', '''ca''', '''ca'a'''</notes></valsi>
<valsi word="cabra" type="verb"><definition>x<sub>1</sub> entity is apparatus for function x<sub>2</sub> event controlled by agent x<sub>3</sub> entity</definition><notes>
Comment: '''cabra''' is for devices controlled by external force, '''minji''' is for machines working automatically, '''zmiku''' is for robots in general
:'''lo cabra''' — apparatus, '''lo se cabra''' — function of an apparatus
:'''ti cabra lo ka zalvi lo gurni vau lo xance''' — ''This is a hand-controlled machine for grinding grain.''
:Related words: '''tutci''', '''minji''', '''finti''', '''girzu''', '''ganzu''', '''pilno'''</notes></valsi>
<valsi word="cacra" type="verb"><definition>x<sub>1</sub> event is x<sub>2</sub> number hours in duration</definition><notes>
:'''lo cacra''' — hour, '''lo se cacra''' — number of hours
:'''caku lo nicte cu cacra li mu''' — ''At this time night is 5 hours long.''
:Related words: '''junla''', '''mentu''', '''snidu''', '''tcika''', '''temci'''</notes></valsi>
<valsi word="cadzu" type="verb"><definition>x<sub>1</sub> entity walks on surface x<sub>2</sub> entity with limbs x<sub>3</sub></definition><notes>
:'''lo cadzu''' — walker
:'''mi pu ru'i cadzu lo srasu lo jamfu ca lo nu do tsuku''' — ''I was walking on the grass on foot when you arrived.''
:Related words: '''stapa''', '''bajra''', '''klama''', '''litru'''</notes></valsi>
<valsi word="cafne" type="verb"><definition>x<sub>1</sub> event occurs frequently</definition><notes>
:'''lo cafne''' — frequent event
:'''banzu cafne fa lo nu mi vitke lo patfu be mi''' — ''It's quite often that I visit my father.''
:Related words: '''rirci''', '''fadni''', '''kampu''', '''rapli''', '''krefu''', '''lakne''', '''so'i''''''roi'''</notes></valsi>
<valsi word="cagna" type="verb"><definition>x<sub>1</sub> entity is a wound on body x<sub>2</sub> entity at locus x<sub>3</sub> entity caused by x<sub>4</sub> event</definition><notes>
:'''lo cagna''' — wound
:'''ti cagna lo moklu be ra lo pu se zvati be lo denci lo nu lo mikce mo'u vimcu dy''' — ''This is a wound in his mouth at the place where there was a tooth removed by a doctor.''
:Related words: '''xrani''', '''bilma'''</notes></valsi>
<valsi word="cai" type="interjection modifier"><definition>critical, extreme intensity interjection. Can be used either on its own or as a modifier of interjection</definition>
<notes>:'''oi cai''' — ''Ah, pain, I'm gonna lose consciousness now!!!''
</notes></valsi><valsi word="cakla" type="verb"><definition>x<sub>1</sub> entity is some chocolate or cocoa</definition><notes>
:'''lo cakla''' — chocolate
:'''mi nelci lo blabi cakla semau lo manku cakla''' — ''I prefer white chocolate to dark chocolate.''
:Related words: '''ckafi'''</notes></valsi>
<valsi word="calku" type="verb"><definition>x<sub>1</sub> entity is a shell or husk around x<sub>2</sub> entity</definition><notes>
:'''lo calku''' — shell
:'''mi nitcu lo calku be lo stedu''' — ''I need a head helmet.''
:Related words: '''pilka''', '''skapi''', '''gacri''', '''bartu'''</notes></valsi>
<valsi word="canci" type="verb"><definition>x<sub>1</sub> entity vanishes from location x<sub>2</sub> entity</definition><notes>
:'''do canci lo jvinu be fi mi''' — ''You disappeared from my view.''
:Related words: '''cliva''', '''ganse''', '''zgana''', '''lebna''', '''vimcu'''</notes></valsi>
<valsi word="cando" type="verb"><definition>x<sub>1</sub> entity is idle or at rest</definition><notes>
:'''lo cando''' — idle, at rest
:'''do simlu lo ka cando''' — ''You seem to be idle.''
:Related words: '''surla'''</notes></valsi>
<valsi word="cange" type="verb"><definition>x<sub>1</sub> entity is a farm or ranch at x<sub>2</sub> entity farmed by x<sub>3</sub> entity that raises or produces x<sub>4</sub> entity</definition><notes>
:'''lo cange''' — farm, '''lo te cange''' — farmer, '''lo ve cange''' — farm production
:'''ti cange lo barda tumla lo mensi be mi lo vanjba''' — ''This is a farm covering a large parcel of land, it's kept by my sister and produces grapes.''
:Related words: '''purdi''', '''nurma''', '''ferti''', '''foldi''', '''xarju'''</notes></valsi>
<valsi word="canja" type="verb"><definition>x<sub>1</sub> entity trades commodity x<sub>2</sub> entity, property of x1 for x<sub>3</sub> entity, property of x4 with x<sub>4</sub> entity</definition><notes>
Comment: '''jdima''' is for cost/price/value distinction.
:'''lo canja''' — trader, '''lo se canja''' — commodity
:'''e'u mi canja lo bidju lo ka jarco lo tatru be do mi vau do''' — ''Let me give you these beads in exchange that you show me your breast.''
:Related words: '''dunda''', '''friti''', '''vecnu''', '''zarci''', '''jdini''', '''pleji''', '''jdima''', '''jerna''', '''kargu''', '''banxa''', '''cirko''', '''dunda''', '''janta''', '''kargu''', '''prali''', '''sfasa''', '''zivle''')</notes></valsi>
<valsi word="canko" type="verb"><definition>x<sub>1</sub> entity is a window or portal in wall or building x<sub>2</sub> entity</definition><notes>
:'''lo canko''' — window, '''lo se canko''' — building with a window
:'''lo canko be lo karce cu kalri''' — ''The window in the car is open.''
:Related words: '''vorme''', '''bitmu''', '''ganlo''', '''murta''', '''pagre''', '''kevna''', '''jvinu''', '''kalri''', '''kuspe'''</notes></valsi>
<valsi word="canlu" type="verb"><definition>x<sub>1</sub> entity is a space or room occupied by x<sub>2</sub> entity</definition><notes>
:'''lo canlu''' — space
:'''lo canlu be lo purdi cu barda''' — ''The garden occupies a large space.''
:Related words: '''kensa''', '''bliku''', '''kumfa''', '''kevna''', '''kunti''', '''tubnu''', '''dekpu'''</notes></valsi>
<valsi word="canpa" type="verb"><definition>x<sub>1</sub> entity is a shovel or spade for doing x<sub>2</sub> event</definition><notes>
:'''lo canpa''' — shovel
:'''ti canpa lo nu kakpa lo dertu vau ji lo nu katna lo genja''' — ''Is this spade for digging ground or for cutting roots?''
:Related words: '''kakpa''', '''guska''', '''tutci'''</notes></valsi>
<valsi word="canre" type="verb"><definition>x<sub>1</sub> entity is some sand or grit entity</definition><notes>
:'''lo canre''' — sand
:'''mi pu tolcri lo jamfu prina be lo canre''' — ''I found some footprints in the sand.''
:'''mi pu se nandu lo ka cadzu lo canre poi gunma lo cmalu rokci''' — ''It was hard for me to walk on the sand made of small stones.''
:Related words: '''bidju''', '''rokci''', '''zalvi''', '''boxna'''</notes></valsi>
<valsi word="canti" type="verb"><definition>x<sub>1</sub> entity is the intestines or guts of x<sub>2</sub> entity</definition><notes>
:'''lo canti''' — intestine
:'''lo jurme co'a xabju lo canti be lo cifnu bazi lo nu ri jbena''' — ''Bacteria colonize the intestines of a child soon after it is born.''
:Related words: '''betfu'''</notes></valsi>
<valsi word="carce" type="verb"><definition>x<sub>1</sub> entity is a carriage or wagon for carrying x<sub>2</sub> entity</definition><notes>
:'''lo carce''' — carriage, '''lo se carce''' — cargo of a carriage
:'''mi sazri lo carce be lo karce''' — ''I am driving a car transporter.''
:Related words: '''karce''', '''xislu''', '''marce''', '''matra'''</notes></valsi>
<valsi word="carmi" type="verb"><definition>x<sub>1</sub> entity is bright or intense in x<sub>2</sub> property of x1</definition><notes>
:'''lo carmi''' — bright, intense
:'''ei do carmi lo ka tadni''' — ''You should study hard.''
:'''lo vi bombila cu carmi lo ka te gusni''' — ''This light bulb gives a bright light.''
:Related words: '''denmi''', '''gusni''', '''kandi''', '''ruble''', '''skari''', '''tilju''', '''tsali''', '''mutce''', '''blabi''', '''blanu''', '''bunre''', '''cicna''', '''crino''', '''grusi''', '''narju''', '''nukni''', '''pelxu''', '''xekri''', '''xunre''', '''zirpu'''</notes></valsi>
<valsi word="carna" type="verb"><definition>x<sub>1</sub> entity turns or rotates around axis x<sub>2</sub> entity in direction x<sub>3</sub> entity</definition><notes>
Comment: in x3 use '''lo pritu''' for clockwise movement and '''zunle''' for counterclockwise movement
:'''lo carna''' — rotating, '''lo se carna''' — axis of rotation, '''lo te carna''' — direction of rotation
:'''ko carna fe'emo'u lo pritu''' — ''Turn right.''
:'''ko pritu carna''' — ''Turn right.''
:'''lo xislu pu carna lo grana lo zunle ma'i lo galtu''' — ''The wheel was rotating around the rod counterclockwise when viewed from above.''
:Related words: '''gunro''', '''jendu'''</notes></valsi>
<valsi word="cartu" type="verb"><definition>x<sub>1</sub> entity is a chart or diagram of x<sub>2</sub> entity showing information x<sub>3</sub> proposition</definition><notes>
:'''lo cartu''' — chart, '''lo se cartu''' — picture on a chart
:'''ti cartu lo fange tcadu lo dargu''' — ''This is a map showing roads of an alien city.''
:'''ko jarco fi mi fe lo cartu be lo punai se zvati be mi'o''' — ''Show me a map of a place where you and I haven't been.''
:Related words: '''platu'''</notes></valsi>
<valsi word="carvi" type="verb"><definition>x<sub>1</sub> entity rains or showers to x<sub>2</sub> entity from x<sub>3</sub> entity</definition><notes>
:'''lo carvi''' — rain, '''lo te carvi''' — rain cloud
:'''ca ca'o carvi''' — ''It's raining.''
:'''lo snime pu carmi carvi lo lalxu lo barda dilnu''' — ''I was snowing hard onto the lake from a large cloud.''
:Related words: '''bratu''', '''dilnu''', '''santa''', '''snime''', '''tcima''', '''bisli''', '''bumru'''</notes></valsi>
<valsi word="casnu" type="verb"><definition>x<sub>1</sub> plural of entity discusses or talks about x<sub>2</sub> entity</definition><notes>
:'''lo casnu''' — debater, '''lo se casnu''' — topic of a discussion
:'''ra jo'u mi pu casnu lo arte''' — ''She and I discussed a piece of art.''
:Related words: '''bacru''', '''cusku''', '''darlu''', '''tavla'''</notes></valsi>
<valsi word="catke" type="verb"><definition>x<sub>1</sub> entity shoves or pushes x<sub>2</sub> entity at locus x<sub>3</sub> entity</definition><notes>
Comment: '''danre''' for non-agentive force, '''lacpu'''
:'''ko catke la'e me'o so pa pa''' — ''Dial 911!''
:'''le nixli pu catke le nanla lo stedu be ri''' — ''The girl pushed the boy on his head.''
:Related words: '''darxi''', '''lacpu'''</notes></valsi>
<valsi word="catlu" type="verb"><definition>x<sub>1</sub> entity looks at x<sub>2</sub> event</definition><notes>
:'''ko catlu mi''' — ''Look at me.''
:Related words: '''jvinu''', '''minra''', '''simlu''', '''viska''', '''lanli''', '''zgana''', '''setca''', '''viska'''</notes></valsi>
<valsi word="catni" type="verb"><definition>x<sub>1</sub> entity has authority over matter x<sub>2</sub> property of x1 on the basis of x<sub>3</sub> property of x2</definition><notes>
:'''lo catni''' — someone with authority
:'''mi co'a catni lo ka te cange ti vau lo ka te permite mi lo patfu be mi''' — ''The authority to be a farmer on this land has been given to me by my father.''
:Related words: '''turni''', '''tutra''', '''krati''', '''ca'i''', '''jaspu''', '''pulji'''</notes></valsi>
<valsi word="catra" type="verb"><definition>x<sub>1</sub> entity kills x<sub>2</sub> entity</definition><notes>
:'''lo catra''' — killer, '''lo se catra''' — killed
:'''le nakni cu kakne lo ka catra re cipni sepi'o pa rokci''' — ''He can kill two birds with one stone.''
:Related words: '''morsi''', '''xarci'''</notes></valsi>
<valsi word="cau" type="preposition from '''claxu'''"><definition>''lacked by ...''</definition>
<notes></notes></valsi><valsi word="caxno" type="verb"><definition>x<sub>1</sub> entity is shallow in direction x<sub>2</sub> entity away from reference point x<sub>3</sub> entity</definition><notes>
:'''lo caxno''' — shallow
:'''lo vi lalxu cu caxno lo ka tsuku lo loldi be ce'u vau lo sefta''' — ''This lake is shallow in reaching the bottom from the surface.''
:Related words: '''condi''', '''tordu''', '''jarki''', '''cinla''', '''cmalu''', '''jarki''', '''jmifa'''</notes></valsi>
<valsi word="ce" type="conjunction"><definition>''along with...'', ''and also ...''</definition>
<notes>Comment: links nouns to create noun of plural type.
:'''You and I discussed languages together''' — ''do ce mi casnu lo za'u bangu.''
:Related words: '''je''', '''e'''
</notes></valsi><valsi word="ce'i" type="digit/number"><definition> '%' (percentage symbol), hundredths</definition>
<notes>:'''ji'i munoce'i lo remna cu ninmu''' — ''Approximately 50% of humans are women.''
</notes></valsi><valsi word="ce'o" type="conjunction"><definition>''and then ...'' (forms ordered sequence)</definition>
<notes>Comment: links nouns to create sumti of ordered plural type.
:'''li pa ce'o li re ce'o li ci cu porsi''' — ''1,2,3 is a sequence.''
:Related words: '''ce''', '''je''', '''e'''
</notes></valsi><valsi word="ce'u" type="pronoun"><definition>inside an abstraction of a verb '''ce'u''' refers to another place of that verb</definition>
<notes>Comment: definitions of verbs show which place '''ce'u''' refers to. If not explicitly stated then '''ce'u''' refers to the first place of the verb. To refer to the head of a relative clause use '''ke'a'''.
:'''mi nitcu lo ka da tavla ce'u''' — ''I need someone to talk to me.''
</notes></valsi><valsi word="cecla" type="verb"><definition>x<sub>1</sub> entity launches projectile or missile x<sub>2</sub> entity; x1 is a gun</definition><notes>
Comment: ??? x2 is danti, x3 is propulsion
:'''lo cecla''' — gun, '''lo se cecla''' — missile
:'''ti cecla lo fagri''' — ''This is a fire gun.''
:Related words: '''renro''', '''danti''', '''jakne''', '''jbama''', '''spoja'''</notes></valsi>
<valsi word="cecmu" type="verb"><definition>x<sub>1</sub> entity is a community or colony of organisms x<sub>2</sub> plural of entity</definition><notes>
:'''lo cecmu''' — community, '''lo se cecmu''' — member of a community
:'''lo cecmu be lo cipni mo'u muvdu lo vi tcadu''' — ''The colony of birds moved to this city.''
:Related words: '''bende''', '''kulnu''', '''natmi''', '''tcadu''', '''jecta''', '''girzu'''</notes></valsi>
<valsi word="cedra" type="verb"><definition>x<sub>1</sub> entity is an era or age characterized by x<sub>2</sub> property of x1</definition><notes>
:'''lo cedra''' — era
:'''lo cabna cu cedra lo nu pilno lo skami''' — ''These days are the era of using computers.''
:Related words: '''ranji''', '''temci''', '''citsi'''</notes></valsi>
<valsi word="cei"><definition>''that will from now on be called ...'' (main verb follows)</definition>
<notes>Comment: '''cei''' copies the whole main verb with all its places that can later be filled with another nouns.
:'''mi ba klama cei broda lo zarci''' — ''I will go to the store.''
:'''au do broda''' — ''I'd like you fo there too.''
</notes></valsi><valsi word="cenba" type="verb"><definition>x<sub>1</sub> entity varies in x<sub>2</sub> property of x1 in amount x<sub>3</sub> entity</definition><notes>
Comment: '''binxo''' describes that entity turns into another entity, '''galfi''' describes how to change one entity into another one. '''cenba''' describes how entity changes its state while remaining the same entity, '''stika''' describes how to make entity change its state
:'''lo cenba''' — variable
:'''do cenba lo ni makau se cpedu vau lo barda''' — ''Your demands vary to much degree.''
:Related words: '''cenba''', '''galfi''', '''stika''', '''stodi''', '''zasni''', '''binxo'''</notes></valsi>
<valsi word="censa" type="verb"><definition>x<sub>1</sub> entity is holy or sacred to x<sub>2</sub> entity</definition><notes>
:'''lo censa''' — holy
:'''lo bu'u tcadu cu censa ro lo prenu pe vi''' — ''This city is holy to all people here.''
:Related words: '''cevni''', '''krici''', '''latna''', '''pruxi''', '''lijda''', '''sinma'''</notes></valsi>
<valsi word="centero" type="verb"><definition>x<sub>1</sub> is in the center of x<sub>2</sub></definition><notes>
Comment: central subset (of a set or territory). Use midju for center point, kernelo for nucleus
:'''lo centero''' — center
:'''lo vi tcadu cu centero lo gugde''' — ''This city is in the center of the country.''
:Related words: '''midju''', '''kernelo''', '''xadba'''</notes></valsi>
<valsi word="centi" type="verb"><definition>x<sub>1</sub> entity is a hundredth of x<sub>2</sub> same type as x1 in x<sub>3</sub> property of x1</definition><notes>
:'''lo centi''' — hundred

:'''lo ckape''' — dangerous, '''lo se ckape''' — threatened
:'''ka'e ckape lo nu do kanro vau fa lo nu do zukte lo se stidi be la kevin''' — ''It can be dangerous for your health to do what Kevin suggested.''
:'''do jai se ckape fai lo ka co'a bilma''' — ''You are at risk of getting ill.''
:Related words: '''te''' '''bandu''', '''te''' '''kajde''', '''te''' '''marbi''', '''se''' '''snura''', '''se''' '''xalni'''</notes></valsi>
<valsi word="ckasu" type="verb"><definition>x<sub>1</sub> entity mocks at x<sub>2</sub> entity about x<sub>3</sub> property of x2 by doing x<sub>4</sub> property of x1</definition><notes>
:'''lo pendo pu ckasu mi lo ka cadzu tai makau vau lo ka cusku lo mabla''' — ''A friend mocked at the manner I walk by saing bad words.''
:Related words: '''cmila'''</notes></valsi>
<valsi word="ckeji" type="verb"><definition>x<sub>1</sub> entity feels ashamed, mortified about x<sub>2</sub> event before audience x<sub>3</sub> entity</definition><notes>
:'''lo ckeji''' — ashamed, '''lo se ckeji''' — shameful event
:'''lo mi mamta pu ckeji lo nu mi tarti makau vau loi prenu''' — ''My mother was ashamed of my conduct in front of the crowd.''
:Related words: '''cinmo'''</notes></valsi>
<valsi word="ckiku" type="verb"><definition>x<sub>1</sub> entity is a key fitting lock x<sub>2</sub> entity</definition><notes>
Comment: x2 can describe doors in the sense of entities that lock access
:'''lo ckiku''' — key (of a lock), '''lo se ckiku''' — lock (of a key)
:'''i ti ckiku lo xunre vorme i ma ckiku lo do jaspu''' — ''What is the password to your account?''
:Related words: '''stela'''</notes></valsi>
<valsi word="ckilu" type="verb"><definition>x<sub>1</sub> property of nonce place with '''kau''' is a scale of units for measuring x<sub>2</sub> property of nonce place with '''kau'''</definition><notes>
:'''lo ckilu''' — scale
:'''lo ka mitre makau cu ckilu lo ka te sepli makau makau''' — ''Metric scale measures the distance between two points.''
:Related words: '''ci'u''', '''gradu''', '''merli''', '''cimde''', '''manri'''</notes></valsi>
<valsi word="ckini" type="verb"><definition>x<sub>1</sub> entity is related to x<sub>2</sub> entity by relationship x<sub>3</sub> relation between x1 and x2, contains two places for '''ce'u'''</definition><notes>
:'''lo ckini''' — related, '''lo te ckini''' — relationship
:'''mi na jimpe lo te ckini be lo panci bei lo se vecnu be fi do''' — ''I don't understand the relation between the smell and your purchase.''
:'''ti'e lo sance cu ckini lo barda mabru lo ka ce'u cupra ce'u fau lo nu ri pagre ti''' — ''They say the sound is related to a large mammal that produces it while passing here.''
:'''lo nu da'i mi pu zvati la nipon cu ckini fi no da''' — ''The fact that I was in Japan is totally irrelevant.''
:Related words: '''ki'i''', '''ponse''', '''srana''', '''steci''', '''mapti''', '''sarxe''', '''fange'''</notes></valsi>
<valsi word="ckire" type="verb"><definition>x<sub>1</sub> entity is grateful or thankful to x<sub>2</sub> entity for x<sub>3</sub> property of x2</definition><notes>
:'''lo ckire''' — thankful, '''lo te ckire''' — reason for gratitude
:'''mi ckire do lo ka sidju mi''' — ''Thank you for helping me.''
:'''ckire fi lo balvi''' — ''Thanks in advance.''
:Related words: '''cinmo''', '''friti''', '''pluka'''</notes></valsi>
<valsi word="ckule" type="verb"><definition>x<sub>1</sub> entity is a school serving at area x<sub>2</sub> entity , teaching x<sub>3</sub> proposition to x<sub>4</sub> entity</definition><notes>
:'''lo ckule''' — school, '''lo te ckule''' — subject taught in a school, '''lo ve ckule''' — pupil of a school
:'''ti ckule lo bu'u gugde lo ve mikce lo citno tadni''' — ''This is a medical school serving in this area teaching therapy methods to young students.''
:'''mi ve ckule fi lo ralju''' — ''I'm in primary school.''
:Related words: '''cilre''', '''ctuca''', '''tadni'''</notes></valsi>
<valsi word="ckunu" type="verb"><definition>x<sub>1</sub> entity is a conifer of species x<sub>2</sub> taxon</definition><notes>
:'''lo ckunu''' — conifer
:'''xu lo tsiju be lo vi ckunu cu kukte''' — ''Are pine nuts of this conifer tasty?''
:Related words: '''tricu'''</notes></valsi>
<valsi word="cladu" type="verb"><definition>x<sub>1</sub> entity is loud at observation point x<sub>2</sub> entity</definition><notes>
:'''lo cladu''' — loud (producing loud sound), '''lo se cladu''' — loud place
:'''lo zgike cu cladu fe ji'a lo bu'u kumfa''' — ''The music is loud even when you are in this room.''
:Related words: '''savru'''</notes></valsi>
<valsi word="clani" type="verb"><definition>x<sub>1</sub> entity is long in length/width etc. x<sub>2</sub> property of x1</definition><notes>
Comment: The first largest dimension. '''ganra''', '''rotsu''' and '''clani''' specify the three dimensions of objects. '''clani''' can be used to describe 'tall' or 'high' (in the sense of vertical length). For lengthy time intervals '''barda''' is also used (choice depends on personal philosophy of the speaker).
:'''lo clani''' — long
:'''i la kevin cu clani lo ka sraji''' — ''Kevin is tall.''
:'''lo cmana cu clani''' — ''The mountain is high.''
:'''lo nu penmi pu clani lo ka se ditcu''' — ''The meeting was long.''
:Related words: '''slabu''', '''condi''', '''ganra''', '''rotsu''', '''tordu''', '''barda''', '''ganra''', '''gutci''', '''minli''', '''rotsu'''</notes></valsi>
<valsi word="claxu" type="verb"><definition>x<sub>1</sub> entity lacks x<sub>2</sub> entity, property of x1</definition><notes>
:'''lo claxu''' — deficient
:'''mi claxu lo ka djica lo ka citka''' — ''I lack the desire to eat.''
:'''si'au do claxu lo ka cinmo''' — ''Looks like you lack any emotions.''
:'''mi claxu lo penbi''' — ''I don't have a pen.''
:Related words: '''cau''', '''cirko''', '''kunti''', '''nitcu''', '''pindi''', '''banzu'''</notes></valsi>
<valsi word="clika" type="verb"><definition>x<sub>1</sub> entity is lichen or moss of species x<sub>2</sub> taxon growing on x<sub>3</sub> entity</definition><notes>
:'''lo clika''' — moss
:'''ti clika fi lo rokci''' — ''This is moss growing on rocks.''
:Related words: '''mledi'''</notes></valsi>
<valsi word="clira" type="verb"><definition>x<sub>1</sub> event is early by standard x<sub>2</sub> proposition</definition><notes>
:'''lo clira''' — early event
:'''lo nu la alis pu cliva lo briju cu clira lo sruma be mi''' — ''Alice leaving the office was early according to my assumption.''
:Related words: '''lerci'''</notes></valsi>
<valsi word="clite" type="verb"><definition>x<sub>1</sub> entity is polite in matter x<sub>2</sub> property of x1 event</definition><notes>
:'''lo clite''' — polite, '''lo se clite''' — polite behaviour
:'''do pu na clite lo ka cusku lo se du'u lo ctuca na drani''' — ''You wasn't polite in saying that the teacher isn't right.''
:Related words: '''ritli'''</notes></valsi>
<valsi word="cliva" type="verb"><definition>x<sub>1</sub> entity leaves x<sub>2</sub> entity, property of x1 via x<sub>3</sub> entity</definition><notes>
:'''ra pu cliva lo kumfa lo canko''' — ''He left the room via the window.''
:Related words: '''litru''', '''canci''', '''vimcu''', '''lebna''', '''muvdu'''</notes></valsi>
<valsi word="clupa" type="verb"><definition>x<sub>1</sub> entity is a loop of material x<sub>2</sub> entity</definition><notes>
:'''lo clupa''' — loop
:'''ko jai se torni lo skori ja'e lo nu ri clupa''' — ''Twist the rope into a loop.''
:Related words: '''djine'''</notes></valsi>
<valsi word="cmaci" type="verb"><definition>x<sub>1</sub> proposition is mathematics describing x<sub>2</sub> entity</definition><notes>
:'''lo cmaci''' — mathematics, '''lo se cmaci''' — field of mathematics
:'''mi tadni lo cmaci be lo klani''' — ''I study arithmetics (mathemaics of quantity).''
:Related words: '''mekso'''</notes></valsi>
<valsi word="cmalu" type="verb"><definition>x<sub>1</sub> entity is small in length/width etc. x<sub>2</sub> property of x1</definition><notes>
:'''lo cmalu''' — small
:'''lo nu penmi ba cmalu lo ka ditcu''' — ''The meeting will be short in duration.''
:'''lo cukta cu cmalu lo ka jai vajni''' — ''The book is of little importance.''
:Related words: '''caxno''', '''cinla''', '''jarki''', '''tordu''', '''barda'''</notes></valsi>
<valsi word="cmana" type="verb"><definition>x<sub>1</sub> entity is a mountain projecting from land-mass x<sub>2</sub> entity</definition><notes>
:'''lo cmana''' — mountain, '''lo se cmana''' — land mass with a mountain
:'''so'i da cmana lo vi tumla''' — ''This land has a lot of mountains.''
:Related words: '''punli''', '''derxi'''</notes></valsi>
<valsi word="cmavo" type="verb"><definition>x<sub>1</sub> text is a grammatical particle of class x<sub>2</sub> taxon</definition><notes>
:'''lo cmavo''' — grammatical particle
:'''zo ka cmavo ma'oi nu''' — ''ka is a particle of class "NU"''
:Related words: '''gismu''', '''lujvo''', '''gerna''', '''smuni''', '''valsi'''</notes></valsi>
<valsi word="cmene" type="verb"><definition>x<sub>1</sub> text is the name for x<sub>2</sub> entity used by x<sub>3</sub> entity</definition><notes>
Comment: Note that the first place of '''cmene''' requires a quote using e.g. '''zo''' or '''lu''' ... '''li'u'''.
:'''lo cmene''' — name, '''lo te cmene''' — namegiver
:'''ma jetnu cmene do''' — ''What is your real name?''
:'''mi se cmene zo gleki''' — ''My name is Gleki.''
:'''lo bruna cu te cmene mi zo ractu''' — ''My brother calls me "Rabbit"''
:Related words: '''me'e''', '''gismu''', '''tcita''', '''valsi''', '''judri'''</notes></valsi>
<valsi word="cmevla" type="verb"><definition>x<sub>1</sub> text is a cmevla (Lojban word ending in a consonant)</definition><notes>
:'''lo cmevla''' — cmevla
:'''zo lojban cmevla''' — ''"Lojban" is cmevla.''
:Related words: '''selbrivla''', '''gismu''', '''zi'evla''', '''cmavo''', '''cmene'''</notes></valsi>
<valsi word="cmila" type="verb"><definition>x<sub>1</sub> entity laughs</definition><notes>
:'''ra pu co'a cmila''' — ''She started laughing.''
:Related words: '''ckasu''', '''frumu''', '''xajmi''', '''cisma'''</notes></valsi>
<valsi word="cmima" type="verb"><definition>x<sub>1</sub> entity is a member of set x<sub>2</sub> entity</definition><notes>
Comment: x1 describes members of a set. To specify all members of a set use '''gunma'''
:'''lo cmima''' — member, '''lo se cmima''' — set
:'''mi cmima lo gugde kamni''' — ''I am a member of a state committee.''
:Related words: '''ciste''', '''porsi''', '''jbini''', '''girzu''', '''gunma''', '''klesi''', '''mei''', '''kampu''', '''lanzu''', '''liste'''</notes></valsi>
<valsi word="cmoni" type="verb"><definition>x<sub>1</sub> entity howls, utters, moans x<sub>2</sub> sound expressing x<sub>3</sub> property of x1</definition><notes>
Comment: '''cmoni''' describes emotional utterances. For uttering text use '''bacru''', for shouting text use '''krixa'''
:'''lo cmoni''' — moaner
:'''i le prenu pu cmoni zo a lo ka gleki''' — ''The person uttered "A!" expressing his happiness.''
:Related words: '''krixa''', '''bacru''', '''cusku''', '''cortu'''</notes></valsi>
<valsi word="cnano" type="verb"><definition>x<sub>1</sub> entity is normal in x<sub>2</sub> property of x1 among x<sub>3</sub> same type as x1</definition><notes>
Comment: '''cnano''' is the generalized opposite to any/all of these concepts: '''cizra''', '''fadni''', '''cafne''', '''kampu'''
:'''lo cnano''' — norm
:'''lo ki'ogra be li ci cu cnano lo ka se junta vau lo ca zi jbena''' — ''3 kilograms is a normal weight of newborns.''
:Related words: '''tcaci''', '''fadni''', '''kampu''', '''lakne''', '''tarti''', '''rirci'''</notes></valsi>
<valsi word="cnebo" type="verb"><definition>x<sub>1</sub> entity is a neck of body x<sub>2</sub> entity</definition><notes>
:'''lo cnebo''' — neck
:'''lo cnebo be lo za'u vi ninmu cu clani''' — ''These women have long necks.''
:Related words: '''galxe''', '''cutne'''</notes></valsi>
<valsi word="cnemu" type="verb"><definition>x<sub>1</sub> entity rewards x<sub>2</sub> entity for atypical x<sub>3</sub> property of x2 with x<sub>4</sub> entity, property of x1</definition><notes>
:'''lo cnemu''' — rewarder, '''lo se cnemu''' — rewardee, '''lo te cnemu''' — reason for a reward, '''lo ve cnemu''' — reward
:'''mi pu cnemu lo gerku lo ka bevri lo grana lo ka dunda lo sakta gy''' — ''I rewarded the dog for bringing the stick by giving it sugar.''
:Related words: '''dunda''', '''friti''', '''jerna''', '''jinga''', '''jivna''', '''pleji''', '''sfasa''', '''venfu''', '''prali''', '''dapma'''</notes></valsi>
<valsi word="cnici" type="verb"><definition>x<sub>1</sub> entity is neat or orderly in x<sub>2</sub> property of x1</definition><notes>
:'''lo cnici''' — neat
:'''lo kerfa cu cnici lo ka se ganzu fi lo carmi''' — ''The hair is neat in being organized into a shining part.''
:Related words: '''cunso''', '''kalsa'''</notes></valsi>
<valsi word="cnino" type="verb"><definition>x<sub>1</sub> entity is new to observer x<sub>2</sub> entity in property x<sub>3</sub> property of x1</definition><notes>
:'''lo cnino''' — new
:'''lo mi pendo co'a cnino mi lo ka kakne lo ka zgipli fi lo pipno''' — ''My friend appeared new to me in being able to play the piano.''
:'''cnino fa no cnita be la lunra''' — ''Nothing is new under the Moon (saying).''
:Related words: '''nuzba''', '''slabu''', '''citno''', se '''djuno'''</notes></valsi>
<valsi word="cnisa" type="verb"><definition>x<sub>1</sub> entity is some quantity of lead metal</definition><notes>
:'''lo cnisa''' — lead (metal)
:'''ra pu troci lo ka zbasu lo solji lo cnisa''' — ''He tried to make gold out of lead.''
:Related words: '''jinme''', '''tinci'''</notes></valsi>
<valsi word="cnita" type="verb"><definition>x<sub>1</sub> entity is directly beneath or below x<sub>2</sub> entity entity</definition><notes>
:'''lo cnita''' — what is beneath, '''lo se cnita''' — what is above
:'''lo pelji cu cnita lo cukta''' — ''The paper is below the book.''
:Related words: '''dizlo''', '''gapru''', '''galtu''', '''farna''', '''loldi'''</notes></valsi>
<valsi word="co"><definition>inverts the order of parts of compound verb</definition>
<notes>:'''lu lo ractu co melbi li'u du lu lo melbi ractu li'u''' — ''the pretty bunny is the same as "bunny, the pretty"''
</notes></valsi><valsi word="co'a" type="preposition"><definition>at the start of the event (inchoative aspect)</definition>
<notes>:'''pu co'a ru'i carvi''' — ''It started raining.''
:'''le plise co'a fusra''' — ''The apple has begun to decay.''
:'''co'a pelxu''' — ''It's turning yellow.''
</notes></valsi><valsi word="co'e" type="verb"><definition>main verb unspecified or known from context</definition>
<notes>:'''mu'i ma do co'e mi''' — ''Why are you doing this to me?''
:'''za'o co'e''' — ''It's going on for too long.''
:'''ei do troci lo ka co'e bu'u lo drata''' — ''You should try it somewhere else.''
</notes></valsi><valsi word="co'i" type="preposition"><definition>aspect treating the whole event without internal structure (perfective aspect), '''co'inai''' — aspect treating the whole event as having internal structure (imperfective aspect)</definition>
<notes>:'''mi pu co'inai citka lo mango ca lo nu ra co'i nerkla''' — ''I was eating a mango when she entered. .''
</notes></valsi><valsi word="co'o" type="vocative"><definition>''Goodbye! Bye!''</definition>
<notes>:'''co'o lo mi tumla''' — ''Goodbye, my land!''
</notes></valsi><valsi word="co'oi" type="vocative"><definition>''Ciao!'' (''hello!'' or ''goodbye!'' depending on context)</definition>
<notes>:'''co'oi lo mi pendo''' — ''Ciao, my friend!''
:Related words: '''a'oi''', '''coi''', '''co'o''', '''rinsa''', '''tolrinsa'''
</notes></valsi><valsi word="co'u" type="preposition"><definition>quitting, stopping even if before the expected end (cessative aspect)</definition>
<notes>:'''u'anai mi pu co'u pinxe lo stasu''' — ''I haven't eaten up soup.''
</notes></valsi><valsi word="coi" type="vocative"><definition>''Hello! Hi!''</definition>
<notes>:'''coi le munje''' — ''Hello, world!''
</notes></valsi><valsi word="cokcu" type="verb"><definition>x<sub>1</sub> entity soaks up x<sub>2</sub> entity from x<sub>3</sub> entity into x<sub>4</sub> entity</definition><notes>
:'''lo cokcu''' — absorber, '''lo se cokcu''' — absorbed
:'''lo verba cu cokcu lo ladru lo tatru lo moklu''' — ''Children suck up milk from breast into the mouth.''
:Related words: '''panje''', '''sakci''', '''lacpu'''</notes></valsi>
<valsi word="condi" type="verb"><definition>x<sub>1</sub> entity is deep in x<sub>2</sub> property of x1 away from reference point x<sub>3</sub> entity</definition><notes>
:'''lo condi''' — deep
:'''lo vi xamsi cu condi lo ka tsuku lo loldi be ce'u vau lo sefta''' — ''This sea is deep in reaching the bottom from the surface.''
:'''e'o do bevri lo condi kabri''' — ''Please, bring a deep glass.''
:Related words: '''clani''', '''caxno''', '''bargu''', '''ganra''', '''rotsu''', '''barda''', '''gutci''', '''minli'''</notes></valsi>
<valsi word="cortu" type="verb"><definition>x<sub>1</sub> entity feels pain at x<sub>2</sub> entity</definition><notes>
Comment: Often the second place of x2 is the same as x1
:'''lo cortu''' — who feels pain, '''lo se cortu''' — location of pain, '''lo xe cortu''' — ``
:'''mi cortu lo xance''' — ''My hand hurts.''
:'''mi cortu lo galxe be mi''' — ''I have a sore throat.''
:Related words: '''cinmo''', '''xrani'''</notes></valsi>
<valsi word="cpacu" type="verb"><definition>x<sub>1</sub> entity acquires or gets x<sub>2</sub> entity, property of x1 from x<sub>3</sub> entity</definition><notes>, '''lo se cpacu''' — acquired
:'''mi ba cpacu lo grute mi''' — ''I'll get fruits for myself.''
:'''mi xance te cpacu fi la kevin fe lo dakfu''' — ''I handed Kevin a knife.''
:Related words: '''punji''', '''lebna''', '''vimcu'''</notes></valsi>
<valsi word="cpana" type="verb"><definition>x<sub>1</sub> entity on top of x<sub>2</sub> entity entity</definition><notes>
Comment: '''punji''' is for 'lay upon'
:'''lo cpana''' — what is on top, '''lo se cpana''' — what is below
:'''da bisli fi'o se cpana lo cmana''' — ''There is ice on top of the mountain.''
:Related words: '''se''' '''vasru''', '''jbini''', '''zvati''', '''nenri''', '''vreta''', '''ckana''', '''diklo''', '''jibni''', '''lamji''', '''zutse''', '''punji''', '''sarji''', '''zbepi'''</notes></valsi>
<valsi word="cpare" type="verb"><definition>x<sub>1</sub> entity climbs on x<sub>2</sub> entity; x1 wades through x2</definition><notes>
:'''ra pu mo'u cpare lo cmana''' — ''She has climbed on the mountain.''
:Related words: '''klama''', '''litru''', '''bajra''', '''farlu''', '''plipe'''</notes></valsi>
<valsi word="cpedu" type="verb"><definition>x<sub>1</sub> entity requests or asks for x<sub>2</sub> event, property of x3 from x<sub>3</sub> entity</definition><notes>
Comment: a request may be indicated in speech, in writing, or by an action (e.g. petitions are often in writing, while begging/panhandling may be indicated by an action or even demeanor)., '''lo se cpedu''' — something requested
:'''le nanmu pu cpedu lo ka jai gau kalri fai lo vorme vau mi ta'i lo ka jai gau muvdu fai lo xance''' — ''The man asked me to open the door by movign his hand.''
:Related words: '''cusku''', '''pikci''', '''te''' '''preti''', '''te''' '''frati''', '''se''' '''spuda''', '''danfu'''</notes></valsi>
<valsi word="cpina" type="verb"><definition>x<sub>1</sub> entity is pungent or irritating to observer x<sub>2</sub> entity</definition><notes>
:'''lo cpina''' — pungent, irritating
:'''lo sanso cu cpina''' — ''The sauce is hot.''
:'''lo panci cu cpina''' — ''The smell is irritating.''
:Related words: '''vrusi''', '''kukte''', '''cidja''', '''panci''', '''sumne'''</notes></valsi>
<valsi word="cradi" type="verb"><definition>x<sub>1</sub> entity broadcasts or transmits x<sub>2</sub> entity via station or frequency x<sub>3</sub> entity to receiver x<sub>4</sub> entity</definition><notes>
:'''lo cradi''' — broadcaster, '''lo se cradi''' — broadcasted, '''lo te cradi''' — broadcasting station, '''lo ve cradi''' — broadcast receiver
:'''ti cradi lo vajni notci lo tordu boxna lo se bevri''' — ''This is a radio transmitter sending important messages on short waves to portable receivers.''
:Related words: '''tivni''', '''benji''', '''tcana'''</notes></valsi>
<valsi word="crane" type="verb"><definition>x<sub>1</sub> entity is in front of x<sub>2</sub> entity facing x<sub>3</sub> entity</definition><notes>
:'''lo crane''' — something in front
:'''lo tricu cu crane la alis la kevin''' — ''A tree is before (in front of) Alice from Kevin's position.''
:'''lo tricu cu crane mi''' — ''A tree is in front of me.''
:'''lo citno cu pagre fi'o se crane lo lunra''' — ''A shadow passed before the moon.''
:Related words: '''sefta''', '''flira''', '''trixe''', '''mlana''', '''pritu''', '''zunle'''</notes></valsi>
<valsi word="creka" type="verb"><definition>x<sub>1</sub> entity is a shirt</definition><notes>
:'''lo creka''' — shirt
:'''do poi dasni lo creka cu simlu lo ka stati''' — ''You look smart in the shirt.''
:Related words: '''taxfu'''</notes></valsi>
<valsi word="crepu" type="verb"><definition>x<sub>1</sub> entity harvests x<sub>2</sub> property of x2 from x<sub>3</sub> entity</definition><notes>
:'''lo crepu''' — harvester, '''lo se crepu''' — harvested crop, '''lo te crepu''' — crop field
:'''ra crepu lo vanjba lo purdi''' — ''She is harvesting grapes from the garden.''
:Related words: '''critu''', '''sombo''', '''jmaji'''</notes></valsi>
<valsi word="cribe" type="verb"><definition>x<sub>1</sub> entity is a bear of species x<sub>2</sub> taxon</definition><notes>
:'''lo cribe''' — bear (animal)
:'''lo cribe cu se zdani lo vi boske''' — ''Bears live in this forest.''
:Related words: '''danlu''', '''mabru'''</notes></valsi>
<valsi word="crida" type="verb"><definition>x<sub>1</sub> entity is a fairy, elf, or other mythical humanoid</definition><notes>
:'''lo crida''' — fairy, elf
:'''mi pu cusku lo lisri be lo za'u crida''' — ''I told a story about fairies.''
:Related words: '''ranmi''', '''lijda'''</notes></valsi>
<valsi word="crino" type="verb"><definition>x<sub>1</sub> entity is green</definition><notes>
:'''lo crino''' — green
:'''ca lo crisa lo pezli poi crino co'a xunre''' — ''In the fall leaves that are green turn red.''
:Related words: '''skari''', '''blabi''', '''xekri''', '''kandi''', '''carmi''', '''cicna'''</notes></valsi>
<valsi word="cripu" type="verb"><definition>x<sub>1</sub> entity is a bridge across x<sub>2</sub> entity between points x<sub>3</sub> plural of entity</definition><notes>
:'''lo cripu''' — bridge
:'''mi'ai muvdu fo lo cripu be lo rirxe bei lo tcadu ce lo nurma''' — ''We are moving over the birdge across the river that connects the city and the rural zone.''
:Related words: '''bargu''', '''kruca''', '''ragve''', '''kuspe'''</notes></valsi>
<valsi word="crisa" type="verb"><definition>x<sub>1</sub> entity is summer of year x<sub>2</sub> entity at location x<sub>3</sub> entity</definition><notes>
:'''lo crisa''' — summer

<valsi word="cu"><definition>shows the beginning of the clause tail</definition>
<notes>Comment: can be omitted if the previous word is a pronoun of the same clause, can also be replaced with prepositions.
:'''lei rirni cu zvati ti ca''' — ''The parents are here now.''
</notes></valsi><valsi word="cu'e" type="preposition"><definition>asks for an appropriate preposition or a combination of them</definition>
<notes>:'''do cu'e vitke la nipon - pu'o''' — ''Have you been to Japan? - I'm about to.''
:'''le penbi cu'e zvati - pu vu''' — ''Where is the pen? - It was over there.''
</notes></valsi><valsi word="cu'i" type="interjection modifier"><definition>neutral intensity (on the scale) interjection. Can be used either on its own or as a modifier of interjection</definition>
<notes>:'''aucu'i le bruna mo'u tsuku''' — ''The brother arrived, meh.''
</notes></valsi><valsi word="cu'o" type="verb"><definition>number > verb denoting probability</definition>
<notes>Comment: x1 (entity) has probability (n) of occurring under conditions x2 (entity). The number (n) is put in front of '''cu'o'''.

<notes>Comment: used for quotations.

:Related words: '''masti''', '''djedi''', '''nanca''', '''nu''', '''fasnu''', '''purci''', '''balvi''', '''jeftu''')</notes></valsi>
<valsi word="dau" type="digit/number"><definition>hex digit A (decimal 10) [ten]</definition>
<notes>:'''ei mi'o denpa ze'a lo djedi be li dau''' — ''We should wait for 10 days.''
</notes></valsi><valsi word="dau'i" type="interjection modifier"><definition>equal intensity interjection. Used as a modifier of interjections</definition>
<notes>Comment: specifies an intensity of an interjection equal to the intensity of the same interjection earlier used.
:'''ju'o la alis ba tsuku''' — ''I'm sure Alice will arrive.''
:'''ju'o dau'i ji'a la kevin ba vitke mi'a''' — ''And I'm equally sure that Kevin will visit us.''
:Related words: '''dau'i''', '''mau'i''', '''me'ai''', '''cu'i''', '''sai''', '''ru'e'''
</notes></valsi><valsi word="de" type="pronoun"><definition>there exists something or someone: 2nd pronoun of '''da''', '''de''', '''di''' series</definition>
<notes>:'''ro da poi ke'a sinma ke'a cu se sinma ro de poi ke'a sinma di''' — ''Everyone who respects oneself is respected by everyone who respects someone.''
</notes></valsi><valsi word="de'a" type="preposition"><definition>pause (pausative aspect)</definition>
<notes>:'''mi pu de'a citka lo plise''' — ''I stopped eating apples for a while.''
</notes></valsi><valsi word="de'e" type="pronoun"><definition>a near future utterance</definition>
<notes>:'''de'e cinri jufra''' — ''The following sentence is interesting.''
:'''au do tirna mi''' — ''I'd like you to listen to me.''
:'''lo xunre cu srana lo nu fengu''' — ''Red is related to the state of being angry.''
</notes></valsi><valsi word="de'i" type="preposition from '''detri'''"><definition>''on date ...'' (date stamp follows)</definition>
<notes>Comment: ???explain.
:'''de'i li pamu pi'e ci mi pu zvati la nipon''' — ''On March 15 I was in Japan.''
</notes></valsi><valsi word="de'u" type="pronoun"><definition>a recent utterance</definition>
<notes>:'''i fi'o suksa co'a gusni bu'u lo darno''' — ''Suddenly a light appeared far away and then the light disappeared.''
:'''babo le gusni cu canci''' — ''They both tried to observe it once again.''
:'''le remei pu troci loka ganse le gusni vau za'ure'u i ku'i le remei na pu djuno lo du'u xukau la'e de'e cu du lo sinxa poi le remei ze'u kanpe tu'a ke'a''' — ''But they didn't know whether that was the sign they had been expecting for so long.''
</notes></valsi><valsi word="decti" type="verb"><definition>x<sub>1</sub> entity is a tenth of x<sub>2</sub> same type as x1 in x<sub>3</sub> property of x1</definition><notes>

<notes>:'''ma xamgu traji tadji lo nu tadni la lojban''' — ''What is the best method of learning Lojban?''

<valsi word="do" type="pronoun"><definition>''you'' (the listener)</definition>

<valsi word="drudi" type="verb"><definition>x<sub>1</sub> entity is a roof or lid of structure x<sub>2</sub> entity</definition><notes>
