:'''lo drudi''' — lid, '''lo se drudi''' — something with a lid
:'''lo drudi be lo dinju cu ei se cikre''' — ''The roof of the building needs fixing.''
:Related words: '''bitmu''', '''stedu''', '''galtu''', '''gapru''', '''loldi''', '''marbi''', '''gacri''', '''mapku'''</notes></valsi>
<valsi word="du" type="verb"><definition>x<sub>1</sub> entity , x<sub>2</sub> entity , x<sub>3</sub> are the same thing; corresponds to the operator '=' in math, can have any number of places</definition><notes>
:'''lo du''' — lid, '''lo se du''' — something with a lid
:'''li pa su'i pa du li re li pano fe'i mu''' — ''1 + 1 = 2 = 10 / 5.''
:Related words: '''bitmu''', '''stedu''', '''galtu''', '''gapru''', '''loldi''', '''marbi''', '''gacri''', '''mapku'''</notes></valsi>
<valsi word="du'e" type="digit/number"><definition>too many</definition>
<notes>Comment: subjective estimate.
:'''le vacri ca du'eva'e glare''' — ''It's too hot.''
:'''du'e prenu cu zvati le laji''' — ''There are too many people in the street.''
</notes></valsi><valsi word="du'i" type="preposition from '''dunli'''"><definition>''equally'', ''as much as ...''</definition>
<notes>Comment: x1 of the clause corresponds to '''lo se dunli''', preposition sumti corresponds to '''lo dunli''' — ''equal to'', the clause itself corresponds to '''lo te zmadu''' — the comparison.
:'''mi'a du'i casnu lo mintu''' — ''We equally discussed the same.''
:'''xu do cando du'i mi''' — ''Are you as busy as I am?''
</notes></valsi><valsi word="du'u" type="clause prefix"><definition>clause > verb</definition>
<notes>Comment: x1 is the clause (that follows) expressed in sentence x2 (text).
:'''mi djuno lo du'u do na fuzme''' — ''I know that you are not responsible.''
</notes></valsi><valsi word="dugri" type="verb"><definition>x<sub>1</sub> number is the logarithm of x<sub>2</sub> number to base x<sub>3</sub> number</definition><notes>
:'''lo dugri''' — logarithm, '''lo te dugri''' — base of a logarithm
:'''li 3 dugri li 1000 li 10''' — ''3 is the logarithm of 1000 to base 10.''
:Related words: '''tenfa'''</notes></valsi>
<valsi word="dukti" type="verb"><definition>x<sub>1</sub> entity is opposite or contrary to x<sub>2</sub> entity in x<sub>3</sub> property of x1 and x2 with '''kau'''</definition><notes>
:'''lo dukti''' — opposite
:'''la alis la kevin pu dukti lo ka catlu makau''' — ''Alice and Kevin looked in the opposite directions.''
:Related words: '''ranxi''', '''ragve''', '''fatne'''</notes></valsi>
<valsi word="dunda" type="verb"><definition>x<sub>1</sub> entity gives or donates x<sub>2</sub> entity, property of x1 to x<sub>3</sub> entity</definition><notes>
:'''lo dunda''' — giver, '''lo se dunda''' — gift, '''lo te dunda''' — receiver of a gift
:'''mi pu dunda lo plise do''' — ''I gave you an apple.''
:Related words: '''benji''', '''muvdu''', '''canja''', '''pleji''', '''vecnu''', '''friti''', '''sfasa''', '''dapma''', '''cnemu''', '''prali'''</notes></valsi>
<valsi word="dunja" type="verb"><definition>x<sub>1</sub> entity freezes</definition><notes>
:'''ra na ru'e dunja''' — ''He almost froze.''
:Related words: '''febvi''', '''lunsa''', '''runme''', '''sligu'''</notes></valsi>
<valsi word="dunku" type="verb"><definition>x<sub>1</sub> entity is distressed or anguished by x<sub>2</sub> event</definition><notes>
:'''lo dunku''' — distressed, '''lo se dunku''' — distressing event
:'''mi pu dunku lo ka nonseka''' — ''I was distressed at beging alone.''
:'''xu do dunku lo nu lo do mensi cu bilma''' — ''Are you distressed at your sister being ill?''
:Related words: '''fengu''', '''surla'''</notes></valsi>
<valsi word="dunli" type="verb"><definition>x<sub>1</sub> entity is equal to x<sub>2</sub> entity in x<sub>3</sub> property of x1 and x2 with '''kau'''</definition><notes>
:'''lo dunli''' — equal
:'''CC''' — ''.''
:Related words: '''du'i''', '''satci''', '''frica''', '''simsa''', '''mintu'''</notes></valsi>
<valsi word="dunra" type="verb"><definition>x<sub>1</sub> entity is winter of year x<sub>2</sub> entity at location x<sub>3</sub> entity</definition><notes>
:'''lo dunra''' — winter
:'''ca lo dunra be lo renonomu moi bei la australias mi pu zvati ti''' — ''During Australian winter of year 2005 I was here.''
:Related words: '''citsi''', '''crisa''', '''critu''', '''vensa'''</notes></valsi>
<valsi word="dy" type="pronoun"><definition>letter 'D'</definition>
<notes></notes></valsi><valsi word="dzena" type="verb"><definition>x<sub>1</sub> entity is an elder or ancestor of x<sub>2</sub> entity by bond x<sub>3</sub> property of x1 and x2</definition><notes>
:'''lo dzena''' — ancestor, '''lo se dzena''' — descendant
:'''do dzena mi lo ka ce'u ce'u lidne lo ka jbena ca makau''' — ''You are my ancestor since you were born before me.''
:Related words: '''patfu''', '''rirni''', '''tamne'''</notes></valsi>
<valsi word="dzipo" type="verb"><definition>x<sub>1</sub> entity is Antarctican in x<sub>2</sub> property of x1</definition><notes>
:'''au mi vitka lo dzipo tumla''' — ''I want to visit the Antarctica.''
:Related words: '''ketco''', '''friko''', '''sralo''', '''terdi'''</notes></valsi>
<valsi word="e" type="conjunction for nouns"><definition>''and''</definition>
<notes>:'''mi e do pu casnu lo za'u bangu''' — ''I discussed languages, and you discussed languages (may be not with each other, may be in different discussions).''
:Related words: '''ce''', '''je''', '''a''', '''e''', '''ji''', '''o''', '''u'''
</notes></valsi><valsi word="e'a" type="interjection"><definition>''you may, I allow'', '''e'anai''' — prohibiting</definition>
<notes>:'''e'a do klama lo nenri''' — ''You may come in.''
:'''zu'e e'anai fagri''' — ''No fire allowed!''
:'''e'anai crepu lo flora''' — ''You may not pick the flowers.''
:Related words: '''permite'''
</notes></valsi><valsi word="e'e" type="interjection"><definition>instigation, provokation, '''e'enai''' — discouragement, demoralization</definition>
<notes>:'''e'e do jarco lo ka vlipa''' — ''Show your strength, go for it!''
:'''e'e mi kuspe do''' — ''I'll reach you.''
:'''e'enai mi claxu lo se ditcu''' — ''Sorry, I lack time.''
:Related words: '''kakne''', '''certu'''
</notes></valsi><valsi word="e'i" type="interjection"><definition>command, instruction, imposing obligation (imperative interjection)</definition>
<notes>:'''e'i mi cliva''' — ''I have to leave.''
:'''do sanga e'i''' — ''Sing!''
:Related words: '''selri'u''', '''seljimte'''
</notes></valsi><valsi word="e'o" type="interjection"><definition>''please'' (request), '''e'onai''' — offer, grant</definition>
<notes>:'''e'o mi zgana''' — ''Let me see.''
:'''e'o do dunda le jisra mi''' — ''Will you pass the huice, please?''
:'''e'onai ko lebna lo titla''' — ''Here, take some candies.''
:Related words: '''cpedu''', '''pikci'''
</notes></valsi><valsi word="e'u" type="interjection"><definition>''Let's'' (suggestion), '''e'unai''' — warning, disadvise</definition>
<notes>:'''e'u mi'o troci''' — ''Let's try.''
:'''e'u klama''' — ''Let's go.''
:'''e'unai do stapa lo crepu''' — ''You'd better not step onto the bridge.''
:Related words: '''stidi''', '''kajde'''
</notes></valsi><valsi word="ebu" type="pronoun"><definition>letter 'E'</definition>
<notes></notes></valsi><valsi word="ei" type="interjection"><definition>''I should ..., one should ...'' (obligation), '''einai''' — freedom, how things need not be</definition>
<notes>:'''ei do ca sipna''' — ''You should be sleeping now.''
:'''ei do djuno''' — ''You ought to know.''
:'''einai do mipri lo nei''' — ''You needn't hide yourself.''
:Related words: '''bilga''', '''zifre'''
</notes></valsi><valsi word="enge" type="verb"><definition>x<sub>1</sub> entity is an architect/designer/engineer of x<sub>2</sub> entity</definition><notes>
:'''lo enge''' — designer
:'''lo mi patfu pu enge lo vi dinju''' — ''My father was an architect of this building.''
:Related words: '''zbasu''', '''platu'''</notes></valsi>
<valsi word="entuzi" type="verb"><definition>x<sub>1</sub> entity is enthusiastic, excited about x<sub>2</sub> event, property of x1</definition><notes>
Comment: '''carmi''' '''akti''' is for the meaning 'excited (in high energy state)'
:'''lo entuzi''' — enthusiastic
:'''la kevin cu mutce lo ka entuzi lo ka co'a se jbiri lo cnino''' — ''Kevin is very enthusiastic about getting a new job.''
:Related words: '''xanka''', '''carmi''', '''akti'''</notes></valsi>
<valsi word="esporte" type="verb"><definition>x<sub>1</sub> entity is a type of sports practiced by x<sub>2</sub> entity</definition><notes>
:'''lo esporte''' — sports, '''lo se esporte''' — sportsperson, sportsman, sportswoman
:'''mi se esporte la tenis''' — ''I practice tennis.''
:Related words: '''zajba''', '''sluji''', '''dansu'''</notes></valsi>
<valsi word="fa" type="case tag"><definition>prefix for the 1st noun of the current clause</definition>
<notes>:'''fe zo coi cusku fa mi''' — ''Hello, said I.''
:'''fe ma fa mi zukte ei''' — ''What shoulg I do?''
:'''sarcu fa lo nu do zvati''' — ''It's required that you are present.''
</notes></valsi><valsi word="fa'a" type="preposition"><definition>''directly towards ...''</definition>
<notes>:'''ko catlu fa'a le canko''' — ''Look in the direction of the window.''
:'''xu le cipni ca'o vofli fa'a lo solri''' — ''Is the bird flying towards the Sun?''
</notes></valsi><valsi word="fa'u" type="conjunction"><definition>''and respectively ...'' (forms unmixed set)</definition>
<notes>:'''zmadu fa'u mleca fi lo ka sampu fa'u lo ka drani''' — ''It's more easy and less correct, respectively.''
</notes></valsi><valsi word="facki" type="verb"><definition>x<sub>1</sub> entity discovers fact x<sub>2</sub> proposition about x<sub>3</sub> entity</definition><notes>
Comment: For searching for objects and finding them use '''mitysisku''' and '''tolcri'''
:'''lo facki''' — discoverer, '''lo se facki''' — a discovery
:'''mi facki lo jitfa lo pu se cusku be la alis''' — ''I discovered that what Alice said is false.''
:'''mi facki lo du'u le tcadu cu jibni''' — ''I found that the city is near.''
:'''mi pu facki lo du'u lo lisri cu xajmi''' — ''I found the story funny.''
:Related words: '''cirko''', '''djuno''', '''jijnu''', '''smadi''', '''sisku'''</notes></valsi>
<valsi word="fadni" type="verb"><definition>x<sub>1</sub> entity is ordinary in x<sub>2</sub> property of x1 among x<sub>3</sub> entity</definition><notes>
Comment: wrong usage
:'''lo fadni''' — typical, ordinary
:'''fi lo mi pendo cu fadni fa la kevin lo ka cusku lo simsa pe mi''' — ''Among my friends it's common for Kevin to say such things about me.''
:Related words: '''cafne''', '''rirci''', '''kampu''', '''lakne''', '''tcaci''', '''cnano'''</notes></valsi>
<valsi word="fagri" type="verb"><definition>x<sub>1</sub> entity is a fire in fuel x<sub>2</sub> entity burning in x<sub>3</sub> entity: 'oxygen' by default</definition><notes>
:'''lo fagri''' — fire, '''lo se fagri''' — fuel for fire, '''lo te fagri''' — oxidizer of fire
:'''lo fagri be lo boske bei lo brife co'a carmi''' — ''The fire in the forest burning in the wind becomes intense.''
:'''le mudri cu se fagri''' — ''The wood is burrning.''

<valsi word="fai" type="case tag"><definition>restores the part of an abstraction omitted by '''jai'''</definition>
<notes>:'''lo nu jimpe ti cu nandu''' — ''Understanding this is hard.''
:'''ti jai nandu fai lo ka se jimpe''' — ''This is hard to understand.''
</notes></valsi><valsi word="falnu" type="verb"><definition>x<sub>1</sub> entity is a sail for gathering wind x<sub>2</sub> entity on vehicle x<sub>3</sub> entity</definition><notes>
Comment: x2 can be wind, water or other forces enabling the sail to work.
:'''lo falnu''' — sail, '''lo se falnu''' — wind for a sail, '''lo te falnu''' — sailboat
:'''lo vi bloti cu te falnu''' — ''This is a sail boat.''
:'''lo vi molki cu te falnu lo djacu lo xislu''' — ''This mill operates on a water wheel.''
:Related words: '''bloti'''</notes></valsi>
<valsi word="famti" type="verb"><definition>x<sub>1</sub> entity is an aunt or uncle of x<sub>2</sub> entity by bond x<sub>3</sub> property of x1 and x2</definition><notes>
:'''lo famti''' — aunt, uncle, '''lo se famti''' — niece, nephew

:Related words: '''bruna''', '''mamta''', '''mensi''', '''patfu''', '''rirni''', '''tamne'''</notes></valsi>
<valsi word="fancu" type="verb"><definition>x<sub>1</sub> entity is a function mapping domainx<sub>2</sub> entity to rangex<sub>3</sub> entity defined by rulex<sub>4</sub> proposition; x1 is a function of x2</definition><notes>
:'''lo fancu''' — function, '''lo se fancu''' — function domain, '''lo te fancu''' — function range
:'''lo jdima be lo broda cu fancu lo ni by se sabji jo'u lo ni by se cpedu''' — ''The price of a good is a function of its supply and demand.''
:'''lo ni mi'o snada cu fancu lo ni mi'o troci''' — ''Our success depends on how hard we try.''
:'''lo ni mi jimpe ti na fancu tu'a do''' — ''I don't depend on you to understand this.''
:'''fy fancu lo'i mrena'u poi zmadu li pa lo'i mrena'u poi zmadu li no me'o vei xy su'i pa ve'o pi'i vei xy vu'u pa ve'o''' — ''f(x) = (x + 1) (x − 1), where x is a real number and x>1.''
:Related words: '''mekso''', '''bridi'''</notes></valsi>
<valsi word="fange" type="verb"><definition>x<sub>1</sub> entity is alien or unfamiliar to x<sub>2</sub> entity in x<sub>3</sub> property of x1</definition><notes>
:'''lo fange''' — alien, unfamiliar
:'''ra fange mi lo ka zukte makau''' — ''He is alien to me in what he does.''
:Related words: '''cizra''', '''jbena''', '''ckini'''</notes></valsi>

Comment: can refer to place

<valsi word="fanri" type="verb"><definition>x<sub>1</sub> entity is a factory or mill producing x<sub>2</sub> entity from x<sub>3</sub> entity</definition><notes>
:'''lo fanri''' — factory, mill, '''lo se fanri''' — product of a factory, '''lo te fanri''' — raw material for a factory
:'''ti fanri lo nanba lo gurni''' — ''This is a mill producing bread from grain.''

<valsi word="fanta" type="verb"><definition>x<sub>1</sub> entity prevents x<sub>2</sub> event from occurring</definition><notes>, '''lo se fanta''' — event being prevented

:'''lo fanva''' — translator, '''lo se fanva''' — text to be translated, '''lo te fanva''' — target language for translation, '''lo ve fanva''' — source language for translation, '''lo xe fanva''' — translation (text)

:'''do fanza mi''' — ''You annoy me.''

:'''la alis pu jai gau farlu fai le dakli le jubme''' — ''Alice dropped the bag on the table.''

<valsi word="farvi" type="verb"><definition>x<sub>1</sub> entity evolves or develops into x<sub>2</sub> entity, property of x1 from x<sub>3</sub> entity, property of x1 through stages x<sub>4</sub> ordered plural of entity, property of x1</definition><notes>, '''lo ve farvi''' — stage of development, version in development
:'''lo'e nanba cu farvi lo bredi lo te zbasu lo nu co'a mixre lo purmo ce lo matne ce lo sovda ce lo sakta ce'o lo nu glare ce'o lo nu satre vo'a lo matne''' — ''One makes a standard cake from raw materials by mixing flour, butter, eggs and sugar together, then heating, then greasing the cake with butter, and after that it is ready.''

:'''lo ei ba fasnu ba fasnu''' — ''Whatever shall be will be.''

:'''lo fatci''' — fact

<valsi word="fau" type="preposition from '''fasnu'''"><definition>''with the event of ...''</definition>
<notes>:'''fau lo nu do djica vau ko cpedu fi mi''' — ''If you want ask me.''
:'''fau ro nu do nitcu da vau ko da lebna''' — ''Whenever you need something take it.''
:'''fau da'i ro da mi snada''' — ''I would succeed anyway.''
</notes></valsi><valsi word="fe" type="case tag"><definition>prefix for the 2nd noun of the current clause</definition>
<notes>:'''fe ma zvati fa la alis''' — ''Where is Alice?''

<notes>:'''mi pu te vecnu lo pare fe'i re sovda''' — ''I bought half a dozen eggs.''

<valsi word="fegli" type="verb"><definition>x<sub>1</sub> entity is ugly to observer x<sub>2</sub> entity in aspect x<sub>3</sub> property of x1</definition><notes>

<valsi word="fendi" type="verb"><definition>x<sub>1</sub> entity divides x<sub>2</sub> entity into x<sub>3</sub> entity</definition><notes>

<valsi word="fengu" type="verb"><definition>x<sub>1</sub> entity is angry at x<sub>2</sub> entity for x<sub>3</sub> property of x2</definition><notes>
:'''lo fengu''' — angry
:'''ra pu fengu mi lo ka pu na klama''' — ''She was angry at me for not coming.''

:'''lo ka fengu cu klesi lo ka jai fenki''' — ''Anger is a form of madness.''

<valsi word="fepni" type="verb"><definition>x<sub>1</sub> entity is x<sub>2</sub> number cents/copecks in value in monetary system x<sub>3</sub> entity</definition><notes>
Comment: Describes money subunits like cents, kopecks.
:'''le penbi cu fepni li muno lo ropno''' — ''The pen costs 50 eurocents.''
:Related words: '''sicni''', '''jdini''', '''jdima''', '''vecnu''', '''rupnu''', '''dekpu''', '''gutci''', '''minli''', '''merli''', '''bunda''', '''kramu'''</notes></valsi>
<valsi word="fepri" type="verb"><definition>x<sub>1</sub> entity is the lung of x<sub>2</sub> entity</definition><notes>
:'''lo fepri''' — lung
:'''ro da pu sanga serai lo ka pilno lo fepri be vo'a''' — ''Everybody sang at the top of their lungs.''
:Related words: '''pambe''', '''vasxu'''</notes></valsi>
<valsi word="ferti" type="verb"><definition>x<sub>1</sub> entity is fertile for growing x<sub>2</sub> entity, property of x1</definition><notes>
Comment: covers both potential and actual/realized fertility.
:'''lo ferti''' — fertile
:'''lo vi tumla cu ferti lo ka te crepu lo vanjba''' — ''This land is fertile for reaping grapes.''
:'''lo vi fetsi cu ferti lo ka se tarbi''' — ''This female is fertile for conception.''
:Related words: '''vanbi''', '''sidju''', '''rorci''', '''farvi''', '''banro''', '''cange'''</notes></valsi>
<valsi word="festi" type="verb"><definition>x<sub>1</sub> entity is waste from x<sub>2</sub> entity</definition><notes>
:'''lo festi''' — waste
:'''ko bevri lo festi be lo grute lo klaji''' — ''Take the fruit scraps to the street.''
:Related words: '''xaksu''', '''kalci''', '''pinca'''</notes></valsi>
<valsi word="fetsi" type="verb"><definition>x<sub>1</sub> entity is a female of species x<sub>2</sub> taxon with feminine traits x<sub>3</sub> property of x1</definition><notes>
:'''lo fetsi''' — female, '''lo te fetsi''' — feminine trait
:'''ti fetsi lo finpe lo ka se ganti makau''' — ''This fish is female in having a certain kind of gonads.''
:Related words: '''nakni'''</notes></valsi>
<valsi word="fi" type="case tag"><definition>prefix for the 3rd noun of the current clause</definition>
<notes>:'''mi dunda fe ti fi do''' — ''I give this to you.''
:'''mi mo'u klama fi le tsani''' — ''I came from the sky.''
</notes></valsi><valsi word="fi'a" type="case tag"><definition>asks for the case tag like '''fa''', '''fe''', '''fi''', '''fo''', '''fu''' (that should go into the place to which '''fi'a''' is put)</definition>
<notes>:'''- do klama fi'a le zdani - fi''' — ''- Are you going home, from home or? - From home.''
</notes></valsi><valsi word="fi'i" type="vocative"><definition>''you are welcome, make yourself at home'' (expression of hospitality), '''fi'nai''' — expression of inhospitality</definition>
<notes>Comment: '''je'e''' is 'you are welcome' for replies to thanks.
:'''fi'i lo vitke be lo mi'a zdani''' — ''Welcome to our house.''
:'''do le'o co'e vi lo mi zdani fi'inai''' — ''How dare you show up near my house, go away!''
</notes></valsi><valsi word="fi'o"><definition>from clause to preposition</definition>
<notes>Comment: ??? explain creates adverb/preposition from bridi.
:'''le mlatu pu plipe fi'o suksa''' — ''The cat jumped quickly.''
:'''le nabmi cu nandu fi'o jinvi so'i prenu''' — ''The problem is difficult according to many people.''
</notes></valsi><valsi word="fi'u" type="digit/number"><definition>fraction slash; if no number to the left then '1' is assumed; when used alone equals to golden ratio (approximately '1.618')</definition>
<notes>:'''re fi'u ci lo prenu na kakne lo ka limna''' — ''Two thirds of people can't swim.''
:'''fi'u re lo mlatu cu zabna''' — ''Half of the cats are nice.''
:'''lo ni clani fe'i lo ni ganr cu du li fi'u''' — ''The length is in golden ratio to the length.''
</notes></valsi><valsi word="figre" type="verb"><definition>x<sub>1</sub> entity is a fig of species x<sub>2</sub> taxon</definition><notes>
:'''lo figre''' — fig
:'''mi nelci lo vi crino figre''' — ''I like these green figs.''
:Related words: '''grute'''</notes></valsi>
<valsi word="filme" type="verb"><definition>x<sub>1</sub> entity is a video, movie about x<sub>2</sub> entity</definition><notes>
Comment: Can be applied to streaming video
:'''lo filme''' — movie, film, '''lo se filme''' — plot of a movie
:'''mi pu zgana lo filme be lo crida''' — ''I watched a film about magical beings.''
:Related words: '''tivni''', '''vidni''', '''pixra''', '''finti'''</notes></valsi>
<valsi word="finpe" type="verb"><definition>x<sub>1</sub> entity is a fish of species x<sub>2</sub> taxon</definition><notes>
:'''lo finpe''' — fish
:'''mi nelci lo ka kalte lo finpe''' — ''I like fishing.''
:Related words: '''danlu'''</notes></valsi>
<valsi word="finti" type="verb"><definition>x<sub>1</sub> entity invents or creates x<sub>2</sub> entity, property of x1 for purpose x<sub>3</sub> entity from existing elements or ideas x<sub>4</sub> entity</definition><notes>
:'''lo finti''' — creator, '''lo se finti''' — creation (object created), creature, '''lo te finti''' — purpose of creation, '''lo ve finti''' — raw materials for creation
:'''mi pu finti lo lisri lo ka jai gau zdile le verba vau lo se vedli be mi''' — ''I created a story out of my real experience to amuse the child.''
:Related words: '''fi'e''', '''ciska''', '''pemci''', '''zbasu''', '''larcu''', '''prosa''', '''filme'''</notes></valsi>
<valsi word="firca" type="verb"><definition>x<sub>1</sub> entity flirts with x<sub>2</sub> entity by doing x<sub>3</sub> property of x1</definition><notes>
:'''ko sisti lo ka firca lo mi mensi lo ka benji lo se dunda ri''' — ''Stop flirting with my sister by sending her gifts.''
:Related words: '''cinse''', '''pamta'a''', '''cinjikca''', '''mletritra''', '''gletu'''</notes></valsi>
<valsi word="flalu" type="verb"><definition>x<sub>1</sub> entity is a law specifying x<sub>2</sub> property of x3 for community x<sub>3</sub> entity</definition><notes>
Comment: x1 is the name of the law
:'''lo flalu''' — law
:'''lo flalu be lo ka na ralte lo gerku bei ro se zdani cu cizra''' — ''The law specifying that no citizen should keep a dog is crazy.''
:Related words: '''javni''', '''ritli''', '''zekri''', '''pulji''', '''tinbe'''</notes></valsi>
<valsi word="flani" type="verb"><definition>x<sub>1</sub> entity is a flute, fife</definition><notes>
:'''lo flani''' — flute
:'''lo sance be lo flani cu jai pluka''' — ''The flute has a pleasant sound.''
:Related words: '''zgike'''</notes></valsi>
<valsi word="flecu" type="verb"><definition>x<sub>1</sub> entity is a current in x<sub>2</sub> entity flowing towards x<sub>3</sub> entity from x<sub>4</sub> entity</definition><notes>
Comment: This word is dispreferred to '''fluso''' that has a place structure identical to '''muvdu'''.
:'''lo flecu''' — current (flow)
:'''ti flecu lo condi lo lalxu lo galtu krasi pe bu'u loi cmana''' — ''This is a current in a deep bed running towards a lake from high springheads in the mountains.''</notes></valsi>
<valsi word="fliba" type="verb"><definition>x<sub>1</sub> entity fails at doing x<sub>2</sub> property of x1</definition><notes>
:'''mi za'ure'u fliba lo cipra''' — ''I failed the test again.''
:'''lo se troci pu se fliba''' — ''The attempt failed.''
:'''mi fliba lo ka tolcri lo penbi''' — ''I can't find the pen.''
:Related words: '''cfila''', '''snada''', '''srera''', '''troci''', '''sisti''', '''ranji''', '''denpa''', '''bebna''', '''zunti'''</notes></valsi>
<valsi word="flira" type="verb"><definition>x<sub>1</sub> entity is a face of body x<sub>2</sub> entity</definition><notes>
:'''lo flira''' — face
:'''u'e melbi flira ra''' — ''What a nice face she has!''
:'''ra pu minde mi lo ka lumci lo flira be mi''' — ''He told me to wash my face.''
:Related words: '''sefta''', '''stedu''', '''crane''', '''mebri'''</notes></valsi>
<valsi word="flora" type="verb"><definition>x<sub>1</sub> entity is a flower of plant or species x<sub>2</sub> taxon; x2 is in the bloom</definition><notes>
:'''lo flora''' — flower, '''lo se flora''' — blooming
:'''lo se flora poi do viska cu rozgu''' — ''This flower is a rose.''
:Related words: '''spati''', '''panci''', '''sumne'''</notes></valsi>
<valsi word="fluso" type="verb"><definition>x<sub>1</sub> is a fluid flowing to x<sub>2</sub> from x<sub>3</sub> via the routex<sub>4</sub></definition><notes>
Comment: '''muvdu''' is a more general term. '''senta''' is for where no directionality is implied.
:'''lo fluso''' — fluid
:'''ti fluso lo lalxu lo galtu krasi pe bu'u loi cmana lo condi''' — ''This is a current in a deep bed running towards a lake from high springheads in the mountains.''
:'''lo fluso pe lo bu'u tcadu cu carmi lo mi nazbi cu ve fluso''' — ''The traffic in this city is intense.''
:'''le cmana mo'u se fluso lo glare''' — ''I have a runny nose. The mountain erupted jetting hot matter.''
:Related words: '''rirxe''', '''senta''', '''rinci''', '''xampo''', '''letri''', '''sakci''', '''gapci''', '''litki''', '''ciblu'''</notes></valsi>
<valsi word="fo" type="case tag"><definition>prefix for the 4th noun of the current clause</definition>
<notes>:'''mi pu ciksi fe lo nu mi pu na zvati vau fo lo nu mi pu bilma''' — ''I explained that I was absent because I was ill.''
</notes></valsi><valsi word="foldi" type="verb"><definition>x<sub>1</sub> entity is a field made of material x<sub>2</sub> entity</definition><notes>
:'''lo foldi''' — field
:'''mi vreta bu'u lo foldi be lo flora''' — ''I'm lying on a flower field.''
:Related words: '''purdi''', '''cange'''</notes></valsi>
<valsi word="fonmo" type="verb"><definition>x<sub>1</sub> entity is some foam or froth of material x<sub>2</sub> entity with bubbles of material x<sub>3</sub> entity</definition><notes>
:'''lo fonmo''' — foam, '''lo te fonmo''' — bubble in foam
:'''lo glare pu ru'i cupra lo fonmo be lo djacu bei lo gapci''' — ''The heat was producing bubbles of gas in the water.''
:Related words: '''zbabu'''</notes></valsi>
<valsi word="fonxa" type="verb"><definition>x<sub>1</sub> entity is a phone or modem in network x<sub>2</sub> entity</definition><notes>
:'''lo fonxa''' — telephone, phone, '''lo se fonxa''' — phone network
:'''ti fonxa lo skori enai lo te cradi''' — ''This is a landline phone, not a radio phone.''
:Related words: '''tcana'''</notes></valsi>
<valsi word="forca" type="verb"><definition>x<sub>1</sub> entity is a fork for x<sub>2</sub> event with tines x<sub>3</sub> entity on base x<sub>4</sub> entity</definition><notes>
:'''lo forca''' — fork
:'''ti forca lo nu jukpa vau ci da lo mudri''' — ''This is a wooden fork for cooking with three tines.''
:Related words: '''dakfu''', '''smuci''', '''komcu''', '''tutci'''</notes></valsi>
<valsi word="fragari" type="verb"><definition>x<sub>1</sub> entity is a strawberry of species/breed x<sub>2</sub> taxon</definition><notes>
Comment: See '''frambesi''', '''grute''', '''jbari''', '''rozgu'''
:'''lo fragari''' — strawberry
:'''lo fragari cu je'a titla''' — ''Strawberries are relly sweet.''
:Related words: '''jbari'''</notes></valsi>
<valsi word="fraso" type="verb"><definition>x<sub>1</sub> entity is French in x<sub>2</sub> property of x1</definition><notes>
:'''lo fraso''' — French
:'''xu do se bangu lo fraso''' — ''Do you speak French?''
:Related words: '''ropno'''</notes></valsi>
<valsi word="fraxu" type="verb"><definition>x<sub>1</sub> entity forgives x<sub>2</sub> entity for x<sub>3</sub> property of x2</definition><notes>, '''lo te fraxu''' — action forgiven
:'''ko fraxu mi lo ka jai lerci''' — ''Forgive me for being late.''
:Related words: '''dunda''', '''permite''', '''zungi'''</notes></valsi>
<valsi word="frica" type="verb"><definition>x<sub>1</sub> entity differs from x<sub>2</sub> entity in x<sub>3</sub> property of x1 and x2 with '''kau'''</definition><notes>
:'''lo frica''' — something different
:'''CC''' — ''.''
:Related words: '''ranxi''', '''drata''', '''dunli''', '''simsa''', '''vrici'''</notes></valsi>
<valsi word="friko" type="verb"><definition>x<sub>1</sub> entity is African in x<sub>2</sub> property of x1</definition><notes>
:'''lo friko''' — African
:'''au mi viska lo friko xanto''' — ''I want to see African elephants.''
:Related words: '''ropno''', '''xazdo'''</notes></valsi>
<valsi word="frili" type="verb"><definition>x<sub>1</sub> property of x2 is easy for x<sub>2</sub> entity</definition><notes>
:'''lo frili''' — easy
:'''lo vi karce cu jjai frili fai lo ka sazri''' — ''This car is easy to handle.''
:'''na pu frili mi fa lo nu tolcri lo ckiku''' — ''It wasn't easy for me to find the keys.''
:Related words: '''nandu''', '''sampu''', '''zifre'''</notes></valsi>
<valsi word="frinu" type="verb"><definition>x<sub>1</sub> entity is a fraction of x<sub>2</sub> entity divided by x<sub>3</sub> entity</definition><notes>
:'''lo frinu''' — fraction, '''lo se frinu''' — numerator of a fraction, '''lo te frinu''' — denominator of a fraction
:'''li re frinu li bi li vo''' — ''2 = 8 / 2.''
:Related words: '''parbi''', '''dilcu''', '''mekso''', '''fendi'''</notes></valsi>
<valsi word="friti" type="verb"><definition>x<sub>1</sub> entity offers x<sub>2</sub> entity, property of x1 to x<sub>3</sub> entity</definition><notes>, '''lo se friti''' — offering
:'''mi pu friti fi le mamta fe lo ka sidju lo verba lo ka klama lo cnita''' — ''I offered the mother to help the child to go down.''
:Related words: '''canja''', '''dunda''', '''rinsa''', '''vecnu''', '''jdima''', '''cnemu''', '''pleji''', '''vitke'''</notes></valsi>
<valsi word="frumu" type="verb"><definition>x<sub>1</sub> entity frowns</definition><notes>
:'''ra pu frumu ca lo ka catlu mi''' — ''He frowned looking at me.''
:Related words: '''cmila''', '''cisma'''</notes></valsi>
<valsi word="fu" type="case tag"><definition>prefix for the 5th noun of the current clause</definition>
<notes>:'''mi ba benji lo xatra fu lo kibro''' — ''I will send the letter via the internet.''
</notes></valsi><valsi word="fu'au" type="discursive"><definition>''luckily'', '''fu'aucu'i''' — ''not pertaining to luck'', '''fu'aunai''' — ''unluckily''</definition>
<notes>:'''fu'au mi se permite fi lo ka dasni lo tordu skaci''' — ''Luckily, I'm allowed to wear a short skirt.''
:'''do ca zvati lo zdani fu'audai''' — ''You are now at home, lucky you.''
:'''fu'aunai lo vi dacti na mutce da'i lo ka plixau''' — ''Unluckily, this thing wouldn't be of big help.''
:'''fu'aunai no da pu ganse lo nu le ninmu ba'o kansa mi'a''' — ''Unlukily, no one noticed that she was no longer with us.''
:Related words: '''funca'''
</notes></valsi><valsi word="fu'e"><definition>creates a scope (brackets) of influence for an interjection</definition>
<notes>:ends with: '''fu'o'''
:'''mi viska lo fu'e ia cizra zdani fu'o ponse''' — ''I can see an owner of what I believe is a strange house.''
:'''mi ca klama lo drata tcadu fu'e ta'o ca lo reldei tezu'e lo ka viska loi mi rirni fu'o''' — ''I am going to another city (on Tuesday, by the way, to visit my parents).''
</notes></valsi><valsi word="fu'i" type="interjection modifier"><definition>the state has been achieved easily, '''fu'inai''' — state has been achieved hard</definition>
<notes>:'''e'efu'i mi cpare le cmana''' — ''I can easily climb the mountain, I can go for it!''
:'''uifu'inai mi tsuku lo korbi be le tcadu''' — ''Yay, that was hard but now I'm at the edge of the city.''
:Related words: '''frili'''
</notes></valsi><valsi word="fu'o"><notes>:starts with: '''FUhE'''
</notes></valsi><valsi word="fukpi" type="verb"><definition>x<sub>1</sub> entity is a copy of x<sub>2</sub> entity in form x<sub>3</sub> entity made by method x<sub>4</sub> event</definition><notes>
:'''lo fukpi''' — copy, replica
:'''mi ralte lo fukpi be lo vi pixra bei lo jubme bukpu bei lo nu prina''' — ''I have a printed copy of this picture made as a table cloth.''
:Related words: '''krefu''', '''rapli''', '''gidva''', '''zi'evla'''</notes></valsi>
<valsi word="fulta" type="verb"><definition>x<sub>1</sub> entity floats in or on gas or fluid x<sub>2</sub> entity</definition><notes>
:'''lo sefta be lo djacu cu se fulta lo morsi pezli''' — ''Dead leaves float on the surface of the water.''
:Related words: '''limna''', '''bloti''', '''sakli'''</notes></valsi>
<valsi word="funca" type="verb"><definition>x<sub>1</sub> event is determined by the good or bad luck of x<sub>2</sub> entity</definition><notes>
:'''lo funca''' — luck (good or bad)
:'''mi se funca lo ka se jundi ro da''' — ''I'm lucky in that evebody listens to me.''
:Related words: '''cunso''', '''mabla''', '''zabna'''</notes></valsi>
<valsi word="fusra" type="verb"><definition>x<sub>1</sub> entity rots or decays</definition><notes>
:'''lo fusra''' — rotting
:'''pa perli cu ba'o fusra''' — ''There is one pear and it is rotten.''
:Related words: '''birje''', '''vanju''', '''vifne'''</notes></valsi>
<valsi word="fuzme" type="verb"><definition>x<sub>1</sub> entity is responsible for x<sub>2</sub> event to authority x<sub>3</sub> entity</definition><notes>
:'''lo fuzme''' — responsible
:'''la alis pu jai se facki fai lo ka na fuzme lo zekri le kamni''' — ''Alice was found by the committee not responsible for the crime.''
:Related words: '''bilga'''</notes></valsi>
<valsi word="fy" type="pronoun"><definition>letter 'F'</definition>
<notes></notes></valsi><valsi word="ga" type="forethought conjunction (not for tanru)"><definition>''and/or''</definition>
<notes>Comment: shows that at least one of the constructs inside '''ga''' ... '''gi''' is true.
:'''ga mi citka gi mi kelci''' — ''I either eat or play, or do both.''
</notes></valsi><valsi word="ga'a" type="preposition from '''zgana'''"><definition>''to observer ...'', ''observed by ...''</definition>
<notes>Comment: not limited to vision.
:'''ca cerni ga'a mi''' — ''I can see it's morning now.''
</notes></valsi><valsi word="ga'i" type="interjection modifier/honorific"><definition>expressing hauteur, '''ga'icu'i''' — expressing equal rank, '''ga'inai''' — meekness (used with one of lower rank)</definition>
<notes>:'''do nitcu ma doi pikci ga'i''' — ''What do you need, you beggar?''
:'''mi ro do ga'icu'i tavla''' — ''I'm talking to you, my peers.''
:'''e'o doi turni ko sidju mi'a ga'inaisai''' — ''Please, governor, help us, worthless people.''
:Related words: '''gapru''', '''cnita'''
</notes></valsi><valsi word="ga'u" type="preposition"><definition>''above'', ''up from ...''</definition>
<notes>:'''pu bumru ga'u lo lalxu''' — ''There was mist over the river.''
</notes></valsi><valsi word="gacri" type="verb"><definition>x<sub>1</sub> entity is a lid for covering x<sub>2</sub> entity</definition><notes>
:'''lo gacri''' — lid, '''lo se gacri''' — something with a lid
:'''lo snime cu gacri lo dertu''' — ''Snow covers the ground.''
:Related words: '''pilka''', '''gapru''', '''marbi''', '''drudi''', '''botpi''', '''bitmu''', '''calku'''</notes></valsi>
<valsi word="gadri" type="verb"><definition>x<sub>1</sub> text is a sumti generating particle of class LE or LA labelling x<sub>2</sub> text</definition><notes>
Comment: '''lo''', '''le''', '''la''', '''loi''', '''lei''', '''lai''' are the most common gadri
:'''lo gadri''' — gadri (grammatical particle)
:'''zo le gadri lu nu dansu li'u''' — '''''le''' is a gadri.''
:Related words: '''valsi''', '''cmavo'''</notes></valsi>
<valsi word="gai" type="digit/number"><definition>hex digit C (decimal 12) [twelve]</definition>
<notes>:'''mi citka ti'u li fei''' — ''I eat at noon (12 o'clock).''
</notes></valsi><valsi word="galfi" type="verb"><definition>x<sub>1</sub> entity transforms, modifies, changes x<sub>2</sub> entity into x<sub>3</sub> entity</definition><notes>
Comment: '''binxo''' describes that entity turns into another entity, '''galfi''' describes how to change one entity into another one. '''cenba''' describes how entity changes its state while remaining the same entity, '''stika''' describes how to make entity change its state
:'''lo galfi''' — modifier, transformer
:'''le mamta pu galfi lo rectu ce lo nanba lo pluka snuji''' — ''Mother turned the meat and the bread into lovely sandwiches.''
:'''ju'o le ninmu ba galfi la kevin lo speni be vo'a''' — ''I'm ure she will make Kevin her spouse.''
:'''lo lenku brife pu galfi lo pezli lo bunre''' — ''The cold wind turned the leaves brown.''
:Related words: '''stika''', '''binxo''', '''cenba''', '''zasni'''</notes></valsi>
<valsi word="galtu" type="verb"><definition>x<sub>1</sub> entity is high in reference frame x<sub>2</sub> entity entity</definition><notes>
:'''lo galtu''' — high
:'''lo cipni cu galtu mi''' — ''The bird is high compared to me.''
:Related words: '''gapru''', '''dizlo''', '''cnita''', '''drudi''', '''farna'''</notes></valsi>
<valsi word="galxe" type="verb"><definition>x<sub>1</sub> entity is a throat of x<sub>2</sub> entity</definition><notes>
:'''lo galxe''' — throat
:'''da'i lo djacu cu xamgu lo galxe be do''' — ''Water would be fine for your throat.''
:Related words: '''cnebo''', '''kevna''', '''tunlo'''</notes></valsi>
<valsi word="ganlo" type="verb"><definition>portal  x<sub>1</sub> entity is closed, preventing access to place x<sub>2</sub> entity for object x<sub>3</sub> entity</definition><notes>
:'''lo ganlo''' — closed
:'''lo vorme cu ganlo lo nenri lo fange''' — ''The door is closed not letting the strangers in.''
:Related words: '''kalri''', '''pagre''', '''canko''', '''vorme''', '''zunti'''</notes></valsi>
<valsi word="ganra" type="verb"><definition>x<sub>1</sub> entity is broad or wide in length/width etc. x<sub>2</sub> property of x1</definition><notes>
Comment: The second largest dimension. '''ganra''', '''rotsu''' and '''clani''' specify the three dimensions of objects
:'''lo ganra''' — broad
:'''le tricu cu rotsu lo ka se midju''' — ''The tree is thick in the middle.''
:Related words: '''clani''', '''jarki''', '''rotsu''', '''condi''', '''barda''', '''gutci''', '''minli'''</notes></valsi>
<valsi word="ganse" type="verb"><definition>x<sub>1</sub> entity detects or senses x<sub>2</sub> entity by means x<sub>3</sub> property of x1</definition><notes>
:'''lo ganse''' — detector, '''lo se ganse''' — detected, '''lo te ganse''' — means of detection
:'''mi ganse lo nu ti cpina vau lo ka smaka ri''' — ''I sens it being irritating by tasting it.''
:Related words: '''pencu''', '''sanji''', '''viska''', '''sumne''', '''tirna''', '''zgana''', '''canci''', '''simlu'''</notes></valsi>
<valsi word="ganti" type="verb"><definition>x<sub>1</sub> entity is a gonad/ovary of x<sub>2</sub> entity of sex x<sub>3</sub> entity</definition><notes>
:'''lo ganti''' — gonad, '''lo te ganti''' — sex (biological)
:'''lo xanto cu se ganti lo barda lo nakni''' — ''Male elephants have large testicles.''
:Related words: '''plibu''', '''sovda''', '''pinji''', '''gutra''', '''mabla'''</notes></valsi>
<valsi word="ganxo" type="verb"><definition>x<sub>1</sub> entity is the anus of x<sub>2</sub> entity</definition><notes>
:'''lo ganxo''' — anus
:'''le mikce pu kucli tu'a lo nabmi pe lo ganxo be le nanmu''' — ''The doctor was curious about the problem with the anus of the man.''
:Related words: '''zargu''', '''kalci''', '''mabla''', '''rinci'''</notes></valsi>
<valsi word="ganzu" type="verb"><definition>x<sub>1</sub> entity organizes chaos x<sub>2</sub> entity into order x<sub>3</sub> entity by principle x<sub>4</sub> proposition</definition><notes>
:'''lo ganzu''' — organizer, '''lo se ganzu''' — chaotic, not organized, '''lo te ganzu''' — organized

<valsi word="gapci" type="verb"><definition>x<sub>1</sub> entity is a gas</definition><notes>

<valsi word="gasnu" type="verb"><definition>x<sub>1</sub> event causes x<sub>2</sub> event to happen</definition><notes>
:'''lo gasnu''' — agent

<valsi word="gasta" type="verb"><definition>x<sub>1</sub> entity is some steel</definition><notes>

<valsi word="gau" type="preposition from '''gasnu'''"><definition>''with active agent ...''</definition>

:'''ba gau mi do cliva''' — ''I will make you leave.''
:'''mi pu jai gau citka fai lo verba''' — ''I fed the child.''
</notes></valsi><valsi word="ge" type="forethought conjunction (not for tanru)"><definition>''and''</definition>
<notes>Comment: shows that both constructs inside '''ge''' ... '''gi''' are true.

<valsi word="gerna" type="verb"><definition>x<sub>1</sub> proposition is the grammar of language x<sub>2</sub> entity for structure x<sub>3</sub> text</definition><notes>

<valsi word="gi"><definition>separator of the two parts in the forethought connection</definition>

<valsi word="gy" type="pronoun"><definition>letter 'G'</definition>
<notes></notes></valsi><valsi word="i"><definition>separates sentences</definition>
<notes>:'''da vi fasnu i je lo nu da mo kau cu na klina''' — ''Something's happening here, and what it is isn't exactly clear.''
</notes></valsi><valsi word="i'a" type="interjection"><definition>''OK'' (acceptance), '''i'anai''' — blame</definition>
<notes>:'''i'a mi ba denpa''' — ''Okay, I will wait.''
:'''lo danfu i'a nai cu ei drata''' — ''No, the solution doesn't satisfy me, it should be different.''
:Related words: '''nalna'e''', '''nalpro''', '''no'epro''', '''nalzugjdi'''
</notes></valsi><valsi word="i'e" type="interjection"><definition>''Fine!'' (approval), '''i'ecu'i''' — non-approval, '''i'enai''' — ''Boo!'' (disapproval)</definition>
<notes>:'''i'e do pu gunka lo vajni''' — ''Very good!''
:'''i'ecu'i do pu tsuku ca lo se tcika''' — ''You did an important work.''
:'''i'enai do jai lerci''' — ''Well, okay, you arrived on time. Oy, you are late.''
:Related words: '''zanru'''
</notes></valsi><valsi word="i'i" type="interjection"><definition>togetherness, comradeship, '''i'inai''' — antagonistically</definition>
<notes>:'''i'i do badri doi pendo''' — ''You are sad, I know that feeling, bro.''
:'''i'inai mi zukte lo na me do moi''' — ''It's your problems, I'm not doing your work.''
:Related words: '''kansa''', '''gunma''', '''sivni''', '''sepli'''
</notes></valsi><valsi word="i'o" type="interjection"><definition>appreciation, '''i'onai''' — envy</definition>
<notes>:'''i'o do je'a pendo''' — ''Ah, you're a true friend.''
:'''i'o nai do ro roi se funca lo zabna''' — ''Mmm, you are always lucky.''
:Related words: '''ckire''', '''jilra'''
</notes></valsi><valsi word="i'u" type="interjection"><definition>familiarity, '''i'unai''' — unfamiliarity, mystery</definition>

:'''ti i'unai xotli''' — ''It's some hotel.''
:Related words: '''slabu''', '''nalni'o''', '''kufra'''
</notes></valsi><valsi word="ia" type="interjection"><definition>belief, '''iacu'i''' — ''allegedly'' (skepticism), '''ianai''' — ''Pshaw!'' (disbelief)</definition>
<notes>:'''ia drani''' — ''I believe that's correct.''

:'''ianai le prenu cu stace mi''' — ''I don't believe, he is frank with me.''
:Related words: '''krici''', '''jinvi'''
</notes></valsi><valsi word="ibu" type="pronoun"><definition>letter 'I'</definition>
<notes></notes></valsi><valsi word="ie" type="interjection"><definition>''Yeah! Aye!'' (agreement), '''ienai''' — disagreement</definition>
<notes>:'''ie la kevin ka'e pu zvati ti''' — ''Yes, Alice could be here.''

</notes></valsi><valsi word="ii" type="interjection"><definition>''Eek! Yikes!'' (fear), '''iinai''' — safeness</definition>

</notes></valsi><valsi word="incipe" type="verb"><definition>x<sub>1</sub> event is the beginning/the initial stage/starting/inchoate/coming into existence/first part of x<sub>2</sub> event</definition><notes>

<notes>:'''mi ja'a jimpe''' — ''I do understand.''
</notes></valsi><valsi word="ja'ai" type="interjection"><definition>1. affirms attitude. Used as a modifier of interjection 2. affirms prepositions, pronouns, clauses, verb words 3. placed after a connective affirms the part after that connective</definition>
<notes>Comment: affirmative/negation pairs are '''ja'ai'''/'''nai''', '''ja'a'''/'''na''', '''je'a'''/'''na'e''', '''jo'a'''/'''na'i'''.
:'''ui ja'ai''' — ''Yay indeed!''

</notes></valsi><valsi word="ja'o" type="evidential"><definition>''I conclude''</definition>
<notes>:'''ja'o do merko''' — ''Then, you must be an American.''

<valsi word="jai" type="1st meaning"><definition>Splits a clause into some noun + ''''cu''' '''jai'''' and ''''fai''' '''lo''' '''ka''''+the rest of the clause</definition>

</notes></valsi><valsi word="jai " type="2nd meaning"><definition>Some noun + ''''jai'''' + some preposition take the first place of the main verb. The old first place can be expressed with the case marker '''fai'''</definition>

</notes></valsi><valsi word="je'ai"><definition>asks which particle fits the place where '''je'ai''' is put: '''je'a''', '''na'e''', '''no'e''', '''to'e'''</definition>
<notes>:'''- do je'ai nelci lo gerku - to'e''' — ''- You like/dislike dogs? - I hate them.''
</notes></valsi><valsi word="je'e" type="vocative"><definition>''roger, I got your message, you are welcome (in reply to thanks)'', '''je'enai''' — ''I didn't get your message''</definition>
<notes>Comment: '''fi'i''' is 'you are welcome' for expressing hospitality.
:'''ki'e do - je'e do''' — ''Thank you! - You are welcome!''
</notes></valsi><valsi word="je'i" type="conjunction"><definition>question</definition>
<notes>Comment: in modern Lojban '''ji''' is used instead of '''je'i'''.
:'''do ba'o je'i pu'o citka''' — ''Have you eaten yet or are you only about to eat?''
</notes></valsi><valsi word="je'u" type="discursive"><definition>''truly, yes'', '''je'unai''' — ''no'' (false)</definition>
<notes>:'''je'u do stati prenu''' — ''Truly you are a smart person.''
:'''lo je'unai purdi cu se ponse lo za'u cizra prenu''' — ''This "garden" (which is in fact not a garden) is owed by some weird people.''
:'''xu do kansa mi'a - je'unai''' — ''Are you with us? - No.''
:Related words: '''jetnu'''
</notes></valsi><valsi word="jecta" type="verb"><definition>x<sub>1</sub> entity is a polity or state governing x<sub>2</sub> entity</definition><notes>
:'''lo jecta''' — polity, state
:'''lo nu claxu loi pa turni cu jecta lo vi tutra''' — ''Not having a single government is the political system of this area.''

<valsi word="jeftu" type="verb"><definition>x<sub>1</sub> event is x<sub>2</sub> number weeks long</definition><notes>

<valsi word="jivna" type="verb"><definition>x<sub>1</sub> entity competes with competitors x<sub>2</sub> entity in contest x<sub>3</sub> event for the reward x<sub>4</sub> entity</definition><notes>
:'''lo jivna''' — competitor, '''lo se jivna''' — opponent in a competition, '''lo te jivna''' — competition, '''lo ve jivna''' — prize in a competition
:'''la alis pu jivna lo drata nixli lo nu vi'i ve'u bajra vau lo ka cpacu lo jdini''' — ''Alice competed with other girls in a long distance race with a monetary prize for the winner.''
:Related words: '''cnemu''', '''jinga''', '''talsa''', '''bradi''', '''fapro''', '''kelci'''</notes></valsi>
<valsi word="jmaji" type="verb"><definition>x<sub>1</sub> plural of entity gather at location x<sub>2</sub> entity from locations x<sub>3</sub> plural of entity</definition><notes>
:'''lo jmaji''' — gatherers, '''lo se jmaji''' — location of gathering
:'''lo jbopre pu jmaji lo dinju lo vrici gugde''' — ''Lojbanists gathered.''
:Related words: '''crepu'''</notes></valsi>
<valsi word="jmifa" type="verb"><definition>x<sub>1</sub> entity is a shoal or reef</definition><notes>
:'''lo jmifa''' — shoal
:'''pu zdile fa lo ka limna ne'a loi jmifa''' — ''It was amusing to swim near the reefs.''
:Related words: '''caxno'''</notes></valsi>
<valsi word="jmina" type="verb"><definition>x<sub>1</sub> entity combines or adds x<sub>2</sub> entity, property of x3 to x<sub>3</sub> entity with result x<sub>4</sub> entity, property of x3</definition><notes>
:'''lo sfofa cu jmina lo ka se kufra kei lo kumfa''' — ''The sofa adds comfort to the room.''
:Related words: '''zmadu''', '''banro''', '''sumji''', '''zenba''', '''setca'''</notes></valsi>
<valsi word="jmive" type="verb"><definition>x<sub>1</sub> entity is alive in that it does x<sub>2</sub> property of x1</definition><notes>
:'''lo jmive''' — alive
:'''le danlu cu jmive lo ka ruble muvdu''' — ''The animal is alive since it is weakly moving.''
:Related words: '''lifri''', '''morsi''', '''stuzi''', '''zvati''', '''xabju'''</notes></valsi>
<valsi word="jo" type="conjunction"><definition>''if and only if''</definition>
<notes>:'''ai mi te vecnu lo kargu jo cnino karce''' — ''I'm going to buy an expensive car if and only if it is new.''
</notes></valsi><valsi word="jo'a" type="discursive"><definition>the clause can make sense in meaning (metalinguistic affirmer)</definition>
<notes>Comment: '''na'i''' is metalinguistic negation.
:'''xu le prenu noi sanli vi lo va dinju cu ninmu - jo'a''' — ''Is the person standing near that building a woman? - The sentence is formed correctly (there is a person standing near the building, the question of whether it's a woman is applicable).''
:Related words: '''drani'''
</notes></valsi><valsi word="jo'e" type="conjunction"><definition>forms union of sets</definition>
<notes>:'''e'o doi io lo ninmu jo'e lo ctuca ko cliva le kumfa''' — ''Respected women and teachers, please, leave the room.''
</notes></valsi><valsi word="jo'u" type="conjunction"><definition>in common with...'', ''along with...'', ''and also ...' (forms unmixed set)</definition>
<notes>Comment: '''ce''' is preferred to '''jo'u'''.
:'''You and I discussed languages together''' — ''do jo'u mi casnu lo za'u bangu.''
</notes></valsi><valsi word="joi" type="conjunction"><definition>''mixed together with...'', ''forming a mass...'' (forms mixed mass)</definition>
<notes>:'''ti du lo sovda joi lo purmo''' — ''This is a mass of eggs and flour.''
</notes></valsi><valsi word="jonai" type="conjunction"><definition>''either ... or ...''</definition>
<notes>:'''mi tavla ijonai do tavla''' — ''Either I talk or you talk.''
</notes></valsi><valsi word="jorne" type="verb"><definition>x<sub>1</sub> entity is joined to x<sub>2</sub> entity at location x<sub>3</sub> entity</definition><notes>
Comment: x1 and x2 are a union
:'''la alis cu jorne lo stizu lo skori''' — ''Alice it tied to the chair with a rope.''
:'''ko jorne la'e me'o sopapa''' — ''Call 911 !''
:'''mi ba jorne do ba lo nu mi cliva lo ckule''' — ''I will .''
:Related words: '''lasna''', '''fenso''', '''kansa''', '''pencu''', '''penmi'''</notes></valsi>
<valsi word="ju" type="conjunction"><definition>''whether or not''</definition>
<notes>:'''ei zukte iju le nanmu cu klama''' — ''Let's do it whether or not he comes.''
</notes></valsi><valsi word="ju'a" type="evidential"><definition>''I state'' (non-specified source of information)</definition>
<notes>:'''ju'a ro da cu se senpi ei''' — ''Everything should be doubted, I say.''
:Related words: '''xusra'''
</notes></valsi><valsi word="ju'e" type="conjunction"><definition>forms two independent sentences</definition>
<notes>Comment: '''mi ju'e do klama''' means the same as '''mi klama .i do klama'''.
:'''I discuss languages You discuss languages''' — ''mi ju'e do casnu lo za'u bangu.''
</notes></valsi><valsi word="ju'i" type="vocative"><definition>''Hey! Ahem! Attention!'', '''ju'nai''' — ''At ease!'', '''je'nai''' — ''Ignore me! Nevermind!''</definition>
<notes>:'''ju'i lo nixli ma cmene do''' — ''Hey, girl, what is your name?''
:'''ju'i cu'i sonci''' — ''At ease, soldiers.''
:'''mi co'a si'unai jimpe ju'inai''' — ''I understood myself, nevermind.''
</notes></valsi><valsi word="ju'o" type="interjection modifier"><definition>certainty, '''ju'ocu'i''' — uncertainty, '''ju'onai''' — impossibility</definition>
<notes>:'''ju'o do pu pensi da''' — ''You must have thought of something.''
:'''banli ju'ocu'i''' — ''Maybe it's great, I'm not sure.''
:'''ju'onai xu lo tai valsi cu se pilno''' — ''Are such words used, I'm sure they are not!''
:Related words: '''birti''', '''cumki'''
</notes></valsi><valsi word="jubme" type="verb"><definition>x<sub>1</sub> entity is a table</definition><notes>
:'''lo jubme''' — table
:'''xu da kunti jubme''' — ''Is there a free table?''
:Related words: '''ckana''', '''jamfu''', '''nilce''', '''zbepi''', '''tsina''', '''stizu'''</notes></valsi>
<valsi word="judri" type="verb"><definition>x<sub>1</sub> entity is an address of x<sub>2</sub> entity in system x<sub>3</sub> entity</definition><notes>
:'''lo judri''' — address, '''lo te judri''' — address system
:'''ma judri do lo tcadu''' — ''What is your address?''
:'''ma judri do lo kibro ve mrilu''' — ''What is your e-mail address?''
:Related words: '''tcita''', '''cmene''', '''ciste''', '''stuzi'''</notes></valsi>
<valsi word="jufra" type="verb"><definition>x<sub>1</sub> text is a sentence or statement about x<sub>2</sub> entity in language x<sub>3</sub> entity</definition><notes>
:'''lo jufra''' — sentence, '''lo se jufra''' — topic of a sentence, '''lo te jufra''' — language of a sentence
:'''lu i lo mlatu ci pinxe li'u jufra lo danlu la lojban''' — '''''i lo mlatu cu pinxe''' is a sentence about animals in Lojban language.''
:Related words: '''valsi''', '''bangu''', '''gerna''', '''cusku''', '''smuni'''</notes></valsi>
<valsi word="jukpa" type="verb"><definition>x<sub>1</sub> entity cooks or prepares food x<sub>2</sub> entity by recipe x<sub>3</sub> property of x1</definition><notes>
:'''lo jukpa''' — cook, '''lo se jukpa''' — cooked food, '''lo te jukpa''' — recipe for cooking
:'''le mamta pu jukpa le torta lo ka punji ri lo toknu''' — ''Mother cooked the cacke by putting it in the oven.''
:Related words: '''cupra''', '''bredi'''</notes></valsi>
<valsi word="julne" type="verb"><definition>x<sub>1</sub> entity is a filter passing x<sub>2</sub> entity and prohibiting x<sub>3</sub> entity</definition><notes>
:'''lo julne''' — filter
:'''ti julne fi lo finpe''' — ''This is a fishing net.''
:'''tu julne lo djacu lo rismi''' — ''That is a colander that lets the water pass and retains rice.''
:Related words: '''komcu''', '''ciste''', '''jgena'''</notes></valsi>
<valsi word="jundi" type="verb"><definition>x<sub>1</sub> entity pays attention to x<sub>2</sub> entity</definition><notes>
:'''lo jundi''' — attentive, '''lo se jundi''' — object of attention
:'''mi pu jindu lo nu ra pu cusku makau''' — ''I was attentive at was he was saying.''
:Related words: '''kurji''', '''zvati'''</notes></valsi>
<valsi word="jungo" type="verb"><definition>x<sub>1</sub> entity is Chinese in x<sub>2</sub> property of x1</definition><notes>
:'''lo jungo''' — Chinese
:'''le fetsi cu jungo lo ka tcila be lo flira be ce'u''' — ''The girl is Chinese in her face features.''
:Related words: '''xazdo'''</notes></valsi>
<valsi word="junla" type="verb"><definition>x<sub>1</sub> entity is a timer or clock measuring time units x<sub>2</sub> entity</definition><notes>
Comment: x2 can be show the precision to which time units are measured
:'''lo junla''' — timer, '''lo se junla''' — unit of time
:'''ti junla lo snidu be li pi mu''' — ''This clock measures seconds to the precision of 0.5 seconds.''
:Related words: '''cacra''', '''mentu''', '''snidu''', '''tcika''', '''temci'''</notes></valsi>
<valsi word="junpero" type="verb"><definition>x<sub>1</sub> entity is a juniper/cedar of species/variety x<sub>2</sub> taxon</definition><notes>
Comment: ???Some trees called cedar are actually juniper. See '''ricrcedro''', '''ckunu'''
:'''mi pu jmina lo jimca be lo junpero lo fagri''' — ''I added juniper twigs to the fire.''
:Related words: '''spati''', '''tricu'''</notes></valsi>
<valsi word="junri" type="verb"><definition>x<sub>1</sub> entity is earnest or serious about x<sub>2</sub> property of x1</definition><notes>
:'''lo junri''' — someone serious
:'''xu do junri lo ka te mukti lo ka cliva lo bu'u gugde''' — ''Are you serious in your intent to leave this country.''
:Related words: '''tilju''', '''xalbo''', '''badri''', '''ritli'''</notes></valsi>
<valsi word="junta" type="verb"><definition>x<sub>1</sub> entity is the weight of x<sub>2</sub> plural of entity in field x<sub>3</sub></definition><notes>
:'''lo junta''' — weight
:'''lo kensa gunka cu se junta lo ki'ogra be li panono lo terdi''' — ''The space worker weights 100 kilograms in the gravity of the Earth.''
:Related words: '''grake''', '''linto''', '''tilju''', '''bunda'''</notes></valsi>
<valsi word="jurme" type="verb"><definition>x<sub>1</sub> entity is a bacteria or germ of species x<sub>2</sub> taxon</definition><notes>
:'''lo jurme''' — bacteria
:'''le lanli pu pilno lo jurme lo cipra''' — ''The researcher used bacteria for tests.''
:Related words: '''vidru'''</notes></valsi>
<valsi word="jursa" type="verb"><definition>x<sub>1</sub> property of x2 is harsh or severe to x<sub>2</sub> entity</definition><notes>
:'''lo jursa''' — harsh event
:'''lo ka jivna pu jursa mi''' — ''Competition was fierce for me.''
:Related words: '''gunta''', '''vlile'''</notes></valsi>
<valsi word="jutsi" type="verb"><definition>x<sub>1</sub> entity is a taxon of super-taxon x<sub>2</sub>; x1 is a species of genus x2 , family x3 , etc.</definition><notes>
Comment: This verb potentially has infinite number of places.
:'''lo jutsi''' — taxon, species
:'''mi zgana lo cinki poi jutsi ro da''' — ''I watch insects of all kinds.''
:Related words: '''klesi''', '''lanzu'''</notes></valsi>
<valsi word="juxre" type="verb"><definition>x<sub>1</sub> entity is clumsy in doing x<sub>2</sub> property of x2</definition><notes>
:'''lo juxre''' — clumsy
:'''mi pu ca'o juxre lo ka muvdu''' — ''I was getting clumsy in my movements.''
:'''le fonxa pu juxre lo ka se pilno''' — ''The phone was clumsy to use.''
:Related words: '''sluji''', '''muvdu'''</notes></valsi>
<valsi word="jvinu" type="verb"><definition>x<sub>1</sub> entity is a view of x<sub>2</sub> entity from viewpoint x<sub>3</sub> entity</definition><notes>
:'''lo jvinu''' — view, '''lo te jvinu''' — viewpoint
:'''lo jvinu be lo xamsi bei lo mi kumfa cu banli''' — ''I have a great view of the sea from my room.''
:Related words: '''catlu''', '''kanla''', '''viska''', '''canko''', '''jarco'''</notes></valsi>
<valsi word="jy" type="pronoun"><definition>letter 'J'</definition>
<notes></notes></valsi><valsi word="ka" type="clause prefix"><definition>clause > infinitive</definition>
<notes>Comment: x1 is the property of the clause that follows. Has at least one '''ce'u''' inside referring to a noun of the outer clause. '''ka''' without a '''ce'u''' inside is the same as '''ka ce'u'''. Used to express infinitives.
:'''mi djica lo ka sipna''' — ''I want to sleep.''
:'''la alis cu nitcu lo ka te dunda lo birje''' — ''Alice needs to be given beer.''
:'''ta'i ku do ba cirko lo ka sinma ce'u''' — ''This way you will lose the respect.''
:'''lo pa tadji be lo ka se pendo cu ka pendo''' — ''The only way to have a friend is to be a friend.''
</notes></valsi><valsi word="ka'ai" type="preposition from '''kansa'''"><definition>''with ...'', ''with a companion ...''</definition>
<notes>:'''mi cadzu ka'ai lo gerku''' — ''I walk with a dog.''
</notes></valsi><valsi word="ka'e" type="preposition"><definition>''possibly can...''</definition>
<notes>Comment: not necessarily innately capable, might describe what can potentially happen to the thing described.
:'''mi na ka'e denpa''' — ''I can't wait.''
</notes></valsi><valsi word="ka'o" type="digit/number"><definition>imaginary i; square root of -1</definition>
<notes>:'''li te'o te'a ka'o bi'e pi'i pai su'i pa du li no''' — ''e<sup>(i * π)</sup> +1 = 0.''
</notes></valsi><valsi word="ka'u" type="evidential"><definition>''I know by cultural means'' (myth, custom)</definition>
<notes>:'''ka'u so'a prenu cu xebni da''' — ''We know, that most people hate soemthing.''
:Related words: '''kluju'o'''
</notes></valsi><valsi word="kabri" type="verb"><definition>x<sub>1</sub> entity is a cup or mug containing x<sub>2</sub> entity</definition><notes>
Comment: A '''kabri''' is normally eaten from by lifting it, a '''palta''' is not.
:'''lo kabri''' — cup, '''lo se kabri''' — content of a cup
:'''e'o do dunda lo kabri be lo ckafi mi''' — ''Please, give me a cup of coffee.''
:Related words: '''palta''', '''citka''', '''blaci''', '''tansi'''</notes></valsi>
<valsi word="kabu"><definition>refers to the last '''ka'''-clause used</definition>
<notes>:'''mi je'a djica lo ka tadni i ku'i kabu nandu mi''' — ''I do want to study.''
</notes></valsi><valsi word="kacma" type="verb"><definition>x<sub>1</sub> entity is a camera recording images of illumination type x<sub>2</sub> entity to medium x<sub>3</sub> entity</definition><notes>
:'''lo kacma''' — camera
:'''ti kacma lo tcadu lo datni centero''' — ''This is a camera recording images of the city to the data center.''
:Related words: '''lenjo'''</notes></valsi>
<valsi word="kafke" type="verb"><definition>x<sub>1</sub> entity coughs, farts, burps x<sub>2</sub> entity from orifice x<sub>3</sub> entity</definition><notes>
:'''ra pu kafke lo barda lo ganxo''' — ''He made a big fart.''
:Related words: '''bilma''', '''senci''', '''sputu''', '''vamtu'''</notes></valsi>
<valsi word="kagni" type="verb"><definition>x<sub>1</sub> entity is a company / corporation chartered by authority x<sub>2</sub> entity for purpose x<sub>3</sub> property of x1</definition><notes>
:'''lo kagni''' — company, corporation
:'''lo kagni be lo jbopre bei lo nu kakpa lo ctile pu tolcri lo ctile lo loldi be lo xamsi''' — ''The Lojbanists' chartered oil drilling company discovered oil at the bed of the sea.''
:Related words: '''kansa''', '''kamni''', '''banxa''', '''bende'''</notes></valsi>
<valsi word="kai" type="preposition from '''ckaji'''"><definition>''characterizing ...''</definition>
<notes>Comment: subject case tag.
:'''kai je fa mi pu jitro''' — ''I was in control.''
</notes></valsi><valsi word="kajde" type="verb"><definition>x<sub>1</sub> entity warns x<sub>2</sub> entity of danger x<sub>3</sub> event</definition><notes>
:'''loi rirni pu kajde mi'a lo ba vlile tcima''' — ''Parents warned us about heavy weather.''
:Related words: '''ckape''', '''nupre''', '''snura''', '''tcica''', '''xlura'''</notes></valsi>
<valsi word="kajna" type="verb"><definition>x<sub>1</sub> entity is a shelf or counter on x<sub>2</sub> entity</definition><notes>
:'''lo kajna''' — shelf
:'''mi pu punji le pelji lo kajna be lo fagri stuzi''' — ''I put the paper on the .''
:Related words: '''balni'''</notes></valsi>
<valsi word="kakne" type="verb"><definition>x<sub>1</sub> entity is capable of doing x<sub>2</sub> property of x1</definition><notes>
Comment: for e.g. "I can't wait" '''ka'e''' is more appropriate. '''kakne''' is about ability.
:'''lo kakne''' — capable
:'''mi na kakne lo ka sipna''' — ''I can't sleep.''
:Related words: '''stati''', '''certu''', '''gasnu''', '''ka'e''', '''nu'o''', '''pu'i''', '''djuno''', '''zifre'''</notes></valsi>
<valsi word="kakpa" type="verb"><definition>x<sub>1</sub> entity digs x<sub>2</sub> entity out of x<sub>3</sub> entity</definition><notes>
:'''lo kakpa''' — digger
:'''la tom pu jai se bapli fai lo ka kakpa lo karce lo snime''' — ''Tom had to dig his car out of the snow.''
:Related words: '''katna''', '''plixa''', '''sraku''', '''canpa''', '''sraku'''</notes></valsi>
<valsi word="kalci" type="verb"><definition>x<sub>1</sub> entity is excrement or feces of x<sub>2</sub> entity</definition><notes>
:'''lo kalci''' — excrement
:'''lo kalci be lo bakni cu jai rinka lo nu lo dertu cu ferti''' — ''Cow dung makes soil fertile.''
:Related words: '''ganxo''', '''pinca''', '''vikmi''', '''mabla''', '''festi'''</notes></valsi>
<valsi word="kalri" type="verb"><definition>x<sub>1</sub> entity is open, giving access to place x<sub>2</sub> entity for object x<sub>3</sub> entity</definition><notes>
Comment: For 'oepn something' use '''jai''' '''gau''' '''kalri''' '''fai'''
:'''lo kalri''' — open
:'''lo canko cu kalri lo nenri lo vifne vacri''' — ''The window is open letting the fresh air in.''
:'''gau ko kalri fa lo canko''' — ''Open the window. Open the window.''
:Related words: '''ganlo''', '''pagre''', '''canko''', '''vorme'''</notes></valsi>
<valsi word="kalsa" type="verb"><definition>x<sub>1</sub> entity is a chaos, chaotic in x<sub>2</sub> property of x1</definition><notes>
:'''lo kalsa''' — chaos, chaotic
:'''lo mi kumfa cu kalsa lo ka bu'u ce'u lo mi bukpu cu zvati makau''' — ''My room is a mess (in where are my clothes).''
:Related words: '''cunso''', '''cnici'''</notes></valsi>
<valsi word="kalte" type="verb"><definition>x<sub>1</sub> entity hunts prey x<sub>2</sub> entity for purpose x<sub>3</sub> property of x1</definition><notes>
:'''lo kalte''' — hunter, '''lo se kalte''' — prey
:'''lei certu pu kalte lo finpe lo ka lanli ri''' — ''The researches were hunting fihes to study them.''
:Related words: '''jersi''', '''kavbu''', '''sisku''', '''rivbi'''</notes></valsi>
<valsi word="kamju" type="verb"><definition>x<sub>1</sub> entity is a column</definition><notes>
:'''lo kamju''' — pillar
:'''le pa kamju cu sarji lo korbi be lo drudi''' — ''The column supports the edge of the roof.''
:Related words: '''ckana''', '''garna''', '''sanli''', '''slanu'''</notes></valsi>
<valsi word="kamni" type="verb"><definition>x<sub>1</sub> entity is a committee with task x<sub>2</sub> property of x1</definition><notes>
:'''lo kamni''' — committee, '''lo se kamni''' — purpose of a committee
:'''lo kamni be lo ka jai gau farvi le bangu cu gunma za'u pano prenu''' — ''There are more than 10 members in the committee for developing the language.''
:Related words: '''bende''', '''kagni'''</notes></valsi>
<valsi word="kampu" type="verb"><definition>x<sub>1</sub> property of x2 is universal among x<sub>2</sub> entity</definition><notes>
:'''lo kampu''' — common, general, universal, '''lo se kampu''' — group with something in common
:'''da zo'u lo ka dasni da cu kampu ro lo tadni''' — ''Wearing the same uniform is common for every student.''
:Related words: '''fadni''', '''zilfadni''', '''cafne''', '''rirci''', '''fadni''', '''cnano''', '''tcaci''', '''lakne''', '''cmima''', '''simxu'''</notes></valsi>
<valsi word="kanba" type="verb"><definition>x<sub>1</sub> entity is a goat of species x<sub>2</sub> taxon</definition><notes>
:'''lo kanba''' — goat
:'''lo cirla cu se zbasu fi lo ladru be lo kanba''' — ''The cheese is made from goat's milk.''
:Related words: '''lanme''', '''sunla'''</notes></valsi>
<valsi word="kancu" type="verb"><definition>x<sub>1</sub> entity counts the number in x<sub>2</sub> entity to be x<sub>3</sub> number by units x<sub>4</sub> property of x2</definition><notes>
:'''mi kancu lo prenu li pa re lo ka re mei''' — ''I counted the people as 12 couples.''
:Related words: '''kanji''', '''satci''', '''merli'''</notes></valsi>
<valsi word="kandi" type="verb"><definition>x<sub>1</sub> entity is dim, non-intense in x<sub>2</sub> property of x1 received by observer x<sub>3</sub> entity</definition><notes>
:'''lo kandi''' — dim, non-intense
:'''fi mi fa le valsi cu kandi lo ka se smuni''' — ''To me the word is dim in meaning.''
:Related words: '''blabi''', '''carmi''', '''klina''', '''linto''', '''manku''', '''cermurse''', '''vacmurse''', '''ruble''', '''skari''', '''milxe''', '''blanu''', '''bunre''', '''cicna''', '''crino''', '''grusi''', '''narju''', '''nukni''', '''pelxu''', '''xekri''', '''xunre''', '''zirpu'''</notes></valsi>
<valsi word="kanla" type="verb"><definition>x<sub>1</sub> entity is an eye of x<sub>2</sub> entity</definition><notes>
:'''lo kanla''' — eye
:'''la alis cu se kanla lo barda je melbi''' — ''Alice has big beautiful eyes.''
:Related words: '''jvinu''', '''kerlo''', '''viska''', '''kumte'''</notes></valsi>
<valsi word="kanpe" type="verb"><definition>x<sub>1</sub> entity expects x<sub>2</sub> event with likelihood x<sub>3</sub> number: from 0 to 1, by default '''li''' '''so'a''', i.e. near 1</definition><notes>
Comment: expecting' here may imply even undesriable events that are nevertheless expected to occur.
:'''fi li so'u fa mi pu kanpe lo nu do clira volve''' — ''I didn't expect you to return early.''
:Related words: '''djica''', '''pacna''', '''lakne''', '''cunso''', '''fau''', '''da'i'''</notes></valsi>
<valsi word="kanro" type="verb"><definition>x<sub>1</sub> entity is healthy or well in x<sub>2</sub> property of x1</definition><notes>
:'''lo kanro''' — healthy
:'''mi kanro lo ka cortu lo galxe''' — ''I'm healthy in that my throat doesn't ache.''
:Related words: '''bilma''', '''mikce'''</notes></valsi>
<valsi word="kansa" type="verb"><definition>x<sub>1</sub> entity accompanies x<sub>2</sub> entity in state x<sub>3</sub> event</definition><notes>
:'''le mi gerku fe'eroroi kansa mi''' — ''My dog is everywhere with me.''
:'''ro roi pu pluka fa lo nu kansa do lo ka gunka''' — ''It was pleasant to work with you.''
:Related words: '''kagni''', '''jorne''', '''gunma''', '''girzu''', '''lasna'''</notes></valsi>
<valsi word="kantu" type="verb"><definition>x<sub>1</sub> entity is a quantum of x<sub>2</sub> property of x1</definition><notes>
Comment: '''selci''' is for masses and most objects
:'''lo kantu''' — quantum
:'''mi pu xaksu re kantu be lo cacra fau lo ka denpa tu'a do''' — ''I wasted two hours waiting for you.''
:'''ti du re lo kantu be lo makfa''' — ''Here are two pieces of magic.''
:Related words: '''selci''', '''ratni''', '''gradu''', '''gusni''', '''nejni''', '''linji'''</notes></valsi>
<valsi word="karce" type="verb"><definition>x<sub>1</sub> entity is a car, truck, van for carrying x<sub>2</sub> entity</definition><notes>
:'''lo karce''' — car, truck, van, '''lo se karce''' — cargo of a car
:'''ti karce lo festi''' — ''It's a trash truck.''

<notes></notes></valsi><valsi word="la"><definition>verb > name (sumti)</definition>
<notes>Comment: ''the one that is called ...'' Creates personal name from verbs or cmevla.
:'''la alis ba vitke la paris''' — ''Alice will visit Paris.''
:'''zo bruna cmene la kevin lo mi pendo''' — ''Brother is how friends call Kevin.''
</notes></valsi><valsi word="la'a" type="discursive"><definition>''probably'', '''la'acu'i''' — ''possibly, may be'', '''la'anai''' — ''improbably''</definition>
<notes>:'''la'a ti traji lo ka misno''' — ''Probably, this is the most popular one.''
:'''la'aru'e ve ciksi''' — ''Probably, it's an expanation.''
:'''la'acu'i le nakni cu zukte seva'u le fetsi''' — ''May be, he is doing it for her.''
:'''la'anai la kevin ka'e jai gau birti fai la alis''' — ''It's improbable that Kevin can convince Alice.''
:Related words: '''lakne'''
</notes></valsi><valsi word="la'e"><definition>''what can be referred to by ...'' (noun follows)</definition>
<notes>Comment: '''la'e''' [noun]' is the same as ''''lo''' '''se''' '''sinxa''' '''be''' [noun]'.
:ends with: '''lu'u'''
:'''do ce mi casnu da''' — ''The was something you and I discussed.''
:'''la'edi'u pu cacra li ji'i pa''' — ''And that lasted for approximately an hour.''
:'''la'e zo alis cu cinri cukta''' — ''Alice is an interesting book.''
</notes></valsi><valsi word="la'o"><definition>foreign text > noun that is a name</definition>
<notes>Comment: quotes a text that can be not Lojbanic. The quotation is to be wrapped with pauses from both sides and with an additional Lojbanic word around them from both sides. Usually the separating words is the name of the first letter of the language of the quotation.
:'''la'o gy The wild bears gy jai cinri filme''' — ''The wild bears is an interesting movie.''
:Related words: '''zo'oi''', '''zoi''', '''la'o''', '''la'oi''', '''zo''', '''lu''' ... '''li'u''', '''lo'e''', '''lo'u''', '''me'oi'''
</notes></valsi><valsi word="la'oi"><definition>foreign word > noun that is a name</definition>
<notes>Comment: '''la'oi''' and one single word after it make a name. The word after '''la'oi''': might be from any language and written in any script, it is delimited by pauses (in speech) or whitespaces (in writing) from both sides, it can't have pauses inside if pronounced, nor dots when written. For names  with pauses inside use '''la'o'''.
:'''xu do se zdani la'oi Virginia''' — ''Do you live in Virginia?''
:Related words: '''zo'oi''', '''zoi''', '''la'o''', '''la'oi''', '''zo''', '''lu''' ... '''li'u''', '''lo'e''', '''lo'u''', '''me'oi'''
</notes></valsi><valsi word="labno" type="verb"><definition>x<sub>1</sub> entity is a wolf of species x<sub>2</sub> taxon</definition><notes>

:'''lo latna co'a me lo flora poi se panci lo pluka''' — ''The lotus turns into a flower with a pleasant scent.''
