<valsi word="lazni" type="verb"><definition>x<sub>1</sub> entity is lazy concerning action x<sub>2</sub> property of x1</definition><notes>
:'''lo lazni''' — lazy, '''lo se lazni''' — action lazily avoided
:'''mi lazni lo ka catlu lo matra''' — ''I am lazy to look at the engine.''
:Related words: '''nejni''', '''vreta''', '''gunka'''</notes></valsi>
<valsi word="le"><definition>verb > noun previously mentioned</definition>
<notes>Comment: ''the'', creates pronoun like ''she'', ''he'' from noun. '''le fetsi''' is 'she', '''le nakni''' is 'he', '''le''' '''za'umei''' is 'they'.
:'''mi pu viska lo fetsi''' — ''I saw a female.''
:'''le fetsi cu melbi''' — ''She is pretty.''
</notes></valsi><valsi word="le'ai" type="terminator"><notes>:starts with: '''lo'ai'''
</notes></valsi><valsi word="le'e"><definition>verb > noun denoting a typical thing previously mentioned</definition>
<notes>Comment: ''the typical one that does or is ...'' (previously defined).
:'''lo'e cipni cu kakne lo ka vofli i mi tadni le'e cipni''' — ''Typical birds can fly. And I study such birds.''
:Related words: '''le''', '''lo''', '''lo'e'''
</notes></valsi><valsi word="le'o" type="interjection modifier"><definition>''Grr!'' (aggression), '''le'ocu'i''' — expressing passive (non-agressive) emotion, '''le'onai''' — expressing defensive emotion</definition>
<notes>:'''le'o ro ko tinbe fi mi''' — ''Everybody follow my orders!''
:'''le'ocu'i sa'u mi pu retsku zo'ei lo ni do kanro''' — ''Hey, I just asked you about your health.''
:'''le'onai mi jimpe lo du'u ei mi zutse ti''' — ''Okay, okay, I understand that I have to sit here.''
:Related words: '''gunta''', '''bandu'''
</notes></valsi><valsi word="le'u" type="terminator"><notes>:starts with: '''LOhU'''
</notes></valsi><valsi word="lebna" type="verb"><definition>x<sub>1</sub> entity takes or seizes x<sub>2</sub> entity, property of x3 from x<sub>3</sub> entity</definition><notes>
Comment: in '''cpacu''' volition or previous possession is not necessarily implied, '''vimcu''' is for alienation where x1 need not gain possession, '''lo se lebna''' — something taken
:'''le za'umei pu lebna fi mi fe lo ka se krali lo ka ponse le karce''' — ''They took my rights on owning the car.''
:'''mi pu lebna lo titla le tanxe ca lo nu lo drata na jundi''' — ''I took a candie from the box when other weren't attentive.''
:Related words: '''punji''', '''cpacu''', '''vimcu''', '''canci''', '''cliva'''</notes></valsi>
<valsi word="lei"><definition>verb > noun denoting a mass previously mentioned</definition>
<notes>Comment: ''the ...'', ''the mass of those that are ...'' (previously mentioned).
:'''mi pu zgana loi prenu je ba co'a sanli ibabo mi pu muvdu fa'a lei prenu''' — ''I noticed a crowd and stood up. After that I moved into the direction of the crowd.''
</notes></valsi><valsi word="lektoni" type="verb"><definition>x<sub>1</sub> is an electron</definition><notes>
Comment: ???remove?
:'''lo lektoni''' — electron
:'''lo lektoni cu kantu''' — ''Electron is an elementary particle.''
:Related words: '''letri'''</notes></valsi>
<valsi word="lenjo" type="verb"><definition>x<sub>1</sub> entity is a lens focusing rays x<sub>2</sub> entity to the focus x<sub>3</sub> entity</definition><notes>
Comment: lenjo2 is usually light. Light from the original object comes through x1 in the form of x2 onto x3
:'''lo lenjo''' — lens, '''lo se lenjo''' — rays focused by a lens, '''lo te lenjo''' — focus of a lens
:'''ti lenjo lo gusni lo darno''' — ''This lens focusing light has a long focal length.''
:'''mi co'a dasni loi lenjo tezu'e lo ka sfubu''' — ''I put on goggles in order to dive.''
:'''ko bevri fi mi fe loi mi lenjo''' — ''Bring me my glasses.''
:Related words: '''kacma''', '''minra'''</notes></valsi>
<valsi word="lenku" type="verb"><definition>x<sub>1</sub> entity is cold</definition><notes>
:'''lo lenku''' — cold
:'''lo vacri ca'o lenku''' — ''It's getting cold.''
:Related words: '''glare''', '''bisli'''</notes></valsi>
<valsi word="lerci" type="verb"><definition>x<sub>1</sub> entity is late by standard x<sub>2</sub> proposition</definition><notes>
:'''lo lerci''' — late event
:'''lo nu mi volve lo zdani cu lerci lo se jinvi be lo mamta be mi''' — ''According to my mother I returned home late.''
:Related words: '''clira'''</notes></valsi>
<valsi word="lerfu" type="verb"><definition>x<sub>1</sub> entity is a letter, symbol in word or alphabet x<sub>2</sub> entity, text representing x<sub>3</sub> entity, sound</definition><notes>
:'''lo lerfu''' — letter, alphabetic symbol
:'''zoi ry.д.ry. lerfu lo rusko zo d''' — ''д is a letter of Russian alphabet representing sound '''d'''.''
:Related words: '''mifra''', '''namcu''', '''sinxa''', '''pandi'''</notes></valsi>
<valsi word="letri" type="verb"><definition>x<sub>1</sub> entity is electric in x<sub>2</sub> property of x1</definition><notes>
:'''lo letri''' — electric
:'''lo dilnu cu letri lo ka cupra lo lindi''' — ''The cloud are electric in that they produce lightnings.''
:Related words: '''magneti''', '''trina''', '''xlura'''</notes></valsi>
<valsi word="li"><definition>number > value</definition>
<notes>Comment: value of the following number or a math expression.
:'''li vo cu sumji li re li re''' — ''4 is the sum of 2 and 2.''
</notes></valsi><valsi word="li'a" type="discursive"><definition>''clearly, of course'', '''li'anai''' — obscurely</definition>
<notes>:'''li'a do xanka''' — ''You are clearly worried.''
:'''li'a no da poi te ckini be la alis bei la kevin pu na drani''' — ''Clearly, nothing in their relations was amiss.''
:'''li'a mi pu noroi vitke lo dzipo tumla''' — ''Of course, I have never been to Antarctica.''
:'''li'anai lo tcima cu funca le solri''' — ''Weather depends on the sun, I see, but it's complicated.''
:Related words: '''klina'''
</notes></valsi><valsi word="li'i" type="clause prefix"><definition>clause > verb</definition>
<notes>Comment: x1 (property of x2) is x2's experience described in the clause that follows. The first omitted place of the clause is assumed to be the second place of the '''li'i''' clause..
:'''lo pluka ko li'i se senva''' — ''Have a pleasant dream (sweat dreams!) Bon appetite!''
:'''lo pluka ko li'i se citka i ma do li'i salci''' — ''How did you like the party?''
</notes></valsi><valsi word="li'o" type="discursive"><definition>''and so on'' (omitted text)</definition>
<notes>:'''lo pavdei cu pa moi djedi i lo reldei cu re moi djedi i li'o''' — ''Monday is the first day, Tuesday is the second day, and so on.''
</notes></valsi><valsi word="li'u" type="terminator"><notes>Comment: seldom elidable except at end of text.
:starts with: '''LU'''
</notes></valsi><valsi word="lianpi" type="verb"><definition>x<sub>1</sub> is a cheek of x<sub>2</sub></definition><notes>
:'''lo lianpi''' — cheek
:'''ra pu se lianpi lo plana''' — ''She had chubby cheeks.''
:Related words: '''flira''', '''mlana'''</notes></valsi>
<valsi word="lianzi" type="verb"><definition>x<sub>1</sub> entity is a length of chain with links or rings x<sub>2</sub> entity</definition><notes>
:'''lo lianzi''' — chain, '''lo se lianzi''' — link of a chain, ring of a chain
:'''ti lianzi lo barda je rijno''' — ''This is a chain with big silver rings.''
:Related words: '''cukla''', '''gunma''', '''lasna'''</notes></valsi>
<valsi word="lidne" type="verb"><definition>x<sub>1</sub> entity precedes x<sub>2</sub> same type as x1 in x<sub>3</sub> property of x1 and x2</definition><notes>
Comment: '''purci''' is for time sequence
:'''lo mlatu ba lidne lo gerku lo ka se casnu ca makau''' — ''Cats will be discussed before dogs.''
:Related words: '''li'e''', '''balvi''', '''ralju''', '''rebla''', '''purci''', '''jersi''', '''porsi''', '''jatna''', '''farna'''</notes></valsi>
<valsi word="lifri" type="verb"><definition>x<sub>1</sub> entity experiences x<sub>2</sub> event</definition><notes>
:'''lo lifri''' — experiencer, patient (experiencer), '''lo se lifri''' — experienced event
:'''mi lifri lo ka pu se nandu''' — ''I've had a hard life.''
:'''do ba lifri lo nabmi''' — ''You'll get into trouble.''
:'''mi pu lifri lo ka ganse lo cizra''' — ''I underwent strange sensation.''
:Related words: '''ri'i''', '''jmive''', '''fasnu''', '''renvi'''</notes></valsi>
<valsi word="lijda" type="verb"><definition>x<sub>1</sub> entity is a religion of believers x<sub>2</sub> entity sharing beliefs x<sub>3</sub> proposition</definition><notes>
:'''lo lijda''' — religion, '''lo se lijda''' — religious believer, '''lo te lijda''' — religious belief
:'''lo na krici tu'a pa cevni na te lijda''' — ''Not believing in God is not a religion.''
:'''la animism cu lijda lo remna poi se zdani lo vi tumla lo du'u ro dacti cu vasru lo pruxi''' — ''Animism is a religion of people living on this land that asserts that every object contains a spirit.''
:'''do se lijda ma''' — ''What is your religion?''
:Related words: '''budjo''', '''censa''', '''cevni''', '''crida''', '''dadjo''', '''jegvo''', '''krici''', '''latna''', '''malsi''', '''marde''', '''muslo''', '''pruxi''', '''ranmi''', '''ritli''', '''xriso''', '''zekri'''</notes></valsi>
<valsi word="limna" type="verb"><definition>x<sub>1</sub> entity swims in x<sub>2</sub> entity</definition><notes>
:'''lo limna''' — swimmer
:'''e'anai do limna lo xamsi''' — ''Don't swim in the sea!''
:Related words: '''djacu''', '''fulta''', '''klama''', '''litru'''</notes></valsi>
<valsi word="lindi" type="verb"><definition>x<sub>1</sub> entity is a lightning striking at x<sub>2</sub> entity from x<sub>3</sub> entity</definition><notes>
:'''lo lindi''' — lightning
:'''sa'u tu pe pu cu lindi lo darno lo dilnu''' — ''That was just a lightning that stroke far way from here from a cloud.''
:Related words: '''letri'''</notes></valsi>
<valsi word="linji" type="verb"><definition>x<sub>1</sub> entity is a line segment defined by points x<sub>2</sub> plural of entity</definition><notes>
:'''lo linji''' — line, '''lo se linji''' — points defining a line
:'''loi pulji pu se linji lo clani tezu'e lo ka kurji lo prenu poi cadzu''' — ''The policemen formed long lines in order to protect walking people.''
:Related words: '''kruvi''', '''sirji''', '''jganu''', '''kantu''', '''mokca'''</notes></valsi>
<valsi word="linto" type="verb"><definition>x<sub>1</sub> entity is lightweight</definition><notes>
Comment: In metaphorical sense '''se''' '''xalbo''' is light (not serious)
:'''lo linto''' — lightweight
:'''le mlatu verba cu linto''' — ''The kitten is lightweight.''
:Related words: '''junta''', '''tilju'''</notes></valsi>
<valsi word="lisri" type="verb"><definition>x<sub>1</sub> text is a story about x<sub>2</sub> entity</definition><notes>
:'''lo lisri''' — story, tale, yarn, narrative, '''lo se lisri''' — plot of a story
:'''ko skicu lo lisri be lo crida mi''' — ''Tell me a story about fairies.''
:Related words: '''ranmi''', '''cfika''', '''skicu''', '''prosa''', '''pemci'''</notes></valsi>
<valsi word="liste" type="verb"><definition>x<sub>1</sub> entity is a list, log of x<sub>2</sub> plural of entity</definition><notes>
Comment: Unlike '''porsi''' the word '''liste''' describes an actual object with the sequence formed as is.
:'''lo liste''' — list, log, '''lo se liste''' — logged
:'''mi pu tcidu lo liste be lo notci noi te porsi lo ka se benji ca makau''' — ''I read a log of messages, which were sorted in the order of being sent.''
:Related words: '''porsi''', '''girzu''', '''cmima'''</notes></valsi>
<valsi word="litce" type="verb"><definition>x<sub>1</sub> entity is x<sub>2</sub> number liters</definition><notes>
:'''lo vi djacu cu litce li re''' — ''It's two liters of water.''
:Related words: '''merli''', '''grake''', '''mitre''', '''dekpu''', '''centi''', '''decti''', '''dekto''', '''femti''', '''gigdo''', '''gocti''', '''gotro''', '''kilto''', '''megdo''', '''mikri''', '''milti''', '''nanvi''', '''petso''', '''picti''', '''terto''', '''xatsi''', '''xecto''', '''xexso''', '''zepti''', '''zetro'''</notes></valsi>
<valsi word="litki" type="verb"><definition>x<sub>1</sub> entity is liquid</definition><notes>
:'''lo litki''' — liquid
:'''ko satre lo litki lo panje''' — ''Wipe the liquid with a sponge.''
:Related words: '''cilmo''', '''djacu''', '''lumci''', '''runta''', '''pambe''', '''sudga''', '''gapci''', '''sligu''', '''flecu''', '''jduli'''</notes></valsi>
<valsi word="litru" type="verb"><definition>x<sub>1</sub> entity travels via route x<sub>2</sub> entity</definition><notes>
:'''lo litru''' — traveller, '''lo se litru''' — travelling route
:'''mi pu litru lo fange gugde''' — ''I travelled abroad.''
:Related words: '''bajra''', '''cadzu''', '''cpare''', '''tcana''', '''klama''', '''cliva''', '''pluta''', '''limna''', '''muvdu'''</notes></valsi>
<valsi word="livga" type="verb"><definition>x<sub>1</sub> entity is a liver of x<sub>2</sub> entity</definition><notes>
:'''lo livga''' — liver
:'''xu lo ka citka lo livga be lo jipci cu xamgu do''' — ''Is eating chicken liver good for you?''
:Related words: '''rango''', '''betfu'''</notes></valsi>
<valsi word="livla" type="verb"><definition>x<sub>1</sub> entity is a fuel for powering x<sub>2</sub> entity</definition><notes>
:'''lo livla''' — fuel
:'''le toknu cu se livla lo mudri''' — ''The furnace is stoked up with wood.''
:'''lo livla na banzu''' — ''There isn't enough fuel.''
:Related words: '''nejni''', '''xaksu''', '''jelca'''</notes></valsi>
<valsi word="lo"><definition>verb > noun</definition>
<notes>Comment: ''the one which does ...'', ''the one which is ...'', ''those which do ...'', ''those which are ...''. Creates noun from verb. Often corresponds to English '-er' like in 'singer', 'player'. Without numbers specified can refer both to singular and plural nouns depending on context.
:'''lo mlatu cu danlu''' — ''Cat is an animal.''
:'''lo pa sazri ca denpa''' — ''A driver waits.''
:'''lo za'u sazri ca denpa''' — ''Drivers wait.''
</notes></valsi><valsi word="lo'ai"><definition>To correct yourself say '''lo'ai''', then the incorrect construct, then '''sa'ai''', then the same but corrected construct, then '''le'ai'''.</definition>
<notes>Comment: You may just start with '''sa'ai''' if it's obvious what is corrected. The word '''le'ai''' on its own indicates that an obvious mistake was made. '''le'ai''' '''dai''' indicates that the other partner made a mistake. '''le'ai''' '''pei''' asks whether the partner made a mistake. '''le'ai''' '''nai''' explicitly denies mistakes.
:ends with: '''sa'ai'''
:'''i mi pu vitke lo dzipo le'ainai i mi pu klama lo zarci y lo'ai pu sa'ai ba le'ai''' — ''I visited Antarctique (sic!) I went to the store, ehm, no, will go!''
</notes></valsi><valsi word="lo'e"><definition>verb > noun denoting a typical thing</definition>
<notes>Comment: ''the typical one that does or is ...''.
:'''lo'e cipni cu kakne lo ka vofli''' — ''Typical birds can fly.''
</notes></valsi><valsi word="lo'o" type="terminator"><notes>:starts with: '''LI'''
</notes></valsi><valsi word="lo'u"><definition>main verb > noun that is a quote</definition>
<notes>Comment: '''lo'u''' ... '''le'u''' is a noun quoting any number of Lojban words.
:ends with: '''le'u'''
:'''ma smuni lo'u vau ua le'u noi do cusku''' — ''What's the meaning of '''vau ua''' that you said?''
</notes></valsi><valsi word="logji" type="verb"><definition>x<sub>1</sub> proposition is a logic for reasoning about x<sub>2</sub> proposition</definition><notes>
:'''lo logji''' — logic
:'''lo du'u lo prina be fi lo nixli jamfu cu nenri lo dinju cu logji lo du'u la alis pu zvati ti''' — ''By the fact that there are footprints of a girl inside the house I conclude that Alice was here.''
:Related words: '''nibli'''</notes></valsi>
<valsi word="loi"><definition>verb > noun denoting a mass</definition>
<notes>Comment: ''the mass of those that are ...''. Creates noun that denotes a mass.
:'''loi tadni pu sruri le dinju''' — ''Students surrounded the building.''
</notes></valsi><valsi word="lojbo" type="verb"><definition>x<sub>1</sub> entity is Lojbanic in x<sub>2</sub> property of x1</definition><notes>
:'''lo lojbo''' — Lojbanic
:'''mi lojbo fe po'o lo ka se cinri la lojban ije mi na tavla bau la ly''' — ''I'm a Lojbanic person only in that I'm interested inLojban; I don't speak it.''
:Related words: '''bangu''', '''logji'''</notes></valsi>
<valsi word="loldi" type="verb"><definition>x<sub>1</sub> entity is a floor or ground of x<sub>2</sub> entity</definition><notes>
:'''lo loldi''' — floor
:'''mi pu sipna bu'u lo loldi be lo mi kumfa''' — ''I slept on the floor of my room.''
:Related words: '''bitmu''', '''drudi''', '''dertu''', '''dizlo''', '''cnita''', '''zbepi''', '''sarji''', '''skalera'''</notes></valsi>
<valsi word="lorxu" type="verb"><definition>x<sub>1</sub> entity is a fox of species x<sub>2</sub> taxon</definition><notes>
:'''lo lorxu''' — fox
:'''lo lorxu cu citka lo jipci''' — ''Foxes eat hens.''
:Related words: '''gerku'''</notes></valsi>
<valsi word="lu"><definition>main verb > noun that is a quote</definition>
<notes>Comment: '''lu''' ... '''li'u''' is a noun quoting grammatically correct text in Lojban (can contain any number of words).
:ends with: '''li'u'''
:'''mi pu cusku lu coi lo pendo li'u''' — ''I said "Hello, friends!"''
</notes></valsi><valsi word="lu'e"><definition>''what refers to'' (noun follows)</definition>
<notes>Comment: '''''lu'e''' [noun]'' is the same as '''''lo''' '''sinxa''' '''be''' [noun]''.
:'''lo re cukla cu du lu'e lo logji''' — ''Two circles is a symbol of logic.''
:'''lo vi vorme janbe cu lu'e mi''' — ''This door bell is to call me.''
</notes></valsi><valsi word="lu'u" type="terminator"><notes>:starts with: '''LAhE'''
</notes></valsi><valsi word="lujvo" type="verb"><definition>x<sub>1</sub> text is a lujvo, verb made of affixes with meaning x<sub>2</sub> entity , arguments meaning x<sub>3</sub> ordered plural of entity , with affixes built from components x<sub>4</sub> ordered plural of text</definition><notes>
:'''lo lujvo''' — lujvo (compound verb made of affixes)
:'''zo ki'ogra lujvo lo du'u kilto lo grake vau lo kilto ce'o lo se grake zo kilto ce'o zo grake''' — '''''ki'ogra''' is a lujvo meaning "is a thousand of grams" with arguments meaning "what is measured in thousands", "the number of grams"; affixes of the lujvo are built from '''kilto''' and '''grake''' attached sequentially.''
:Related words: '''stura''', '''cmavo''', '''gismu''', '''rafsi''', '''smuni'''</notes></valsi>
<valsi word="lumci" type="verb"><definition>x<sub>1</sub> entity washes x<sub>2</sub> entity of contaminant x<sub>3</sub> entity</definition><notes>
:'''lo lumci''' — washer
:'''mi pu lumci lo za'u palta lo stali''' — ''I washed the dishes of the remains.''
:Related words: '''djacu''', '''jinru''', '''litki''', '''zbabu''', '''jinsa''', '''curve'''</notes></valsi>
<valsi word="lunbe" type="verb"><definition>x<sub>1</sub> entity is naked or bare</definition><notes>
:'''lo lunbe''' — naked, bare
:'''lo cifnu ca lunbe''' — ''The baby is naked.''
:Related words: '''taxfu''', '''bandu'''</notes></valsi>
<valsi word="lunra" type="verb"><definition>x<sub>1</sub> entity is a moon or major natural satellite of planet x<sub>2</sub> entity</definition><notes>
:'''lo lunra''' — moon, '''lo se lunra''' — planet with a moon
:'''le terdi ce se lunra pa da''' — ''The Earth has one natural moon.''
:Related words: '''planeta''', '''solri''', '''terdi''', '''mluni'''</notes></valsi>
<valsi word="lunsa" type="verb"><definition>x<sub>1</sub> entity condenses</definition><notes>
:'''lo lunsa''' — condensing
:'''lo bisli lunsa pu gacri lo dertu''' — ''The frost covered the ground.''
:Related words: '''cilmo''', '''dunja''', '''febvi''', '''runme''', '''bumru'''</notes></valsi>
<valsi word="luska" type="verb"><definition>x<sub>1</sub> is a mollusc of species x<sub>2</sub></definition><notes>
:'''lo luska''' — mollusc
:'''lo vi luska cu cpare co masno''' — ''This mollusc moves slowly.''
:Related words: '''curmu''', '''danlu''', '''xamsi''', '''rirxe'''</notes></valsi>
<valsi word="ly" type="pronoun"><definition>letter 'L'</definition>
<notes></notes></valsi><valsi word="ma" type="pronoun"><definition>asks for the noun (that should go into the place to which '''ma''' is put)</definition>
<notes>:'''do djica ma''' — ''What do you want?''
:'''ma poi prenu pu zvati ti''' — ''Who was here?''
:'''ma poi dacti pu zvati ti''' — ''What object was here?''
</notes></valsi><valsi word="ma'a" type="pronoun"><definition>''we with you'' (might include other persons not in the dialog)</definition>
<notes>Comment: '''mi'ai''' is a more vague pronoun.
:'''ma'a se zdani lo bu'u planeta''' — ''We inhabit this planet.''
:'''lo rarna munje cu vajni ca lo nu ma'a se lifri''' — ''Nature plays an important role in our lives.''
</notes></valsi><valsi word="ma'i" type="preposition from '''manri'''"><definition>''in reference frame ...''</definition>
<notes>:'''According to my friend the situation is deteriorating''' — ''ma'i lo mi pendo lo tcini cu zenba lo ka xlali.''
</notes></valsi><valsi word="ma'oi"><definition>quotes one next word and treats it as the name of a selma'o (class of particles). The quoted word must be delimited by pauses (in speech) or whitespace (in writing) </definition>
<notes>Comment: selma'o are often written in English text in capital letters e.g.: COI.
:'''zo di'ai cmavo ma'oi coi''' — '''''di'ai''' ('Good luck!') is a grammatical particle of class '''coi'''.''
:Related words: '''ra'oi''', '''zo'oi'''
</notes></valsi><valsi word="ma'u" type="digit/number"><definition>plus sign; positive number; default any positive</definition>
<notes>:'''li ma'u re du li bi vu'u xa''' — ''+2 = 8 - 6'.''
</notes></valsi><valsi word="mabla" type="verb"><definition>x<sub>1</sub> entity is shitty, awful in x<sub>2</sub> property of x1 according to x<sub>3</sub> entity; x1 stinks, sucks</definition><notes>
:'''lo mabla''' — shitty, awful, execrable, deplorable, wretched, rotten, miserable, contemptible, crappy, inferior, of low-quality
:'''fi mi le cidja cu mabla lo ka se zalvi lo denci''' — ''For me the food is awful in chewing it.''
:Related words: '''palci''', '''dapma''', '''xlali''', '''zabna''', '''funca''', '''ganti''', '''ganxo''', '''gletu''', '''gutra''', '''kalci''', '''pinca''', '''pinji''', '''plibu''', '''vibna''', '''vlagi''', '''zargu'''</notes></valsi>
<valsi word="mabru" type="verb"><definition>x<sub>1</sub> entity is mammal of species x<sub>2</sub> taxon</definition><notes>
:'''lo mabru''' — mammal
:'''lo delfinu cu mabru''' — ''Dolphins are mammals.''
:Related words: '''danlu''', '''ladru''', '''tatru''', '''ractu''', '''xanto''', '''xarju'''</notes></valsi>
<valsi word="macnu" type="verb"><definition>x<sub>1</sub> entity is manual in function x<sub>2</sub> property of x1</definition><notes>
Comment: ??? depends on nilsutra
:'''lo macnu''' — manual, '''lo se macnu''' — function done manually
:'''```lo vi karce cu macnu lo ka cnegau lo ni ce'u sutra''' — ''The speed in this machine is switched manually.''
:Related words: '''zmiku''', '''jitro'''</notes></valsi>
<valsi word="magneti" type="verb"><definition>x<sub>1</sub> entity is magnetic in x<sub>2</sub> property of x1</definition><notes>
:'''lo magneti''' — magnet
:'''lo rokci cu magneti lo ka snipa lo jinme''' — ''The stone is magnetic in that it sticks to metal.''
:'''lo rokci co'u magneti lo ka co'a glare''' — ''The stone becomes non-magnetic when being heat up.''
:Related words: '''letri''', '''trina''', '''xlura'''</notes></valsi>
<valsi word="mai"><definition>number > numbered item or paragraph</definition>
<notes>Comment: suffix of a number that marks a paragraph or item when they are ordered.
:'''pamai la meilis ze'i se zdani ti''' — ''First, Mei Li has been living here for a short time.''
:'''remai my ka'e sidju ma'a''' — ''Secondly, she can help us.''
:'''romai my stati nixli''' — ''Lastly, she is a smart girl.''
</notes></valsi><valsi word="makcu" type="verb"><definition>x<sub>1</sub> entity is mature in x<sub>2</sub> property of x1</definition><notes>
:'''lo makcu''' — mature
:'''le nanmu cu simlu lo ka makcu lo ka seksi''' — ''The man seems to be mature in his sexuality.''
:Related words: '''cifnu''', '''ninmu''', '''verba''', '''banro''', '''farvi''', '''nanmu'''</notes></valsi>
<valsi word="makfa" type="verb"><definition>x<sub>1</sub> event is magic or supernatural to x<sub>2</sub> entity performed by x<sub>3</sub> entity</definition><notes>
:'''lo makfa''' — magical event, '''lo te makfa''' — wizard, magician
:'''lo nu lo ractu cu canci cu makfa lo verba la djan''' — ''.''
:Related words: '''krici''', '''manci'''</notes></valsi>
<valsi word="malsi" type="verb"><definition>x<sub>1</sub> entity is a church or temple of religion, culture x<sub>2</sub> entity</definition><notes>
:'''lo malsi''' — church, temple
:'''ti malsi lo budjo''' — ''This is a Buddhist temple.''
:Related words: '''cevni''', '''krici''', '''lijda''', '''ritli'''</notes></valsi>
<valsi word="mamta" type="verb"><definition>x<sub>1</sub> entity is a mother of x<sub>2</sub> entity</definition><notes>
:'''lo mamta''' — mother, '''lo se mamta''' — child of a mother
:'''lo mamta be do pu zukte ma ca lo nu do mo'u klama lo zdani''' — ''What was your mother doing when you got home?''
:Related words: '''patfu''', '''sovda''', '''rirni''', '''rorci''', '''tarbi''', '''famti''', '''bersa''', '''jbena'''</notes></valsi>
<valsi word="manfo" type="verb"><definition>x<sub>1</sub> entity is uniform, homogeneous in x<sub>2</sub> property of x1</definition><notes>
:'''lo manfo''' — uniform, homogeneous
:'''le bukpu ca manfo lo ka se tengu''' — ''The cloth is uniform in texture.''
:Related words: '''prane''', '''curve''', '''ranji''', '''vitno''', '''stodi''', '''dikni''', '''sampu''', '''traji'''</notes></valsi>
<valsi word="mango" type="verb"><definition>x<sub>1</sub> entity is a mango of variety x<sub>2</sub> taxon</definition><notes>
:'''lo mango''' — mango
:'''mi punai citka lo mango''' — ''I have never eaten mangoes.''
:Related words: '''grute'''</notes></valsi>
<valsi word="manku" type="verb"><definition>x<sub>1</sub> entity is dark</definition><notes>
:'''lo manku''' — dark
:'''lo kumfa cu manku''' — ''The room is dark.''
:Related words: '''blabi''', '''gusni''', '''ctino''', '''kandi''', '''xekri''', '''ctino'''</notes></valsi>
<valsi word="manri" type="verb"><definition>x<sub>1</sub> entity is a standard for observing x<sub>2</sub> entity with rules x<sub>3</sub> property of x1</definition><notes>
:'''lo manri''' — standard
:'''mi manri lo nu makau ba jinga vau lo ka jdice makau''' — ''I'm the standard of determining of who will win, however I decide that will be so.''
:'''lo vu ve'i cmana ba manri lo nu zgana le tumla''' — ''That hill will be the reference frame for bserving the land.''
:Related words: '''ma'i''', '''ckilu''', '''merli''', '''pajni''', '''cimde''', '''jdice''', '''marde'''</notes></valsi>
<valsi word="mansa" type="verb"><definition>x<sub>1</sub> entity satisfies x<sub>2</sub> entity in x<sub>3</sub> property of x1</definition><notes>
:'''lo mansa''' — satisfying, '''lo se mansa''' — satisfied
:'''lo zdani be mi cu mansa mi lo ka tcini bu'u ce'u''' — ''I'm satisfied with the conditions in my house.''
:Related words: '''pajni'''</notes></valsi>
<valsi word="manti" type="verb"><definition>x<sub>1</sub> entity is an ant of species x<sub>2</sub> taxon</definition><notes>
:'''lo manti''' — ant
:'''lo sakta cu trina lo manti''' — ''Sugar attracts ants.''
:Related words: '''cinki''', '''blato'''</notes></valsi>
<valsi word="mapku" type="verb"><definition>x<sub>1</sub> entity is a hat, helmet</definition><notes>
:'''lo mapku''' — hat, helmet
:'''ai mi dasni lo mapku''' — ''I'm gonna put on a hat.''
:Related words: '''taxfu''', '''stedu''', '''drudi'''</notes></valsi>
<valsi word="mapni" type="verb"><definition>x<sub>1</sub> entity is some cotton</definition><notes>
:'''lo mapni''' — cotton
:'''le mapni cu zabna''' — ''The cotton is of high quality.''
:Related words: '''bukpu'''</notes></valsi>
<valsi word="mapti" type="verb"><definition>x<sub>1</sub> entity is compatible with or matches x<sub>2</sub> entity in x<sub>3</sub> property of x1</definition><notes>
:'''lo mapti''' — compatible
:'''lo se cusku be do na mapti lo se cusku be lo do jatna lo ka se smuni''' — ''Your words are inconsistent in meaning with what your boss said.''
:'''ti ckiku lo na mapti be lo vi stela''' — ''The key is incompatible with this lock.''
:Related words: '''satci''', '''tugni''', '''sarxe''', '''drani''', '''tarmi''', '''ckini''', '''mintu'''</notes></valsi>
<valsi word="marbi" type="verb"><definition>x<sub>1</sub> entity is a shelter protecting x<sub>2</sub> entity against threat x<sub>3</sub> property of x2</definition><notes>
:'''lo marbi''' — shelter, haven, refuge, retreat, harbor
:'''mi pu jai se bapli fai lo ka se marbi lo laldo dinju fi lo ka cilmo''' — ''I had to take shelter in an old building in order not to become wet.''
:Related words: '''bandu''', '''ckape''', '''snura''', '''drudi''', '''sepli''', '''bitmu''', '''gacri'''</notes></valsi>
<valsi word="marce" type="verb"><definition>x<sub>1</sub> entity is a vehicle for carrying x<sub>2</sub> entity</definition><notes>
:'''lo marce''' — vehicle, '''lo se marce''' — passenger
:'''ti marce lo se vecnu''' — ''This is a vehicle for carrying goods.''
:'''ti marce ge lo se vecnu na'o ku gi lo remna ca'aku''' — ''This is a vehicle intended to transport goods but actually used for transporting people.''
:Related words: '''klama''', '''matra''', '''bevri''', '''bloti''', '''carce''', '''karce''', '''sabnu''', '''skiji'''</notes></valsi>
<valsi word="marde" type="verb"><definition>x<sub>1</sub> property of x2 are the ethics of performer x<sub>2</sub> entity</definition><notes>
:'''lo marde''' — ethics, morals, moral standards, ethical standards
:'''lo ka zukte lo se cpedu be lo bilma cu marde ei do''' — ''Doing what the ill person asks should be you ethics.''
:Related words: '''palci''', '''vrude''', '''lijda''', '''manri''', '''javni''', '''tarti''', '''zekri'''</notes></valsi>
<valsi word="margu" type="verb"><definition>x<sub>1</sub> entity is a quantity of mercury</definition><notes>
:'''lo margu''' — mercury
:'''xu lo margu cu jinme''' — ''Is mercury a metal?''
:Related words: '''jinme'''</notes></valsi>
<valsi word="marji" type="verb"><definition>x<sub>1</sub> entity is material of composition x<sub>2</sub> entity in shape x<sub>3</sub> entity</definition><notes>
:'''lo marji''' — material, stuff, matter, '''lo se marji''' — composition of matter, '''lo te marji''' — shape of matter
:'''lo vi nanba cu marji lo mraji lo bliku''' — ''This bread is made of rye and has the form of a block.''
:Related words: '''morna''', '''mucti''', '''nejni''', '''tarmi''', '''dacti'''</notes></valsi>
<valsi word="marna" type="verb"><definition>x<sub>1</sub> entity is a quantity of hemp of species x<sub>2</sub> taxon</definition><notes>
:'''lo marna''' — hemp
:'''ti skori lo marna''' — ''This is a cable made of hemp.''
:Related words: '''skori''', '''tanko''', '''sigja''', '''xukmi'''</notes></valsi>
<valsi word="marvele" type="verb"><definition>x<sub>1</sub> entity is marvellous, astonishing to x<sub>2</sub> entity</definition><notes>
:'''lo marvele''' — marvellous
:'''lo vi stuzi cu marvele mi''' — ''This place is marveleus to me.''
:Related words: '''melbi'''</notes></valsi>
<valsi word="marxa" type="verb"><definition>x<sub>1</sub> entity crushes or smashes x<sub>2</sub> entity into x<sub>3</sub> entity</definition><notes>
:'''mi pu marxa lo patlu lo pesxu''' — ''I made mashed potatoes.''
:Related words: '''daspo''', '''pesxu''', '''zalvi''', '''bapli'''</notes></valsi>
<valsi word="masno" type="verb"><definition>x<sub>1</sub> entity is slow at doing x<sub>2</sub> property of x1</definition><notes>
:'''lo masno''' — slow
:'''le verba cu simlu lo ka masno lo ka cadzu''' — ''The child seems to be slow at walking.''
:Related words: '''sutra'''</notes></valsi>
<valsi word="masti" type="verb"><definition>x<sub>1</sub> event is x<sub>2</sub> number months long</definition><notes>
:'''lo pu dunra cu masti li ci''' — ''The past winter lasted for 3 months.''
:Related words: '''detri''', '''djedi''', '''jeftu''', '''nanca'''</notes></valsi>
<valsi word="matci" type="verb"><definition>x<sub>1</sub> entity is a mat or pad</definition><notes>
:'''lo matci''' — mat, pad
:'''ko jai mosra lo cutci lo matci''' — ''Wipe your shoes on the mat.''
:Related words: '''kicne''', '''tapla''', '''karda''', '''ckana'''</notes></valsi>
<valsi word="matli" type="verb"><definition>x<sub>1</sub> entity is some flax, linen</definition><notes>
:'''lo matli''' — linen
:'''lo vi creka cu matli''' — ''This shirt is linen.''
:Related words: '''bukpu'''</notes></valsi>
<valsi word="matne" type="verb"><definition>x<sub>1</sub> entity is some butter</definition><notes>
:'''lo matne''' — butter
:'''mi pu citka lo snuji be lo matne bei lo nanba''' — ''I ate a sandwich with butter and bread.''
:Related words: '''grasu''', '''kruji'''</notes></valsi>
<valsi word="matra" type="verb"><definition>x<sub>1</sub> entity is an engine driving x<sub>2</sub> entity</definition><notes>
:'''lo matra''' — engine
:'''lo vi karce cu se matra lo vlipa''' — ''This car has a powerful engine.''
:Related words: '''marce''', '''minji''', '''carce'''</notes></valsi>
<valsi word="mau" type="preposition from '''zmadu'''"><definition>''more ...''</definition>
<notes>Comment: x1 of the clause corresponds to '''lo se zmadu''' — ''than...', preposition sumti corresponds to '''lo zmadu''' — ''more ...', the clause itself corresponds to '''lo te zmadu''' — the comparison.
:'''mi nelci do mau la alis''' — ''I like you but Alice likes you more.''
</notes></valsi><valsi word="mau'i" type="interjection modifier"><definition>stronger intensity interjection. Used as a modifier of interjections</definition>
<notes>Comment: specifies an intensity of an interjection stronger than the intensity of the same interjection earlier used.
:'''ua do ti zvati''' — ''Wow, you are here.''
:'''uamau'i ji'a la alis ti zvati''' — ''Wow, wow, Alice is here too!''
:Related words: '''dau'i''', '''mau'i''', '''me'ai''', '''cu'i''', '''sai''', '''ru'e'''
</notes></valsi><valsi word="mavji" type="verb"><definition>x<sub>1</sub> entity is some oats of species x<sub>2</sub> taxon</definition><notes>
:'''lo mavji''' — oats
:'''ze'uku lo mavji gau ralju cidja lo xirma''' — ''Oats have long been the main food for horses.''
:Related words: '''gurni'''</notes></valsi>
<valsi word="maxri" type="verb"><definition>x<sub>1</sub> entity is some wheat of species x<sub>2</sub> taxon</definition><notes>
:'''lo maxri''' — wheat
:'''lo nanba cu se zbasu fi lo maxri''' — ''Bread is made of wheat.''
:Related words: '''gurni'''</notes></valsi>
<valsi word="me"><definition>''x1 is among the referents of ...'' (a noun follows)</definition>
<notes>:ends with: '''me'u'''
:'''xu do me lo ctuca''' — ''Are you a teacher?''
</notes></valsi><valsi word="me'ai" type="interjection modifier"><definition>weaker intensity interjection. Used as a modifier of interjections</definition>
<notes>Comment: specifies an intensity of an interjection weaker than the intensity of the same interjection earlier used.
:'''ua do tsuku doi la alis''' — ''Wow, you arrived, Alice!''
:'''uame'ai lo drata ti zvati ji'a''' — ''Oh well, the others are here too.''
:Related words: '''dau'i''', '''mau'i''', '''me'ai''', '''cu'i''', '''sai''', '''ru'e'''
</notes></valsi><valsi word="me'i" type="digit/number"><definition>less than</definition>
<notes>:'''me'i mu prenu ca zutse bu'u le kumfa''' — ''There are less than five people sitting in the room now.''
</notes></valsi><valsi word="me'o"><definition>number > text</definition>
<notes>Comment: marks the following sequence of numbers as a text.
:'''me'o pa re ci''' — ''123 (as a text).''
</notes></valsi><valsi word="me'oi"><definition>foreign word > verb</definition>
<notes>Comment: '''me'oi''' and one single word after it make a verb. The word after '''me'oi''': might be from any language and written in any script, it is delimited by pauses (in speech) or whitespaces (in writing) from both sides, it can't have pauses inside if pronounced, nor dots when written. A quick way to borrow foreign words into Lojban.
:'''la alis cu me'oi slob''' — ''Alice is a slob.''
:Related words: '''zo'oi''', '''zoi''', '''la'o''', '''la'oi''', '''zo''', '''lu''' ... '''li'u''', '''lo'e''', '''lo'u''', '''me'oi'''
</notes></valsi><valsi word="me'u" type="terminator"><notes>:starts with: '''ME'''
</notes></valsi><valsi word="mebri" type="verb"><definition>x<sub>1</sub> entity is a brow or forehead of x<sub>2</sub> entity</definition><notes>
:'''lo mebri''' — brow
:'''le fetsi pu se mebri lo kalri''' — ''She had a forehead open.''
:Related words: '''stedu''', '''flira'''</notes></valsi>
<valsi word="megdo" type="verb"><definition>x<sub>1</sub> entity is a million of x<sub>2</sub> same type as x1 in x<sub>3</sub> property of x1</definition><notes>
:'''mi ponse lo megdo lo rupnu be li ci''' — ''I own three million dollars.''
:'''e'o do cuxna fi lo pixra poi klani su'e lo megdo be li pa bei lo ka se bitri li bi''' — ''Please choose an image that does not exceed 1 Megabyte.''
:Related words: '''grake''', '''mitre''', '''snidu''', '''stero''', '''delno''', '''molro''', '''kelvo''', '''xampo''', '''gradu''', '''litce''', '''merli''', '''centi''', '''decti''', '''dekto''', '''femti''', '''gigdo''', '''gocti''', '''gotro''', '''kilto''', '''mikri''', '''milti''', '''nanvi''', '''petso''', '''picti''', '''terto''', '''xatsi''', '''xecto''', '''xexso''', '''zepti''', '''zetro'''</notes></valsi>
<valsi word="mei" type="verb"><definition>number > verb denoting mass</definition>
<notes>Comment: x1 (entity) is the mass formed from (n) members that are x2 (plural of entity). The number (n) is put in front of '''mei'''.
:'''mi ralte lo re mei be lo gluta''' — ''I have a pair of mittens.''
:Related words: '''cmima''', '''gunma''', '''moi'''
</notes></valsi><valsi word="mekso" type="verb"><definition>x<sub>1</sub> text is a mathematical expression under rules x<sub>2</sub> proposition</definition><notes>
:'''lo mekso''' — math expression
:'''lu li vo du li re su'i re li'u mekso la lojban''' — ''li vo du li resu'i re is a mathematical expression in Lojban.''
:'''zoi cy.(x+15&amp;~15).cy. mekso la c poi bangu''' — ''x+15&amp;~15 is a mathematical expression in C language.''
:Related words: '''cmaci''', '''dilcu''', '''fancu''', '''frinu''', '''jalge''', '''namcu''', '''parbi''', '''pilji'''</notes></valsi>
<valsi word="melbi" type="verb"><definition>x<sub>1</sub> entity is beautiful to observer x<sub>2</sub> entity in aspect x<sub>3</sub> property of x1</definition><notes>
:'''lo melbi''' — beautiful
:'''le ninmu cu melbi mi lo ka se catlu''' — ''For me the woman is beautiful to look at.''
:Related words: '''pluka''', '''xamgu'''</notes></valsi>
<valsi word="menli" type="verb"><definition>x<sub>1</sub> event is a mind of body x<sub>2</sub> entity</definition><notes>
Comment: Ability of being aware of things and of rational thought
:'''lo menli''' — mind
:'''lo menli be lo smani cu simsa lo menli be lo remna''' — ''The mind of monkeys is similar to the one of humans.''
:Related words: '''intele''', '''besna''', '''morji''', '''mucti''', '''pensi''', '''sanji''', '''xanri''', '''sevzi''', '''xadni'''</notes></valsi>
<valsi word="mensi" type="verb"><definition>x<sub>1</sub> entity is a sister of x<sub>2</sub> entity by bond x<sub>3</sub> property of x1</definition><notes>
:'''lo mensi''' — sister, '''lo se mensi''' — sibling of a sister
:'''do mensi mi lo ka se patfu''' — ''You are my brother since we are born from the same father.''
:Related words: '''bruna''', '''tunba''', '''tamne''', '''famti'''</notes></valsi>

:'''lo nu penmi cu mentu be li ji'i xano''' — ''The meeting is approximately 60 minutes long.''
:Related words: '''junla''', '''cacra''', '''snidu''', '''tcika'''</notes></valsi>

<valsi word="mi" type="pronoun"><definition>''I'' (the speaker or the speakers)</definition>
<notes>:'''mi gleki''' — ''I'm happy.''
</notes></valsi><valsi word="mi'a" type="pronoun"><definition>''we without you'' (might include other persons not in the dialog)</definition>
<notes>Comment: '''mi'ai''' is a more vague pronoun.
:'''mi'a pu casnu do''' — ''We were discussing you.''
</notes></valsi><valsi word="mi'ai" type="pronoun"><definition>''we'' (at least two persons including at least one of the speakers)</definition>
<notes>Comment: English 'we'. '''mi'a''', '''mi'o''' and '''ma'a''' are more specific cases of '''mi'ai'''.
:'''mi'ai serai troci''' — ''We try our best.''
:'''mi'ai djuno lo krinu''' — ''We know the reason.''
:'''da mi'ai nabmi''' — ''We have a problem.''
</notes></valsi><valsi word="mi'e" type="vocative"><definition>''I am ...'' (self-identification of the speaker), '''mi'nai''' — ''I am not'' (denial of the speaker's identity)</definition>
<notes>:'''coi mi'e la gleki''' — ''Hello, I'm La Gleki.''
:'''coi la kevin i mi'enai la kevin''' — ''Hello, Kevin - I'm not Kevin.''
</notes></valsi><valsi word="mi'i" type="conjunction"><definition>''from center of ... and of distance ... around''</definition>
<notes>:'''lo za'u flora cu zvati lo cmana mi'i lo ki'otre be li ci''' — ''The flowers are present on the mountain and three kilometers around of it.''
</notes></valsi><valsi word="mi'o" type="pronoun"><definition>''you and I'' (the speaker and the listener)</definition>
<notes>Comment: '''mi'ai''' is a more vague pronoun.
:'''mi'o ba renvi''' — ''You and I will survive.''
</notes></valsi><valsi word="mi'u" type="discursive"><definition>''ditto'' (the same thing) — another one</definition>
<notes>Comment: ??? aNAPHORA.
:'''mi pu zukte ra mi'u''' — ''I did the same thing.''
:'''mi pu lebna lo cukta gi'e dunda lo cukta mi'u nai la alis''' — ''I took a book and gave another one to Alice.''
:Related words: '''mintu'''
</notes></valsi><valsi word="midju" type="verb"><definition>x<sub>1</sub> entity is in the middle of x<sub>2</sub> entity</definition><notes>
:'''ra pu sanli bu'u lo midju be lo dargu''' — ''He was standing in the middle of the road.''
:Related words: '''lanxe''', '''jbini''', '''nutli''', '''snuji''', '''milxe''', '''denmi''', '''ralju'''</notes></valsi>
<valsi word="mifra" type="verb"><definition>x<sub>1</sub> entity, text is an encoded x<sub>2</sub> entity, text made using cipher x<sub>3</sub> entity, property (contains two places for '''ce'u''')</definition><notes>

:'''zoi .mifr. cni rni dn .mifr. mifra lu coi ro do li'u lo ka zo o pe ce'u se basti zo n pe ce'u''' — ''cni rni dn is an encoded Lojban phrase '''coi ro do''' where '''n''' is a replacement for '''o'''.''

<valsi word="milti" type="verb"><definition>x<sub>1</sub> entity is a thousandth of x<sub>2</sub> same type as x1 in x<sub>3</sub> property of x1</definition><notes>
:'''lo jubme cu milti lo mitre be li bi no no boi lo ka ganra''' — ''The table is 800 millimeters wide.''
:Related words: '''grake''', '''mitre''', '''snidu''', '''stero''', '''delno''', '''molro''', '''kelvo''', '''xampo''', '''gradu''', '''litce''', '''merli''', '''centi''', '''decti''', '''dekto''', '''femti''', '''gigdo''', '''gocti''', '''gotro''', '''kilto''', '''megdo''', '''mikri''', '''nanvi''', '''petso''', '''picti''', '''terto''', '''xatsi''', '''xecto''', '''xexso''', '''zepti''', '''zetro'''</notes></valsi>
<valsi word="milxe" type="verb"><definition>x<sub>1</sub> entity is mild in x<sub>2</sub> property of x1</definition><notes>
:'''lo milxe''' — mild
:'''lo djacu cu milxe lo ka glare''' — ''The water is warm (not hot).''
:'''mi milxe lo ka tatpi''' — ''I'm tired to a moderate degree.''
:Related words: '''mutce''', '''traji''', '''kandi''', '''ruble''', '''midju''', '''nutli''', '''ralci'''</notes></valsi>

:'''lo minde''' — commander
:'''le turni pu minde mi lo ka klama ca lo drani''' — ''The manager ordered me to come on time.''

<valsi word="minji" type="verb"><definition>x<sub>1</sub> entity is a machine for function x<sub>2</sub> event</definition><notes>
Comment: '''cabra''' is for devices controlled by external force, '''minji''' is for machines working automatically, '''zmiku''' is for robots in general
:'''lo minji''' — machine, '''lo se minji''' — function of a machine
:'''ti minji lo nu cpacu lo djacu vau lo xance''' — ''This is a hand-controlled apparatus for getting water.''
:Related words: '''cabra''', '''matra''', '''tutci''', '''zukte''', '''pilno''', '''skami'''</notes></valsi>
<valsi word="minra" type="verb"><definition>x<sub>1</sub> entity reflects or echoes x<sub>2</sub> entity to observer x<sub>3</sub> entity as x<sub>4</sub> entity</definition><notes>, '''lo se minra''' — reflected, echoed
:'''lo djacu pu minra lo gusnu be fi la sol la alis lo marvele barna''' — ''Water reflected the sunlight that Alice could see as marvellous spots.''
:'''le bitmu so'iroi minra lo sance''' — ''The wall echoes the sound several times.''
:Related words: '''catlu''', '''viska''', '''lenjo''', '''pensi'''</notes></valsi>
<valsi word="mintu" type="verb"><definition>x<sub>1</sub> entity is identical to x<sub>2</sub> entity property of x1 and x2 with '''kau'''; x1 is x2</definition><notes>
Comment: The same meaning as '''du''' but only has two places. For equality use '''dunli'''.
:'''lo mintu''' — identical
:'''lo va nanmu poi dasni lo pelxu cu mintu lo do patfu''' — ''That man wearing yellow is your father.''
:Related words: '''panra''', '''satci''', '''mapti''', '''simsa''', '''drata''', '''dunli''', '''du''', '''simxu'''</notes></valsi>
<valsi word="mipri" type="verb"><definition>x<sub>1</sub> entity keeps x<sub>2</sub> entity, property of x1 hidden from x<sub>3</sub> entity</definition><notes>, '''lo se mipri''' — concealed, hidden
:'''mi pu mipri lo torta lo verba''' — ''I hid the pie from the child.''
:Related words: '''stace''', '''mifra''', '''sivni''', '''djuno''', '''cirko''', '''jarco'''</notes></valsi>
<valsi word="mirli" type="verb"><definition>x<sub>1</sub> entity is a deer of species x<sub>2</sub> taxon</definition><notes>
:'''lo mirli''' — deer
:'''co'a lo ka jbena vau lo mirli cu kakne lo ka sanli''' — ''A baby deer can stand as soon as it is born.''
:Related words: '''mabru''', '''danlu'''</notes></valsi>
<valsi word="misno" type="verb"><definition>x<sub>1</sub> entity is famous among x<sub>2</sub> entity</definition><notes>
:'''lo misno''' — famous

:Related words: se '''sinma''', '''banli'''</notes></valsi>
<valsi word="mitre" type="verb"><definition>x<sub>1</sub> entity is x<sub>2</sub> number meters in x<sub>3</sub> property of x1</definition><notes>
:'''lo vi tanxe cu mitre li pa lo ka clani''' — ''This box is one meter in length.''
:Related words: '''kilto''', '''centi''', '''decti''', '''dekto''', '''femti''', '''gigdo''', '''gocti''', '''gotro''', '''gutci''', '''litce''', '''megdo''', '''mikri''', '''milti''', '''minli''', '''nanvi''', '''petso''', '''picti''', '''terto''', '''xatsi''', '''xecto''', '''xexso''', '''zepti''', '''zetro'''</notes></valsi>
<valsi word="mitysisku" type="verb"><definition>x<sub>1</sub> entity searches for x<sub>2</sub> entity among x<sub>3</sub> entity</definition><notes>
:'''lo mitysisku''' — searcher
:'''mi mitysisku lo sunla skaci lo nenri be lo vi kumfa''' — ''I'm looking for a woolen skirt among things in this room.''
:Related words: '''cirko''', '''kalte''', '''kavbu''', '''kucli''', '''rivbi''', '''manci''', '''facki'''</notes></valsi>
<valsi word="mixre" type="verb"><definition>x<sub>1</sub> entity is a mixture including x<sub>2</sub> plural of same type as x1</definition><notes>
:'''lo mixre''' — mixture, '''lo se mixre''' — ingredient of a mixture
:'''lo vacri cu mixre so'o gapci''' — ''Air is a mixture of several gases.''
:Related words: '''salta''', te '''runta''', '''stasu''', '''jicla''', '''sanso'''</notes></valsi>
<valsi word="mlana" type="verb"><definition>x<sub>1</sub> entity is to the side of x<sub>2</sub> entity</definition><notes>
:'''lo mlana''' — lateral

:Related words: '''lamji''', '''cpana''', '''galtu'''</notes></valsi>

:'''lo ka kucli cu catra lo mlatu''' — ''Curiosity killed the cat.''
:'''mi ralte lo mlatu e lo gerku''' — ''I keep a cat and a dog.''
:Related words: '''cinfo''', '''tigra''', '''gerku'''</notes></valsi>
<valsi word="mleca" type="verb"><definition>x<sub>1</sub> entity is less than x<sub>2</sub> entity in x<sub>3</sub> property of x1 and x2 with '''kau''' by amount x<sub>4</sub> entity</definition><notes>
:'''lo mleca''' — less, '''lo se mleca''' — more
:'''ma'i mi lo tcati cu mleca lo ckafi lo ka kukte vau lo mutce''' — ''To me tea is much less tasty than coffee.''

<valsi word="mledi" type="verb"><definition>x<sub>1</sub> entity is a mould or fungus of species x<sub>2</sub> taxon</definition><notes>
:'''lo mledi''' — mould, fungus

<valsi word="mligla" type="verb"><definition>x<sub>1</sub> entity is warm</definition><notes>
:'''lo mligla''' — warm

:Related words: '''glare''', '''milxe''', '''lenku'''</notes></valsi>
<valsi word="mluni" type="verb"><definition>x<sub>1</sub> entity is a satellite orbiting x<sub>2</sub> entity</definition><notes>

:Related words: '''planeta''', '''solri''', '''lunra'''</notes></valsi>
<valsi word="mo" type="verb"><definition>asks for the main verb (that should go into the place to which '''mo''' is put)</definition>
<notes>:'''do mo''' — ''How are you?''
:'''la lojban cu mo''' — ''What is Lojban?''
</notes></valsi><valsi word="mo'a" type="digit/number"><definition>too few</definition>
<notes>Comment: subjective estimate.
:'''mo'a snuji cu cpana lo jubme''' — ''There are too few sandwiches on the table.''
</notes></valsi><valsi word="mo'e"><definition>noun > number</definition>
<notes>Comment: turns the following noun into a number to be used in math operations.
:ends with: '''te'u'''
:'''li mo'e re gerku su'i mo'e ci mlatu du li mo'e mu danlu''' — ''Two dogs + three cats are five animals.''
</notes></valsi><valsi word="mo'i"><definition>marks event as reaching the state specified by the clause following '''mo'i'''</definition>
<notes>:'''i do mo'i ca'u cadzu''' — ''You walk towards my front.''
:'''ko catke mo'izu'a''' — ''Push it to the left.''
</notes></valsi><valsi word="mo'o"><definition>number > numbered chapter</definition>
<notes>Comment: suffix of a number that marks a chapter or section when they are ordered.
:'''pamo'o puzuku zasti falo nanmu e lo ninmu''' — ''Chapter. Long ago lived a man and a woman.''
</notes></valsi><valsi word="mo'u" type="preposition"><definition>completing, being at the expected end (completive or telic aspect), '''mo'unai''' — not having an end (incompletive or atelic aspect)</definition>
<notes>:'''mi mo'u cirko''' — ''I've lost it.''
:'''mi mo'u citka lo ro plise''' — ''I've eaten up all apples.''
:'''mo'unaiku mi pu zbasu lo dinju ze'a lo masti''' — ''I built houses for a month.''
</notes></valsi><valsi word="moi" type="verb"><definition>number > verb denoting ordinal position</definition>
<notes>Comment: x1 (entity) is the n-th member of x2 (entity) ordered by rule x3 (relation between members of x2, contains two places for '''ce'u'''). The number (n) is put in front of '''moi'''. The two '''ce'u''' in the third place can specify the sequence in which members of the set are compared..
:'''lo vi cukta cu me mi moi''' — ''This book is mine.''
:'''i mi ci moi lo pendo lo ka ce'u ce'u cinba''' — ''I kiss all but two of my friends.''
:'''lo cmaci cu romoi lo saske lo ka ce'u ce'u zmadu fi lo ka mi djica lo ka tadni makau''' — ''Math is the last subject that I want to study.''
</notes></valsi><valsi word="mokca" type="verb"><definition>x<sub>1</sub> entity is a point in time or at place x<sub>2</sub> entity</definition><notes>
:'''lo mokca''' — instant
:'''le nu jamna cu mokca po'o lo remna citri''' — ''The war is just a point in human history.''
:'''le terdi cu mokca po'o le munje''' — ''The Earth is just a point in the Universe.''
:Related words: '''jipno''', '''jganu''', '''linji''', '''stuzi''', '''tcika'''</notes></valsi>
<valsi word="moklu" type="verb"><definition>x<sub>1</sub> entity is a mouth of x<sub>2</sub> entity</definition><notes>

:Related words: '''jmive''', '''catra''', '''betri'''</notes></valsi>

:'''lo mrilu''' — mailer, '''lo se mrilu''' — mailed, '''lo xe mrilu''' — mail system

<valsi word="mu" type="digit/number"><definition>5 (digit) [five]</definition>
<notes>:'''mu bakni pu zvati le purdi''' — ''There were 5 cows in the garden.''
</notes></valsi><valsi word="mu'a" type="discursive"><definition>''for example''</definition>
<notes>:'''mi nelci lo danlu noi mu'a du lo gerku e lo mlatu''' — ''I like animals like, for example, dogs and cats.''
:Related words: '''mupli'''
</notes></valsi><valsi word="mu'i" type="preposition from '''mukti'''"><definition>''with the motive of ...''</definition>
<notes>:'''mi pu penmi la alis mu'i lo ka ciksi ro da''' — ''I met Alice in order to explain everything.''
</notes></valsi><valsi word="mu'o" type="vocative"><definition>''I am done talking. Over'' (in radio communications), '''mu'nai''' — ''more to come ... I am not done talking''</definition>

:'''ja'odai le za'u sonci pu cliva le tcadu mu'onai loi tadni''' — ''And, as you may conclude, the soldiers left the city ... no, that's not the end of the story, students.''
</notes></valsi><valsi word="mucti" type="verb"><definition>x<sub>1</sub> entity is immaterial or not physical</definition><notes>

:'''ti mupli lo ka titla vau lo vanju''' — ''This is an example of sweet wine.''

<valsi word="murta" type="verb"><definition>x<sub>1</sub> entity is a curtain for covering x<sub>2</sub> entity</definition><notes>

<valsi word="mutce" type="verb"><definition>x<sub>1</sub> entity is extreme in x<sub>2</sub> property of x1</definition><notes>
:'''lo mutce''' — extreme
:'''ti mutce lo ka kargu''' — ''This is very expensive.''
:'''mi mutce lo ka senpi''' — ''I highly doubt that.''
:Related words: '''milxe''', '''traji''', '''banli''', '''carmi''', '''nutli'''</notes></valsi>

:'''le prenu cu muvdu lo bartu le dinju lo canko''' — ''The person is moving to the outside from the building via the window.''
:Related words: '''rinci''', '''klama''', '''litru''', '''cliva''', '''fatri''', '''dunda''', '''benji''', '''preja''', '''bevri''', '''vimcu'''</notes></valsi>

<valsi word="muzga" type="verb"><definition>x<sub>1</sub> entity is a museum or zoo for preserving x<sub>2</sub> entity</definition><notes>
:'''lo muzga''' — museum

:'''ma stuzi lo muzga be lo arte''' — ''Where is the museum of art?''
:Related words: '''citri'''</notes></valsi>
<valsi word="my" type="pronoun"><definition>letter 'M'</definition>
<notes></notes></valsi><valsi word="na" type="preposition"><definition>1. ''It is not true that ...'' 2. left negator in conjunctions</definition>
<notes>:'''na ku lo mi speni cu citno''' — ''It's not true that my wife is young.''
:'''la kevin puku prami na je cinba mi''' — ''Kevin didn't love but kissed me.''
</notes></valsi><valsi word="na'e"><definition>''not...'', ''other than ...'' (on the scale). Modifies the construct to the right</definition>
<notes>:'''na'e vajni mi''' — ''It's not important to me.''
:'''do ba na'e snada''' — ''You won't make it (won't suceed).''
:'''na'e bo mi pu zukte''' — ''Not I did it.''
</notes></valsi><valsi word="na'i" type="discursive"><definition>the clause doesn't make sense (metalinguistic negator)</definition>
<notes>:'''ca ma do pu te vecnu lo ractu - le ractu na'i''' — ''When did you buy a rabbit?''
:'''i do jinvi ma lo pelmeni - na'I i mi na se slabu zo pelmeni''' — ''What do you think of pelmeni? - Nothing, I don’t know this word.''
:Related words: '''naldra''', '''nalmapti'''
</notes></valsi><valsi word="na'o" type="preposition"><definition>''by default''</definition>
<notes>:'''do na'o to'e se zdile''' — ''You are a boring person.''
</notes></valsi><valsi word="nabmi" type="verb"><definition>x<sub>1</sub> event is a problem to x<sub>2</sub> entity</definition><notes>
:'''lo nabmi''' — problem
:'''lo ka ze'a denpa na nabmi mi''' — ''To wait for a while is not a problem for me.''
:Related words: '''preti''', '''danfu''', '''ciksi''', '''jijnu''', '''jinvi''', '''nandu''', '''pensi''', '''sidbo''', '''spuda''', '''raktu'''</notes></valsi>
<valsi word="nai" type="interjection"><definition>1. opposite attitude. Used as a modifier of interjection 2. 'not', negates prepositions, pronouns, clauses, verb words 3. placed after a connective negates the part after that connective</definition>
<notes>:'''ui - uinai''' — ''Yay! - Alas!''
:'''si'u - si'unai''' — ''With help - without help''
:'''mi zgipli fi lo pipno gi'e nai certu''' — ''I play the piano but I'm not an expert.''
</notes></valsi><valsi word="najnimre" type="verb"><definition>x<sub>1</sub> is an orange of species x<sub>2</sub></definition><notes>
:'''jisra lo najnimre vau e'o''' — ''Orange juice, please!''
:Related words: '''narju''', '''nimre'''</notes></valsi>
<valsi word="nakni" type="verb"><definition>x<sub>1</sub> entity is a male of species x<sub>2</sub> taxon with masculine traits x<sub>3</sub> property of x1</definition><notes>
:'''lo nakni''' — male

:'''o'unai lo mi bersa za'o na volve''' — ''My son is still not back.''
:Related words: '''surla''', '''cnilanxe''', '''dunku'''
</notes></valsi><valsi word="obu" type="pronoun"><definition>letter 'O'</definition>
<notes></notes></valsi><valsi word="oi" type="interjection"><definition>''Darn! Ouch! Hmph'' (complaint), '''oinai''' — pleasure</definition>
<notes>:'''mi tuple oi''' — ''Ouch, my leg!''
:'''oinai vifne djacu''' — ''Fresh water, how nice .''
:Related words: '''pante''', '''pluka''', '''kufra'''
</notes></valsi><valsi word="omle" type="verb"><definition>x<sub>1</sub> entity is an omelette containing x<sub>2</sub> entity</definition><notes>
Comment: Use '''jo'u''' to specify components of the omelette in x2
:'''lo omle''' — omelette
:'''mi ba citka lo omle be lo sovda jo'u lo tamca''' — ''I will eat an omelette made with eggs and tomatoes.''
:Related words: '''tortija''', '''titnanba''', '''pitnanba''', '''salta''', '''nanba''', '''sovda''', '''ladru'''</notes></valsi>
<valsi word="onai" type="conjunction for nouns"><definition>''either ... or ...''</definition>
<notes>:'''do onai mi lumci le kumfa''' — ''Either you clean the room or I do.''
:Related words: '''jo''', '''a''', '''e''', '''ji''', '''o''', '''u'''
</notes></valsi><valsi word="pa" type="digit/number"><definition>1 (digit) [one]</definition>
<notes>:'''pa planeta cu xamgu loi remna''' — ''There is one planet for humans.''
</notes></valsi><valsi word="pa'a" type="preposition from '''panra'''"><definition>''similarly''</definition>
<notes>Comment: ???the main clause expresses the only difference.
:'''le ninmu ne pa'a la alis cu se kanla lo crino''' — ''The woman is like Alice except that the woman has green eyes.''
</notes></valsi><valsi word="pa'e" type="discursive"><definition>''Speaking impartially'', '''pa'enai''' — ''prejudice''</definition>
<notes>:'''pa'e le stasu cu xlali''' — ''In my unbiased opinion, the soup is terrible.''
:'''pa'enai lo za'u vi pixra poi mi finti cu terai xamgu''' — ''Of course I'm biased, but my paintings are the best.''
:Related words: '''tcinydracu'a''', '''tcinydrapai''', '''vudypai'''
</notes></valsi><valsi word="pa'o" type="preposition"><definition>''passing through ...''</definition>
<notes>:'''ta'i da do pu pu'i limna pa'o le rirxe''' — ''Somehow you were able to swim across the river.''
</notes></valsi><valsi word="pacna" type="verb"><definition>x<sub>1</sub> entity hopes for x<sub>2</sub> event with likelihood x<sub>3</sub> number: from 0 to 1</definition><notes>
:'''mi pacna fi li so'a fe lo nu solri ba zi''' — ''I hope it will be sunny soon.''
:Related words: '''djica'''</notes></valsi>
<valsi word="pagbu" type="verb"><definition>x<sub>1</sub> entity is a part or piece of x<sub>2</sub> entity</definition><notes>
:'''lo pagbu''' — part
:'''lo risna cu pagbu lo xadni''' — ''Heart is a part of body.''
:Related words: '''pa'u''', '''mulno''', '''xadba''', '''spisa''', '''gunma''', '''rafsi'''</notes></valsi>
<valsi word="pagre" type="verb"><definition>x<sub>1</sub> entity penetrates barrier x<sub>2</sub> entity to destination x<sub>3</sub> entity from origin x<sub>4</sub> entity</definition><notes>
:'''le trene mo'u pagre lo manku kevna lo nurma lo jarba''' — ''The train passed the dark hole to reach a rural area from the suburbs of the city.''
:Related words: '''bitmu''', '''denci''', '''ganlo''', '''kalri''', '''vorme''', '''pluta''', '''canko''', '''ragve'''</notes></valsi>
<valsi word="pai" type="digit/number"><definition>number pi (approximately '3.14159')</definition>
<notes>:'''`i li pai du li ji'i ci pi pa vo pa mu so''' — ''Number π (pi) is approximately 3.14159.''
:'''lo ni nenri be lo cirkulo be re pi'i ry cu du li pai pi'i ry te'o re''' — ''The area of a circle of diameter "2 * r" is equal to π * r<sup>2</sup>.''
</notes></valsi><valsi word="pajni" type="verb"><definition>x<sub>1</sub> entity judges matter x<sub>2</sub> proposition</definition><notes>

:'''lo pajni''' — judge, '''lo se pajni''' — matter judged

:Related words: '''cuxna''', '''jdice''', '''vajni''', '''cipra''', '''zekri''', '''manri''', '''mansa'''</notes></valsi>

<valsi word="palku" type="verb"><definition>x<sub>1</sub> entity are pants or trousers</definition><notes>
:'''lo palku''' — trousers, pants

:'''lo palne''' — tray, platter

<valsi word="palpi" type="verb"><definition>x<sub>1</sub> entity touch-feels/palpates surface x<sub>2</sub> entity</definition><notes>

<valsi word="pau" type="discursive"><definition>optional question premarker, '''paunai''' — marks the question as a rhetorical one</definition>
<notes>Comment: '''pau''' marks the question as non-rhetorical, in other words, the one that is expected to be answered. '''pau''' may be used for expressing symbol "¿" in Spanish..
:'''pau do retsku lo sedu'u ma krinu lo nu balvi vau ji lo nu pilno''' — ''You are asking of what is the reason for something happening in the future, and/or in usage.''
:'''lo prenu cu bebna ki'u ma paunai''' — ''What is that reason, and is it for something happening in the future, a usage, or both? Why people are so stupid?''
:Related words: '''preti'''
</notes></valsi><valsi word="pe"><definition>''that is about ...'' (a noun follows)</definition>
<notes>Comment: '''lo mi pendo''' is the same as '''lo pendo pe mi'''.
:'''ti du lo karce pe la alis''' — ''This is a car of my friend.''
:'''lo mi pendo cu fenki i lo pendo pe mi cu fenki''' — ''My friend is crazy.''
</notes></valsi><valsi word="pe'a"><definition>marks a construct as figurative, non-literal, metaphorical, '''pe'nai''' — marks a construct as having literal meaning</definition>
<notes>:'''lo ditcu cu jdini pe'a''' — ''Time is money.''
:'''le nanmu cu lanbi pe'a''' — ''He is a "sheep" (figuratively).''
:'''mi tavla xagji pe'a''' — ''I'm hungry for talking.''
:'''mi xagji pe'anai''' — ''I'm literally hungry.''
</notes></valsi><valsi word="pe'i" type="evidential"><definition>''In my opinion, I think''</definition>
<notes>Comment: for thinking (musing upon something) use '''pensi'''.

:'''pe'i vamji fa lonu retsku''' — ''I think it's worth asking.''
:Related words: '''jinvi'''
</notes></valsi><valsi word="pe'u" type="vocative"><definition>''Please''</definition>
<notes>Comment: the same meaning as of '''e'o''' but a vocative, thus implies a noun after it.

</notes></valsi><valsi word="pei" type="interjection modifier"><definition>''what is your attitude to it?'', ''how do you feel about it?'' (asks for the attitude). Can be used either on its own or as a modifier of interjection</definition>

:'''lo punli''' — swelling, clump

:'''lo purci''' — earlier event, past event, '''lo se purci''' — later event, future event

<valsi word="purdi" type="verb"><definition>x<sub>1</sub> entity is a garden or field of family or gardener x<sub>2</sub> entity growing crops x<sub>3</sub> entity</definition><notes>

<valsi word="purmo" type="verb"><definition>x<sub>1</sub> entity is some powder of x<sub>2</sub> entity</definition><notes>
:'''lo purmo''' — powder

<valsi word="py" type="pronoun"><definition>letter 'P'</definition>
<notes></notes></valsi><valsi word="ra" type="pronoun"><definition>a recent completed noun</definition>
<notes>:'''la alis pu tsuku lo zarci gi'e te vecnu lo plise''' — ''Alice entered a store and bought apples.''
:'''babo ra klama lo zdani''' — ''Then she went home.''
</notes></valsi><valsi word="ra'e" type="digit/number"><definition>infinite number of the same digit follows</definition>
<notes>:'''li pa fi'u ci du li pi ra'e ci''' — ''1/3 equals 0.(3)'.''
</notes></valsi><valsi word="ra'i" type="preposition from '''krasi'''"><definition>''from source, origin, starting point ...''</definition>
<notes>:'''mi pu ganse lo pluka panci pe ra'i le purdi''' — ''I felt a pleasant smell from the garden.''
</notes></valsi><valsi word="ra'o"><definition>put after particles of group GOhA and updates its meaning from the viewpoint of the current speaker</definition>
<notes>:'''- mi se pluka lo ka penmi do - go'i ra'o''' — ''- I am pleased to meet you. - Me too.''
</notes></valsi><valsi word="ra'oi"><definition>quotes one next word and treats it as a rafsi. The quoted word must be delimited by pauses (in speech) or whitespace (in writing) </definition>
<notes>Comment: rafsi sometimes can be not legal words on their own so to quote them '''ra'oi''' is useful.
:'''ra'oi kla rafsi zo klama''' — '''''kla''' is an affix from the full verb '''klama'''.''
:Related words: '''ma'oi''', '''zo'oi'''
</notes></valsi><valsi word="ra'u" type="discursive"><definition>''primarily'', ''mainly'' (in importance), '''ra'ucu'i''' — ''equally'' (in importance), '''ra'unai''' — ''incidentally'' (low in importance)</definition>
<notes>:'''ra'u ko tolxanka denpa''' — ''Above all, be patient.''
:'''ei mi gunka ije ra'ucu'i ei mi surla''' — ''I need to work.''
:'''ra'unai mi na se spaji''' — ''But with equal importance I need to relax. Incidentally, I'm not surprised.''
:Related words: '''ralju''', '''vajni'''
</notes></valsi><valsi word="racli" type="verb"><definition>x<sub>1</sub> entity is rational or sane</definition><notes>
:'''lo racli''' — rational event, sane event

:'''mi pu rivbi lo ka bilma vau lo ka zenba lo ka citka vau gi'e jinru lo glare djacu''' — ''I avoided becoming ill by eating more and plunging into hot water.''
:'''le prenu pu rivbi loi pulji''' — ''The person evaded the police.''
:Related words: '''bandu''', '''fanta''', '''se''' '''jersi''', '''sisku''', '''kalte''', '''fapro'''</notes></valsi>
<valsi word="ro" type="digit/number"><definition>each, all</definition>
<notes>:'''ro lo mi pendo cu cusku lo se du'u mi simlu lo ka tatpi''' — ''All of my friends say that I look tired.''
</notes></valsi><valsi word="ro'a" type="emotion category/modifier"><definition>interacting socially (communication, customs), '''ro'acu'i''' — not focused towards interacting socially, '''ro'anai''' — focused away from interacting socially</definition>
<notes>Comment: used without an attitudinal to indicate focus of the speaker..
:'''oi ro'a caku mi se cfipu''' — ''Awkward .''
:'''ui ro'a cu'i mi cikre lo mi skami''' — ''I'm confused.''
:'''uinairo'a no da zvati ti''' — ''I'm just puttering here by myself, fixing my computer. I feel so lonely, nobody is here.''
:Related words: '''jikca'''
</notes></valsi><valsi word="ro'e" type="emotion category/modifier"><definition>mental/intellectual/thought aspect, '''ro'ecu'i''' — not focused towards contemplating, '''ro'enai''' — mindless action</definition>
<notes>Comment: used without an interjection to indicate focus of the speaker..
:'''uiro'e mi morji''' — ''Yay, I remember!''
:'''a'i ro'e cu'i mi ba zukte''' — ''I will do it not putting much intellectual effort.''
:'''do marveli iuro'enai''' — ''There is no logic in it, you are just wonderful.''
:Related words: '''menli'''
</notes></valsi><valsi word="ro'i" type="emotion category/modifier"><definition>emotionally, '''ro'icu'i''' — non-emotionally, '''ro'inai''' — denying emotions</definition>

:'''uiro'inaido snada''' — ''No rejoicing from me, you won.''
:Related words: '''cinmo'''
</notes></valsi><valsi word="ro'o" type="emotion category/modifier"><definition>restricted physical body, '''ro'ocu'i''' — not oriented towards physical experience, '''ro'onai''' — denying physical experience</definition>

:'''ii ro'o cu'i ka'e kargu''' — ''I'm afraid it can be expensive.''

:'''lo vi ru'inai gusni cu du'eva'e savru mi lo ka se viska''' — ''These flashes are too noisy.''

<valsi word="sazri" type="verb"><definition>x<sub>1</sub> entity operates machine x<sub>2</sub> entity with goal x<sub>3</sub> property of x1</definition><notes>
:'''lo sazri''' — driver, operator, '''lo se sazri''' — driven, operated
:'''lo mi pendo pu sazri lo minji lo ka kakpa lo dertu''' — ''My friend operated the machine to dig ground.''
:Related words: '''gidva''', '''xlura''', '''pilno''', '''tutci''', '''jitro''', '''gunka'''</notes></valsi>
<valsi word="se" type="place converter"><definition>switches 1st and 2nd places</definition>
<notes>:'''mi se slabu le nanmu''' — ''I am familiar with the man.''
:'''va'i le nanmu cu slabu mi''' — ''In other words, the man is familiar to me.''
</notes></valsi><valsi word="se du'u" type="clause prefix"><definition>clause > quote</definition>
<notes>Comment: x1 (text) is the sentence expressing the clause x2. Used for reported speech.
:'''mi pu cusku fi la eduard fe lo se du'u lo mi karce cu spofu''' — ''I told Eduard that my car is broken.''
</notes></valsi><valsi word="se ja'e" type="preposition from '''se''' '''jalge'''"><definition>''resulting from ...''</definition>
<notes>:'''seja'e lo nu mi pu cinmo lo mabla vau mi pu gunka no da''' — ''Because of my bad mood I didn't work.''
</notes></valsi><valsi word="se'a" type="interjection modifier"><definition>self-sufficiency, '''se'anai''' — dependency</definition>
<notes>:'''fa se'a le verba pu kelci''' — ''The child played by himself.''
:'''fa se'anai le cifnu cu cadzu''' — ''The infant walks but not by himself.''
:Related words: '''sezysei''', '''kantcu'''
</notes></valsi><valsi word="se'i" type="interjection modifier"><definition>interjection is self-oriented, '''se'inai''' — interjection is oriented towards others.</definition>
<notes>:'''oi se'i mi pu srera''' — ''Oh, I made a mistake.''
:'''oi se'i nai da spofu botpi bu'u lo loldi''' — ''Someone would be discontented, there is a broken bottle on the floor.''
:Related words: '''sevzi''', '''drata'''
</notes></valsi><valsi word="se'o" type="evidential"><definition>''I know from a dream, vision, or personal revelation''</definition>
<notes>Comment: '''za'a''' is for expressing external experience, '''se'o''' is for expressing internal experience..
:'''se'o do ba snada''' — ''I have a feeling you will succeed.''
:Related words: '''senva'''
</notes></valsi><valsi word="se'u" type="terminator"><notes>:starts with: '''SEI'''
</notes></valsi><valsi word="seba'i" type="preposition from '''se''' '''basti'''"><definition>''instead'', ''being a replacement of ...''</definition>
<notes>:'''seba'iku mi pu citka lo torta''' — ''Instead, I ate a cake.''
:'''mi ne seba'i do pu zukte''' — ''I did it instead of you.''
</notes></valsi><valsi word="secau" type="preposition from '''se''' '''claxu'''"><definition>''lacking ...''</definition>
<notes>:'''lo mi pendo ce mi pu tsuku lo cizra stuzi secau lo ka sanji lo du'u ka'e ckape''' — ''My friend and I arrived at a strange place lacking the awareness that it can be dangerous.''
</notes></valsi><valsi word="sefta" type="verb"><definition>x<sub>1</sub> entity is a surface of object x<sub>2</sub> entity</definition><notes>
:'''lo sefta''' — surface
:'''lo sefta be lo najnimre cu xutla''' — ''The orange has a soft surface.''
:Related words: '''crane''', '''flira''', '''plita''', '''bliku'''</notes></valsi>
<valsi word="sei"><definition>verb > interjection</definition>
<notes>:'''sei mi morji do sampla''' — ''As I remember, you are a programmer.''
:'''sei mi bebna le zarci cu se stuzi lo drata''' — ''Silly me, the store is in another place.''
</notes></valsi><valsi word="seka'a" type="preposition from '''se''' '''klama'''"><definition>''going to ...''</definition>
<notes>:'''mi pu cadzu seka'a le rirxe''' — ''I walked to the river.''
</notes></valsi><valsi word="seksi" type="verb"><definition>x<sub>1</sub> entity in activity or state x<sub>2</sub> property of x1 exhibits biological or social sexuality x<sub>3</sub> property of x1</definition><notes>
Comment: ???see erotic
:'''lo seksi''' — sexy, '''lo se seksi''' — sexual activity, '''lo te seksi''' — social gender, biological gender
:'''lo vi finpe ca seksi lo ka punji lo sovda vau lo ka fetsi''' — ''This fish demonstrates its female sexuality by laying eggs.''
:'''do seksi lo ka se asna vau lo ka ninmu le tigni cu seksi lo ka dasni lo tordu skaci vau lo ka ninmu''' — ''You took a sexy feminine pose. The actor shows her female sexuality by wearing a short skirt.''
:Related words: '''gletu''', '''pinji''', '''plibu''', '''vibna''', '''vlagi'''</notes></valsi>
<valsi word="selbrivla" type="verb"><definition>x<sub>1</sub> text is a morphologically defined predicate word, verb word</definition><notes>
:'''lo selbrivla''' — verb word
:'''zo mlatu selbrivla''' — ''mlatu is a selbrivla.''
:Related words: '''lujvo''', '''gismu''', '''zi'evla''', '''cmavo'''</notes></valsi>
<valsi word="selci" type="verb"><definition>x<sub>1</sub> entity is a cell, atom, basic subunit of body x<sub>2</sub> entity</definition><notes>
Comment: '''kantu''' allows to express properties of particles
:'''lo selci''' — indivisible, cell, atom, basic subunit
:'''mu'onai ro selci be lo xadni cu cmima pa lo so'i klesi''' — ''Furthermore, each cell in the body belongs to one out of many classes.''
:Related words: '''kantu''', '''ratni''', '''gradu'''</notes></valsi>
<valsi word="selfu" type="verb"><definition>x<sub>1</sub> entity serves x<sub>2</sub> entity with service x<sub>3</sub> property of x1</definition><notes>
:'''lo selfu''' — servant, '''lo te selfu''' — a service
:'''le gerku cu selfu mi lo ka bevri lo cutci''' — ''The dog serves me by bringing shoes.''
:Related words: '''sidju''', '''sarji''', '''gunka'''</notes></valsi>
<valsi word="semau" type="preposition from '''se''' '''zmadu'''"><definition>''more than ...''</definition>
<notes>Comment: x1 of the clause corresponds to '''lo zmadu''' — ''more', preposition sumti corresponds to '''lo se zmadu''' — ''than ...', the clause itself corresponds to '''lo te zmadu''' — the comparison.
:'''mi cu nelci do semau la alis''' — ''I like you more than Alice likes you.''
:'''mi nelci do pe semau la alis''' — ''I like you more than Alice.''
</notes></valsi><valsi word="seme'a" type="preposition from '''se''' '''mleca'''"><definition>''less than ...''</definition>
<notes>Comment: x1 of the clause corresponds to '''lo mleca''' — ''less', preposition sumti corresponds to '''lo se mleca''' — ''less than ...', the clause itself corresponds to '''lo te mleca''' — the comparison.
:'''mi nelci do seme'a la alis''' — ''I like you less than Alice likes you.''
</notes></valsi><valsi word="senci" type="verb"><definition>x<sub>1</sub> entity sneezes</definition><notes>
:'''gau ko ganlo fa lo moklu be do ca lo nu do senci ja kafke''' — ''Cover your mouth when you sneeze or cough.''
:Related words: '''bilma''', '''kafke'''</notes></valsi>
<valsi word="seni'i" type="preposition from '''nibli'''"><definition>''logically'', ''logically because ...''</definition>
<notes>:'''ro gerku cu danlu iseni'inai bo ro danlu cu gerku''' — ''All dogs are animals.''
:'''mi pu na zvati le tcadu''' — ''However, it doesn't follow from that that all animals are dogs.''
:'''seni'i bo ka'enai ku mi penmi la kevin''' — ''I wasn't in the city so I couldn't meet Alice.''
:'''ro gerku cu danlu iseni'inai bo ro danlu cu gerku''' — ''All dogs are animals. However, that doesn't mean that all animals are dogs.''
</notes></valsi><valsi word="seni'i" type="preposition from '''nibli'''"><definition>''logically'', ''logically because ...''</definition>
<notes>:'''ro gerku cu danlu iseni'inai bo ro danlu cu gerku''' — ''All dogs are animals.''
:'''mi pu na zvati le tcadu''' — ''However, it doesn't follow from that that all animals are dogs.''
:'''seni'i bo ka'enai ku mi penmi la kevin''' — ''I wasn't in the city so I couldn't meet Alice.''
:'''ro gerku cu danlu iseni'inai bo ro danlu cu gerku''' — ''All dogs are animals. However, that doesn't mean that all animals are dogs.''
</notes></valsi><valsi word="senpi" type="verb"><definition>x<sub>1</sub> entity doubts that x<sub>2</sub> proposition is true</definition><notes>
:'''lo senpi''' — irresolute
:'''mi senpi lo du'u ba carvi''' — ''I doubt if it will rain.''
:'''lo jalge ca'o se senpi''' — ''The result is still in doubt.''
:Related words: '''jinvi''', '''krici''', '''djuno''', '''birti'''</notes></valsi>
<valsi word="senta" type="verb"><definition>x<sub>1</sub> entity is a layer of material x<sub>2</sub> entity within structure x<sub>3</sub> entity</definition><notes>
:'''lo senta''' — layer
:'''ti senta lo spati lo cmana ce lo vacri''' — ''This is a layer of plants between the mountain and the air.''
:Related words: '''flecu''', '''nenri''', '''rirxe''', '''sepli''', '''snuji''', '''jbini''', '''bitmu''', '''sruri''', '''skalera'''</notes></valsi>
<valsi word="senva" type="verb"><definition>x<sub>1</sub> entity dreams about x<sub>2</sub> event</definition><notes>
:'''lo senva''' — dreamer, '''lo se senva''' — dream
:'''mi senva lo nu mi vofli ne'i lo dilnu''' — ''I dream about flying in the clouds.''
:'''mi senva tu'a lo sance be lo carvi''' — ''I dream the sound of rain.''
:Related words: '''sipna''', '''xanri'''</notes></valsi>
<valsi word="sepi'o" type="preposition from '''se''' '''pilno'''"><definition>''with ...'', ''using ...''</definition>
<notes>Comment: x1 of the clause corresponds to '''lo pilno''' — ''user', preposition sumti corresponds to '''lo se pilno''' — ''used thing', the clause itself corresponds to '''lo te pilno''' — the goal of using it. "with" for "accompanying" is '''ka'ai'''.
:'''mi citka sepi'o lo forca i mi pe sepi'o lo forca cu citka''' — ''I eat with a fork.''
</notes></valsi><valsi word="sepli" type="verb"><definition>x<sub>1</sub> entity is separate from x<sub>2</sub> entity , separated by x<sub>3</sub> entity</definition><notes>
:'''lo sepli''' — separate
:'''zo''' — '''''i''' separates sentence from sentence.''

:'''lo mi briju cu sepli lo zdani zo'ei ze'a lo cacra i lo xamsi ti ma sepli''' — ''What is the distance to the sea?''
:Related words: '''bitmu''', '''snuji''', '''senta''', '''fendi''', '''curve''', '''jinsa''', '''bitmu''', '''marbi'''</notes></valsi>
<valsi word="serai" type="preposition from '''se''' '''traji'''"><notes>Comment: the preposition sumti corresponds to '''lo se traji''' — comparison, x1 of the clause corresponds to the most one in this comparison.
:'''mi roroi jinga serai lo ka clani''' — ''I always win being the tallest one.''
</notes></valsi><valsi word="setca" type="verb"><definition>x<sub>1</sub> entity inserts or puts x<sub>2</sub> entity into x<sub>3</sub> entity</definition><notes>, '''lo se setca''' — inserted

<valsi word="seva'u" type="preposition from '''xamgu'''"><definition>''for ...'', ''for the benefit of ...''</definition>

</notes></valsi><valsi word="sevzi" type="verb"><definition>x<sub>1</sub> entity is a self of x<sub>2</sub> entity: by default x1</definition><notes>
Comment: '''sevzi''' is usually used in lujvo. Outside lujvo '''lo''' '''nei''' is usually used instead
