<valsi word="sfasa" type="verb"><definition>x<sub>1</sub> entity punishes x<sub>2</sub> entity for x<sub>3</sub> property of x2 with punishment x<sub>4</sub> property of x1</definition><notes>, '''lo se sfasa''' — punished, '''lo te sfasa''' — reason for punishment, '''lo ve sfasa''' — punishment
:'''le rirni pu sfasa le verba lo ka jai gau spofu fai lo palta vau lo ka na permite vo'e lo ka kelci bu'u lo zdani''' — ''The parent punished the child for breaking the plate by not allowing to play at home.''

:'''lo sfofa''' — sofa

<valsi word="sfubu" type="verb"><definition>x<sub>1</sub> entity dives or swoops to x<sub>2</sub> entity from x<sub>3</sub> entity</definition><notes>
:'''lo sfubu''' — diver
:'''mi pu sfubu lo lenku djacu lo lelxu korbi''' — ''.''
:Related words: '''farlu'''</notes></valsi>
<valsi word="si"><definition>erases one last Lojban word. non-Lojban text is treated as one word</definition>
<notes>:'''au mi citka lo kokso si perli''' — ''I'd like to eat a coconut, no, pear!''
</notes></valsi><valsi word="si'a" type="discursive"><definition>''similarly'', '''si'nai''' — ''not similarly''</definition>
<notes>Comment: '''ji'a''' means 'additionally', '''si'a''' means 'similarly' implying that there is another salient difference..
:'''mi si'a pu vitke le tcadu''' — ''I also visited the city (just in another year).''

:Related words: '''simsa''', '''panra'''
</notes></valsi><valsi word="si'au" type="evidential"><definition>''It seems''</definition>
<notes>:'''si'au le fetsi cu xebni do''' — ''It seems, she hates you.''
:'''si'au le ctuca pu co'u pacna''' — ''It seems, the teacher was disappointed.''
</notes></valsi><valsi word="si'e" type="verb"><definition>number > verb denoting portion</definition>
<notes>Comment: x1 (entity) is the n-th portion of mass x2 (entity). The number (n) is put in front of si'e'''.

:'''ku'i sy mo'asi'e lo se gugde''' — ''But they represent a too small fraction of citizens.''
</notes></valsi><valsi word="si'o" type="clause prefix"><definition>clause > verb</definition>
<notes>Comment: x1 is x2's concept described in the clause that follows.

</notes></valsi><valsi word="si'u" type="preposition from '''sidju'''"><definition>''with the help of ...''</definition>
<notes>Comment: x1 of the clause corresponds to '''lo sidju''' — ''who helps', preposition sumti corresponds to '''lo se sidju''' — ''the one being helped', the clause itself corresponds to '''lo te sidju''' — ''the situation in which one helps.

:'''zoi gy. drip fry .gy. tanru''' — ''drip fry is a tanru.''

<notes>:'''da pu renro lo rokci to'o le bitmu''' — ''Someone threw a stone from the direction of the fence.''

<notes>:'''to'u mi na djuno lo danfu''' — ''In short, I don't know the answer.''
:'''to'unai mi cliva ca lo lamji vanci''' — ''In detail, I leave this evening.''
:Related words: '''tordu''', '''clani''', '''tcidu'''
</notes></valsi><valsi word="toi" type="terminator"><definition>seldom elidable except at end of text</definition>
<notes>:starts with: '''to'''
</notes></valsi><valsi word="toknu" type="verb"><definition>x<sub>1</sub> entity is an oven for heating x<sub>2</sub> entity</definition><notes>
:'''lo toknu''' — oven, '''lo se toknu''' — baked in an oven
:'''ti toknu lo cidja''' — ''This is an oven for cooking food.''
:'''tu tokun lo mudri''' — ''And that is a wood burning stove.''
:Related words: '''nanba'''</notes></valsi>
<valsi word="tolckire" type="verb"><definition>x<sub>1</sub> entity feels resentment, bitterness towards x<sub>2</sub> entity for action x<sub>3</sub> property of x2</definition><notes>
:'''lo tolckire''' — resentful
:'''mi pu tolckire le ninmu lo ka tarti lo xlali''' — ''I felt resentful of this lady's bad behavior.''
:Related words: '''to'e''', '''ckire'''</notes></valsi>
<valsi word="tolcri" type="verb"><definition>x<sub>1</sub> entity finds x<sub>2</sub> property of x1 at x<sub>3</sub></definition><notes>, '''lo se tolcri''' — found (in possesion)
:'''mi pu tolcri lo penbi lo va kumfa''' — ''I found the pen in that room.''
:Related words: '''facki''', '''ralte''', '''sisku''', '''claxu''', '''jinga''', '''pleji''', '''canja''', '''sfasa''', '''dapma''', '''binra''', '''mipri'''</notes></valsi>
<valsi word="toldi" type="verb"><definition>x<sub>1</sub> entity is a butterfly or moth of species x<sub>2</sub> taxon</definition><notes>
:'''lo toldi''' — butterfly, moth
:'''mi zgana lo tadji be lo nu lo toldi cu vofli''' — ''I observe how butterflies fly.''
:Related words: '''cinki'''</notes></valsi>
<valsi word="tolna'e" type="verb"><definition>x<sub>1</sub> proposition confirms, is an evidence for x<sub>2</sub> proposition</definition><notes>
:'''lo tolna'e''' — evidence
:'''lo du'u la kevin na xagji cu tolna'e lo du'u ky pu citka lo torta''' — ''The fact that Kevin is not hungry is the evidence that he ate the cake.''
:'''tolna'e lo du'u mi na ba jinga''' — ''It's clear that I won't win.''
:Related words: '''natfe''', '''nibli''', '''tugni''', '''zanru''', '''xusra'''</notes></valsi>
<valsi word="tolpo'u" type="verb"><definition>x<sub>1</sub> entity is functional, usable property of x1; x1 is capable of performing functions x2 </definition><notes>
:'''lo tolpo'u''' — functional, usable
:'''lo minji cu tolpo'u''' — ''The machine is functional.''
:Related words: '''to'e''', '''spofu''', '''akti''', '''kakne'''</notes></valsi>
<valsi word="toltinsa" type="verb"><definition>x<sub>1</sub> entity is flexible in direction x<sub>2</sub> entity under force x<sub>3</sub> event</definition><notes>
:'''lo toltinsa''' — flexible
:'''do simlu lo ka toltinsa lo ka tarti makau vau lo se cpedu be lo se prami be do''' — ''You seem to be flexible in your behavior under requests of your loved one.''
:Related words: '''tinsa''', '''bapli''', '''jdari''', '''nandu''', '''torni''', '''trati''', '''xarnu''', '''danre''', '''stodi'''</notes></valsi>
<valsi word="tonga" type="verb"><definition>x<sub>1</sub> sound is a tone of pitch x<sub>2</sub> entity</definition><notes>
:'''lo tonga''' — tone, '''lo se tonga''' — tone pitch
:'''lo cipni ta'e bacru lo tonga be lo barda''' — ''The bird produces a high pitch.''
:'''lo bakni cu bacru lo tonga be lo cmalu''' — ''Cows produces low pitch.''
:Related words: '''rilti''', '''zgike''', '''janbe''', '''siclu'''</notes></valsi>
<valsi word="tordu" type="verb"><definition>x<sub>1</sub> entity is short in length/width etc. x<sub>2</sub> property of x1</definition><notes>
Comment: The first largest dimension. '''tordu''', '''jarki''' and '''cinla''' specify the three dimensions of objects
:'''lo tordu''' — short
:'''lo vi uenzi cu tordu lo ni valsi''' — ''This text is short in the number of words.''
:Related words: '''cmalu''', '''jarki''', '''caxno''', '''cinla''', '''clani'''</notes></valsi>
<valsi word="torni" type="verb"><definition>x<sub>1</sub> entity twists under force x<sub>2</sub> event</definition><notes>
:'''lo torni''' — twisting
:'''mi mo'u jai se torni lo tornozelo''' — ''I twisted my ankle.''
:Related words: '''tinsa''', '''trati'''</notes></valsi>
<valsi word="tornozelo" type="verb"><definition>x<sub>1</sub> entity is an ankle of x<sub>2</sub> entity</definition><notes>
:'''lo tornozelo''' — ankle
:'''lo djacu pu lamji lo tornozelo be ra''' — ''The water reached her ankles.''
:Related words: '''cidni''', '''jamfu''', '''tuple''', '''jorne'''</notes></valsi>
<valsi word="torta" type="verb"><definition>x<sub>1</sub> entity is some cake, torte, tart, pie, flan made of/containing ingredients x<sub>2</sub> entity</definition><notes>
:'''lo torta''' — cake, torte, tart, pie, flan
:'''ti pu torta lo grute e lo kruji e lo nanba''' — ''This was a cake made of fruits, cream and bread.''
:Related words: '''nanba''', '''panlo''', '''toknu'''</notes></valsi>
<valsi word="traduki" type="verb"><definition>x<sub>1</sub> entity translates x<sub>2</sub> text to x<sub>3</sub> text</definition><notes>
Comment: x2 and x3 can be filled with names denoting languages e.g. '''glico'''.
:'''lo traduki''' — translator, interpreter, '''lo se traduki''' — text translated
:'''do traduki zoi gy.Yay, hello!.gy. ma poi lojbo''' — ''How would you translate "Yay, hello!" to Lojban?''
:'''mi traduki lo glico lo lojbo''' — ''I translate from English to Lojban.''
:Related words: '''uenzi''', '''cusku'''</notes></valsi>
<valsi word="traji" type="verb"><definition>x<sub>1</sub> entity is utmost in x<sub>2</sub> property of x1 and x3 among x<sub>3</sub> entity</definition><notes>
Comment: '''milxe''' and '''mutce''' don't have similar x3
:'''lo traji''' — utmost, most
:'''la alis cu traji lo ka clani vau lo nixli pe lo vi ckule''' — ''Alice is the tallest among girls of this school.''
:Related words: '''rai''', '''jimte''', '''milxe''', '''mutce''', '''banli''', '''curve''', '''fanmo''', '''krasi''', '''manfo''', '''prane''', '''zmadu''', '''mleca'''</notes></valsi>
<valsi word="trano" type="verb"><definition>x<sub>1</sub> entity is a quantity of nitrogen</definition><notes>
:'''lo trano''' — nitrogen
:'''lo vacri cu vasru lo kijno e lo trano''' — ''The air consists of oxygen and nitrogen.''
:Related words: '''vacri'''</notes></valsi>
<valsi word="trati" type="verb"><definition>x<sub>1</sub> entity is taut, strained in direction x<sub>2</sub> property of x1</definition><notes>
:'''lo trati''' — taut, strained
:'''le taxfu cu tarti lo ka pinta''' — ''The dress is strained in horizontal direction.''
:Related words: '''tinsa''', '''torni''', '''tagji''', '''tcena''', '''kluza'''</notes></valsi>
<valsi word="trene" type="verb"><definition>x<sub>1</sub> entity is a train of cars x<sub>2</sub> plural of entity</definition><notes>
:'''lo trene''' — train (of cars), '''lo se trene''' — car of a train, carriage (of a train)
:'''ti trene mu da''' — ''This train consists of 5 cars.''
:Related words: '''tcana'''</notes></valsi>
<valsi word="tricu" type="verb"><definition>x<sub>1</sub> entity is a tree of species x<sub>2</sub> taxon</definition><notes>
:'''lo tricu''' — tree
:'''lo cribe cu kakne lo ka cpare lo tricu''' — ''A bear can climb a tree.''
:Related words: '''cindu''', '''ckunu''', '''pezli''', '''mudri''', '''spati'''</notes></valsi>
<valsi word="trina" type="verb"><definition>x<sub>1</sub> entity attracts x<sub>2</sub> entity with x<sub>3</sub> property of x1</definition><notes>
:'''lo trina''' — attractive, '''lo se trina''' — attracted
:'''lo jibri cu trina mi lo ka mi zifre lo ka cliva lo briju ca lo nu mi djica''' — ''The job attracts me in that I may leave the office when I want.''
:Related words: '''djica''', '''nelci''', '''rigni''', '''xlura''', '''magneti'''</notes></valsi>
<valsi word="trixe" type="verb"><definition>x<sub>1</sub> entity is behind x<sub>2</sub> entity in frame of reference x<sub>3</sub> entity</definition><notes>
:'''lo karce cu trixe lo tricu lo canko''' — ''The car is behind the tree when viewed from the window.''
:Related words: '''crane''', '''rebla''', '''mlana''', '''pritu''', '''zunle'''</notes></valsi>
<valsi word="troci" type="verb"><definition>x<sub>1</sub> entity tries to do x<sub>2</sub> property of x1</definition><notes>, '''lo se troci''' — something tried
:'''mi ba troci lo ka cpare lo tricu''' — ''I will try to climb the tree.''
:'''fa po'o lo troci cu snada''' — ''Only the one who tries succeeds.''
:'''ku'i lo troci po'o cu fliba''' — ''But the one who only tries fails.''
:Related words: '''fliba''', '''snada''', '''cipra'''</notes></valsi>
<valsi word="tsali" type="verb"><definition>x<sub>1</sub> entity is strong in property x<sub>2</sub> property of x1</definition><notes>
:'''lo tsali''' — strong
:'''do tsali lo ka lafti lo tilju''' — ''You are strong in lifting heavy objects.''
:Related words: '''ralci''', '''ruble''', '''carmi''', '''vlipa'''</notes></valsi>
<valsi word="tsani" type="verb"><definition>x<sub>1</sub> entity is the sky at place x<sub>2</sub> entity</definition><notes>
:'''lo tsani''' — sky
:'''lo tsani be lo xamsi cu klina gi'e banli''' — ''The sky in the sea is clean and magnificent.''
:Related words: '''gapru''', '''kensa''', '''tarci''', '''terdi'''</notes></valsi>
<valsi word="tsapi" type="verb"><definition>x<sub>1</sub> entity is a spice or seasoning causing flavor x<sub>2</sub> entity</definition><notes>
:'''lo tsapi''' — spice, seasoning, '''lo se tsapi''' — flavour of a seasoning, flavor of a seasoning
:'''lo vi cidja cu culno lo tsapi be lo cpina''' — ''This food is rich in hot spices.''
:Related words: '''vrusi'''</notes></valsi>
<valsi word="tsiju" type="verb"><definition>x<sub>1</sub> entity is a seed, fertilized cell of organism x<sub>2</sub> entity for producing offspring x<sub>3</sub> entity</definition><notes>
:'''lo tsiju''' — seed, fertilized cell
:'''ti tsiju lo manti lo mamta''' — ''This is a fertilized cell producing ant queen.''
:Related words: '''tarbi''', '''dembi''', '''grute''', '''jbari''', '''sombo''', '''spati''', '''sovda'''</notes></valsi>
<valsi word="tsina" type="verb"><definition>x<sub>1</sub> entity is a platform or stage at x<sub>2</sub> entity supporting x<sub>3</sub> entity</definition><notes>
:'''lo tsina''' — platform, stage
:'''lo tsani cu tsina pe'a lo galtu lo tarci''' — ''The sky is a high "pedestral" for stars.''
:Related words: '''greku''', '''jubme'''</notes></valsi>
<valsi word="tsuku" type="verb"><definition>x<sub>1</sub> entity arrives at x<sub>2</sub> entity, property of x1 via x<sub>3</sub> entity; x1 reaches x2</definition><notes>, '''lo se tsuku''' — place of arrival
:'''mi tsuku lo xotli lo ralju klaji''' — ''I arrived at the hotel via the main street.''
:'''mi kakne lo ka tsuku lo cmana''' — ''I can reach the mountain.''
:'''lo nu mi tsuku pu spaji le za'umei''' — ''My arrival surprised them.''</notes></valsi>
<valsi word="tu" type="pronoun"><definition>''that over there''</definition>
<notes>:'''u'ecai tu mo''' — ''Oh my, what is that over there?''
</notes></valsi><valsi word="tu'a"><definition>refers to a noun inside an abstraction noun. "'''tu'a''' [noun]" is equivalent to "'''lo''' '''nu''' '''co'e''' [noun]"</definition>
<notes>:'''mi djica tu'a lo plise''' — ''I want an apple. I want to do something with an apple (probably, to eat it).''
</notes></valsi><valsi word="tu'e"><definition>'''tu'e''' ... '''tu'u''' — brackets for grouping sentences</definition>
<notes>:ends with: '''tu'u'''
:'''mi cadzu ka'ai le gerku''' — ''I will walk with the dog.''
:'''je ba tu'e mi ba jukpa lo nanba i ja ca bo mi lumci le kumfa tu'u''' — ''And then I will either cook the bread or clean the room or doth both at the same time.''
</notes></valsi><valsi word="tu'o" type="digit/number"><definition>null operand (used in unary mekso operations)</definition>
<notes>Comment: outside math formulae used to indicate that number can't be applied to the noun.
:'''tu'o sluni cu zvati le patxu''' — ''There is a mash of oinons in the pot.''
:Related words: '''zi'o'''
</notes></valsi><valsi word="tu'u"><definition>seldom elidable</definition>
<notes>:starts with: '''tu'e'''
</notes></valsi><valsi word="tubnu" type="verb"><definition>x<sub>1</sub> entity is a tube made of x<sub>2</sub> entity with the hole made of x<sub>3</sub> entity</definition><notes>
Comment: Also sleeves, hoses. For hollow pipes, x3 can be air, water, etc.
:'''lo tubnu''' — tube, '''lo se tubnu''' — material of a tube, '''lo te tubnu''' — content of a tube
:'''lo vi ponjo se sanmi cu tubnu lo rismi lo finpe sovda''' — ''This Japanese meal is a tube of rice with caviar as its filling.''
:Related words: '''kevna''', '''canlu''', '''slanu''', '''kamju'''</notes></valsi>
<valsi word="tugni" type="verb"><definition>x<sub>1</sub> entity agrees with x<sub>2</sub> entity that x<sub>3</sub> proposition is true</definition><notes>
:'''mi tugni do lo nu lo vi purdi cu melbi''' — ''I agree with you that this is a beautiful garden.''
:Related words: '''sarxe''', '''mapti''', '''darlu''', '''natfe''', '''panpi''', '''sarji'''</notes></valsi>
<valsi word="tujli" type="verb"><definition>x<sub>1</sub> entity is a tulip of species x<sub>2</sub> taxon</definition><notes>
:'''lo tujli''' — tulip
:'''lo tujli bazi se flora''' — ''The tulips will bloom soon.''
:Related words: '''spati'''</notes></valsi>
<valsi word="tumla" type="verb"><definition>x<sub>1</sub> entity is a parcel of land at x<sub>2</sub> entity</definition><notes>
:'''lo tumla''' — terrain, parcel of land
:'''ti tumla lo drata gugde''' — ''This is a land of another country.''
:Related words: '''vacri''', '''xamsi''', '''tutra''', '''gugde''', '''xamsi'''</notes></valsi>
<valsi word="tunba" type="verb"><definition>x<sub>1</sub> entity is a sibling of x<sub>2</sub> entity by bond x<sub>3</sub> property of x1</definition><notes>
Comment: x3 defines parent of x1 and x2
:'''lo tunba''' — sibling
:'''do tunba mi lo ka se mamta gi'e se patfu''' — ''You are my sibling since we are born from the same mother and father.''
:Related words: '''bruna''', '''mensi''', '''tamne'''</notes></valsi>
<valsi word="tunka" type="verb"><definition>x<sub>1</sub> entity is a quantity of copper</definition><notes>
:'''lo tunka''' — copper
:'''xu lo tunka cu narju''' — ''Is copper orange?''
:Related words: '''jinme''', '''lastu''', '''ransu'''</notes></valsi>
<valsi word="tunlo" type="verb"><definition>x<sub>1</sub> entity swallows</definition><notes>
:'''ra pu tunlo''' — ''He made a swallowing movement.''
:Related words: '''citka''', '''pinxe''', '''galxe'''</notes></valsi>
<valsi word="tunta" type="verb"><definition>x<sub>1</sub> entity pokes, stabs, pricks x<sub>2</sub> entity</definition><notes>
:'''lo dakfu cu tunta lo tuple be mi''' — ''The knife is poking my leg.''
:Related words: '''balre''', '''dakfu''', '''darxi''', '''fanza''', '''jicla''', '''katna''', '''tikpa'''</notes></valsi>
<valsi word="tuple" type="verb"><definition>x<sub>1</sub> entity is a leg of x<sub>2</sub> entity</definition><notes>
:'''lo tuple''' — leg
:'''je'u ma'a se tuple vo da''' — ''We actually have four legs.''
:Related words: '''stani''', '''zbepi''', '''jamfu''', '''jimca''', '''sanli'''</notes></valsi>
<valsi word="turni" type="verb"><definition>x<sub>1</sub> entity governs people or domain x<sub>2</sub> entity</definition><notes>
:'''lo turni''' — governor
:'''ra turni lo bu'u gugde''' — ''He governs this country.''
:Related words: '''catni''', '''minde''', '''tutra''', '''jecta''', '''gugde''', '''ponse''', '''jitro'''</notes></valsi>
<valsi word="tutci" type="verb"><definition>x<sub>1</sub> entity is a tool used for x<sub>2</sub> property of x1</definition><notes>
Comment: basic tool types: '''salpo''', '''pulni''', '''cfine''', '''klupe''', '''jendu''', '''xislu''', '''vraga''', '''balre''', '''mruli''', '''cinza''', '''garna''', '''pijne''', '''pambe''', '''canpa''', utensils: '''forca''', '''smuci''', '''dakfu'''
:'''lo tutci''' — tool, '''lo se tutci''' — purpose of a tool
:'''lo vlaste cu plixau tutci lo nu tadni lo bangu''' — ''Dictionary is a useful tool for studying languages.''
:Related words: '''cabra''', '''minji''', '''se''' '''pilno''', '''zukte''', '''sazri''', '''salpo''', '''pulni''', '''cfine''', '''klupe''', '''jendu''', '''xislu''', '''vraga''', '''balre''', '''mruli''', '''cinza''', '''garna''', '''pijne''', '''pambe''', '''canpa''', '''forca''', '''smuci''', '''dakfu'''</notes></valsi>
<valsi word="tutra" type="verb"><definition>x<sub>1</sub> entity is territory controlled by x<sub>2</sub> entity</definition><notes>
Comment: Needs not be land.
:'''lo tutra''' — territory
:'''lo tutra be lo manti cu zenba''' — ''The territory controlled by ants is extending.''
:Related words: '''catni''', '''turni''', '''jecta''', '''gugde''', '''ponse''', '''steci''', '''tumla'''</notes></valsi>
<valsi word="ty" type="pronoun"><definition>letter 'T'</definition>
<notes></notes></valsi><valsi word="u" type="conjunction for nouns"><definition>''whether or not''</definition>
<notes>:'''coi lo jbopre u lo certu''' — ''Hello, Lojbanists (whether or not you are experts).''
:Related words: '''ju''', '''a''', '''e''', '''ji''', '''o''', '''u'''
</notes></valsi><valsi word="u'a" type="interjection"><definition>gain, '''u'anai''' — loss</definition>
<notes>:'''u'a sinxa lo nu mi pu drani''' — ''Aha, that's a sign that I was right.''
:'''u'anai lo rob pu zabna gerku''' — ''Snif, Rob was a good dog.''
:Related words: '''jinga''', '''selne'u''', '''prali''', '''cirko'''
</notes></valsi><valsi word="u'e" type="interjection"><definition>''Ooh!'' (wonder), '''u'enai''' — ''Pff!'' (commonplace)</definition>
<notes>:'''u'e le lalxu cu je'a melbi''' — ''Wow, the lake is really beautiful.''
:'''u'e nai lalxu''' — ''So what? It's just a lake.''
:Related words: '''manci''', '''fadni'''
</notes></valsi><valsi word="u'i" type="interjection"><definition>''Ha-ha!'' (amusement), '''u'inai''' — ''Blah'' (weariness)</definition>
<notes>:'''u'i lo mlatu cu troci lo ka kavbu lo rebla be vo'a''' — ''Ha-ha, a cat is trying to capture its tail.''
:'''u'inai mi pu tirna loc do xajmi lisri''' — ''Boring, I heard your funny story.''
:Related words: '''selzdi''', '''selxajmi''', '''xalbo'''
</notes></valsi><valsi word="u'o" type="interjection"><definition>courage, boldness, '''u'ocu'i''' — timidity, shyness, '''u'onai''' — cowardice</definition>
<notes>:'''u'o mi do ba jai gau snura''' — ''I'm coming to your rescue!''
:'''u'o cu'i xu mi zifre lo ka stali''' — ''Erm, may I stay here?''
:'''u'o nai mi na klama lo nenri''' — ''Oh no, I'm not going to enter.''
:Related words: '''virnu'''
</notes></valsi><valsi word="u'u" type="interjection"><definition>''Sorry!'' (repentance)</definition>
<notes>:'''u'u mi pu srera''' — ''Sorry, I made a mistake.''
:Related words: '''xenru''', '''zugycni'''
</notes></valsi><valsi word="ua" type="interjection"><definition>''Aha!'' (discovery), '''uanai''' — confusion/searching</definition>
<notes>:'''ua lo za'u vi jbari cu je'a kukte''' — ''Wow, these berries are indeed tasty.''
:'''uanai ma smuni lo se cusku be do''' — ''Huh, what's the meaning of your words?''
:Related words: '''facki''', '''cfipu''', '''sisku'''
</notes></valsi><valsi word="ubu" type="pronoun"><definition>letter 'U'</definition>
<notes></notes></valsi><valsi word="ue" type="interjection"><definition>''Dear me! Yow! Hey?! Wow!'' (surprise), '''uecu'i''' — not really surprised, '''uenai''' — expectation</definition>
<notes>:'''ue do xa'o zvati ti''' — ''Hey, you are already here!''
:'''uecu'i do ca'o sipna''' — ''Well, no surprises, you are still sleeping.''
:'''ue nai ro da cu prane''' — ''Everything is perfect, just as I expected.''
:Related words: '''spaji'''
</notes></valsi><valsi word="uenzi" type="verb"><definition>x<sub>1</sub> text is a text in language x<sub>2</sub> entity</definition><notes>
:'''lo uenzi''' — text, '''lo se uenzi''' — language of a text
:'''zoi ry.привет.ry. uenzi lo rusko''' — ''привет is a Russian text.''
:Related words: '''cusku''', '''traduki'''</notes></valsi>
<valsi word="ui" type="interjection"><definition>''Wee! Yay! Hooray! Yippie! Yahoo!'' (happiness), '''uinai''' — ''Alas!'' (unhappiness)</definition>
<notes>:'''ui mi pu penmi le fetsi zu'e mi''' — ''Yay, I had a meeting with her.''
:'''uinai mi fliba''' — ''Alas, I failed.''
:Related words: '''gleki'''
</notes></valsi><valsi word="ultime" type="verb"><definition>x<sub>1</sub> event is the finale/final/last part leading up to completion of x<sub>2</sub> event</definition><notes>
:'''lo ultime''' — finale, final part
:'''lo ultime be lo te jivna ba cinri ba'a''' — ''I expect the final part of the competition interesting.''
:Related words: '''incipe''', '''cfari''', '''sisti''', '''krasi''', '''fanmo''', '''mulno'''</notes></valsi>
<valsi word="uo" type="interjection"><definition>''Voila!'' (completion), '''uonai''' — incompleteness</definition>
<notes>:'''uo mi facki lo danfu''' — ''Voila, I found a solution!''
:'''uo nai do tu na ru'e darxi''' — ''Oh, you almost hit it.''
:Related words: '''mulno''', '''mansa''', '''fanmo''', '''snada'''
</notes></valsi><valsi word="uu" type="interjection"><definition>''Oh dear! Poor thing!'' (pity, compassion), '''uunai''' — ''Mwa ha ha!'' (cruelty)</definition>
<notes>:'''uu a'o do ba jinga ca lo drata''' — ''Oh you poor thing, I hope you will win another time.''
:'''uunai do ba me lo selfu be mi''' — ''Mwa ha ha, you will be my slave!''
:Related words: '''kecti'''
</notes></valsi><valsi word="va" type="preposition"><definition>''... space units apart''</definition>
<notes>Comment: specifies the distance, e.g. in meters .
:'''le prenu cu sanli va lo mitre be li re ki mi''' — ''The man is standing two meters away from me.''
</notes></valsi><valsi word="va'e" type="verb"><definition>number > verb denoting position on scale</definition>
<notes>Comment: x1 (property of nonce place with '''kau''') is at n-th position on scale x2 (property of nonce place with '''kau'''). The number (n) is put in front of '''va'e'''.
:'''ro prenu cu su'ova'e bebna''' — ''Every person is stupid to some degree.''
:'''du'eva'e fa lo nu cuxna''' — ''It's to hard to choose something.''
:'''ti so'ova'e boske''' — ''This is jungle. not a real forest.''
</notes></valsi><valsi word="va'i" type="discursive"><definition>''in other words''</definition>
<notes>:'''mi ponse so'u jdini''' — ''I have little money.''
:'''va'i mi pindi''' — ''In other words, I'm poor.''
:Related words: '''cneselsku'''
</notes></valsi><valsi word="va'o" type="preposition from '''vanbi'''"><definition>''provided that ...'', ''on condition that ...'', ''under conditions ...'', ''in environment ...''</definition>

:'''i lo vi mlatu cu vrici lo ka skari makau''' — ''These cats vary in color.''
:Related words: '''klesi''', '''girzu''', '''frica''', '''simsa''', '''panra'''</notes></valsi>
<valsi word="vrude" type="verb"><definition>x<sub>1</sub> entity is virtuous in x<sub>2</sub> property of x1</definition><notes>
:'''lo vrude''' — virtuous
:'''ra vrude lo ka sidju lo prenu''' — ''He is virtuous in helping people.''
:'''la kevin na ji'e vrude''' — ''Kevin isn't moral to such a a degree.''
:Related words: '''palci''', '''xamgu''', '''marde''', '''zabna'''</notes></valsi>
<valsi word="vrusi" type="verb"><definition>x<sub>1</sub> entity is a taste or flavor of x<sub>2</sub> entity</definition><notes>
Comment: '''vrusi''' can describe a combination of taste and smell
:'''lo vrusi''' — taste, flavor, '''lo se vrusi''' — having a taste
:'''lo vrusi be lo finpe cu carmi''' — ''The fish has a strong flavour.''
:Related words: '''kukte''', '''tsapi''', '''cpina''', '''panci'''</notes></valsi>
<valsi word="vu"><definition>''far away'', ''... space units apart''</definition>
<notes>Comment: specifies the distance, e.g. in meters .
:'''le prenu ca zvati vu ci trene tcana ki mi''' — ''The man is now far away, three train stations from me.''
</notes></valsi><valsi word="vu'e" type="interjection modifier"><definition>expressing virtue, '''vu'enai''' — expressing sin</definition>
<notes>:'''ievu'e sarcu fa lo nu le tcadu cu se daspo''' — ''It's my virtue, I agree that the city should be destroyed.''
:'''mi djica vu'enai lo nu do na cliva''' — ''My sin, I don't want you to leave.''
:'''uivu'enai mi pu citka lo titla poi mi pu zekri lebna''' — ''Yay, I ate a candie that I had stolen.''
:Related words: '''vrude''', '''zungi'''
</notes></valsi><valsi word="vu'o" type="terminator"><definition>ends place consisting of several nouns so that a relative clause or an interjection can be put after it making it apply to the whole place</definition>
<notes>:'''zo oi e zo ua vu'o poi do pu cusku cu srana xu lo jibri be do''' — ''Are "Ouch" and "Eureka" that you said related to your job?''
</notes></valsi><valsi word="vu'u"><definition>''minus'', subtraction operator (symbol ''—'' in math)</definition>
<notes>:'''li pa pa vu'u bu li du li ci''' — ''11 - 8 = 3.''
</notes></valsi><valsi word="vy" type="pronoun"><definition>letter 'V'</definition>
<notes></notes></valsi><valsi word="vy bu" type="pronoun"><definition>letter 'W'</definition>
<notes></notes></valsi><valsi word="xa" type="digit/number"><definition>6 (digit) [six]</definition>
<notes>:'''xa cipni ca vofli''' — ''There are 6 birds flying.''
</notes></valsi><valsi word="xa'o" type="preposition"><definition>''already'', starting before the expected beginning (infraperfective aspect)</definition>
<notes>:'''mi pu xa'o citka lo torta''' — ''I ate a cake too early.''
:'''ue do ti xa'o zvati''' — ''Wow, you are already here.''
</notes></valsi><valsi word="xabju" type="verb"><definition>x<sub>1</sub> entity dwells or lives in x<sub>2</sub> entity</definition><notes>
Comment: A synonym to '''se''' '''zdani'''
:'''lo xabju''' — inhabitant, '''lo se xabju''' — home
:'''do xabju ma poi gugde''' — ''What country do you live in?''
:'''do xabju ma poi tcadu''' — ''What city do you live in?''
:Related words: '''ginka''', '''zdani''', '''zvati''', '''stuzi''', '''jmive''', '''stali''', '''vitke'''</notes></valsi>

<valsi word="xi" type="subscript"><definition>subscript prefix, attaches a numeral to a pronoun, preposition, place converter or a verb word giving new meanings</definition>
<notes>Comment: '''se''' '''xi''' '''re''' is the same as '''se''', '''se''' '''xi''' '''ci''' is the same as '''te'''. '''se''' '''xi''' '''pa''' just emphasizes the normal order of places as if there wasn't '''se''' '''xi''' pa''' put here..
:'''i la alis e la an pu zvati lo nu penmi''' — ''Alice and Ann were at a meeting.''
:'''ku'i abu xi re pu ze'i cliva''' — ''But Ann left soon.''
:'''mi se xi ba'e pa prami la kevin''' — ''I love (love!) Kevin (not that he loves me).''
:'''mi ce do se xi pa e re prami''' — ''I love you, and you love me.''
:'''fa xi xo'e mi fa xi xo'e do viska''' — ''You, I see (may be you see me, may be I see you, context will tell).''

:Related words: '''spati'''</notes></valsi>
<valsi word="xu" type="discursive"><definition>true-false question, '''xunai''' — false-true question</definition>
<notes>:'''xu do pu djuno''' — ''Did you know?''
:'''xunai do pu djuno''' — ''Didn't you know?''
</notes></valsi><valsi word="xukmi" type="verb"><definition>x<sub>1</sub> entity is the chemical x<sub>2</sub> entity with purity x<sub>3</sub> property of x1</definition><notes>
:'''lo xukmi''' — chemical
:'''lo vi anli cu xukmi lo solji li pi 585''' — ''This ring is 58.5% pure gold (58.5 out of 100 parts is pure gold).''
:Related words: '''curve''', '''cidro''', '''marna''', '''nimre'''</notes></valsi>
<valsi word="xunre" type="verb"><definition>x<sub>1</sub> entity is red</definition><notes>
:'''lo xunre''' — red
:'''ko dunda lo xunre cukta mi''' — ''Give me the red book.''
:Related words: '''skari''', '''blabi''', '''xekri''', '''kandi''', '''carmi''', '''nukni''', '''narju''', '''rozgu''', '''zirpu'''</notes></valsi>
<valsi word="xusra" type="verb"><definition>x<sub>1</sub> entity claims, asserts that x<sub>2</sub> proposition is true</definition><notes>
:'''lo xusra''' — claimant, '''lo se xusra''' — claim
:'''lo semau djuno cu mau xusra''' — ''Who knows more claims less.''
:'''xu do xusra lo du'u lo terdi cu carna lo solri''' — ''Are you asserting that the Earth goes round the Sun?''
:Related words: '''natfe''', '''nupre'''</notes></valsi>
<valsi word="xutla" type="verb"><definition>x<sub>1</sub> entity is smooth</definition><notes>
:'''lo xutla''' — smooth
:'''lo djacu cu simlu lo ka xutla tai lo blaci''' — ''The water looks smooth as glass.''
:Related words: '''plita''', '''rufsu''', '''tengu''', '''dikni''', '''pinta''', '''sakli''', '''spali'''</notes></valsi>
<valsi word="xy" type="pronoun"><definition>letter 'X'</definition>
<notes></notes></valsi><valsi word="y"><definition>''Err'', hesitation noise</definition>
<notes>Comment: maintains the floor while speaker decides what to say next.
:'''mi te vecnu lo vi plise e y lo vu perli''' — ''I'm buying these apples and, umm, the pears over there.''
</notes></valsi><valsi word="y'y" type="pronoun"><definition>letter ' (apostrophe)</definition>
<notes></notes></valsi><valsi word="ybu" type="pronoun"><definition>letter 'Y'</definition>
<notes></notes></valsi><valsi word="za" type="preposition"><definition>''some time ago'' (unspecified or known from context)</definition>
<notes>:'''mi ba volve za lo djedi be li ci''' — ''I will return in three days.''
:Related words: '''zi''', '''za''', '''zu'''
</notes></valsi><valsi word="za'a" type="evidential"><definition>''I observe''</definition>
<notes>Comment: '''za'a''' is for expressing external experience, '''se'o''' is for expressing internal experience..
:'''oinai za'a melbi tcima''' — ''Oh, what a nice weather.''
:'''za'a lo aftobuso cu jai lerci''' — ''Apparently, the bus is late.''
:'''za'a cladu bu'u lo bartu''' — ''I can hear the loud sound outside.''
:'''ja'o carmi carvi''' — ''So it must be raining heavily.''
:Related words: '''zgana''', '''lanli'''
</notes></valsi><valsi word="za'e" type="left interjection"><definition>marks the following construct as a nonce one</definition>
<notes>Comment: can be used to show a non-standard use of the construct. Used for words made up for this specific context.
:'''mi pu za'e derpi''' — ''I "derped"''
:'''va'i mi pu cusku lo se bebna''' — ''In other words I said something stupid.''
:Related words: '''ba'e''', '''za'e'''
</notes></valsi><valsi word="za'o" type="preposition"><definition>lasting after the expected end (superfective aspect)</definition>
<notes>:'''mi pu za'o citka lo titla ba lo nu mi mo'u citka lo mi sanmi''' — ''I kept eating candies after my meal was over.''
</notes></valsi><valsi word="za'u" type="digit/number"><definition>greater than</definition>
<notes>:'''le za'u verba ca'o citka le kumfa''' — ''The children are eating in the room.''
:'''za'u lo prenu pu'o klama''' — ''More people are about to come.''
</notes></valsi><valsi word="za'ure'u" type="preposition"><definition>''again''</definition>
<notes>:'''e'o do za'ure'u cusku''' — ''Could you repeat that?''
</notes></valsi><valsi word="zabna" type="verb"><definition>x<sub>1</sub> entity is superb/admirable in x<sub>2</sub> property of x1</definition><notes>
:'''lo zabna''' — superb, admirable
:'''i lo jisra cu zabna lo ka se tasta''' — ''The juice is superb in taste.''
:'''ra zabna lo ka se sance''' — ''Her voice is cool.''
:Related words: '''mabla''', '''xamgu''', '''funca''', '''vrude''', '''banli'''</notes></valsi>
<valsi word="zajba" type="verb"><definition>x<sub>1</sub> entity is a gymnast performing x<sub>2</sub> property of x1</definition><notes>
:'''lo zajba''' — gymnast, '''lo se zajba''' — gymnastic feat
:'''ra zajba lo ka rilti muvdu''' — ''He is a rhythmic gymnast.''
:Related words: '''sluji''', '''dansu'''</notes></valsi>
<valsi word="zalvi" type="verb"><definition>x<sub>1</sub> entity grinds x<sub>2</sub> entity into powder x<sub>3</sub> entity</definition><notes>, '''lo te zalvi''' — powder produced by grinding
:'''mi'a zalvi lo maxri lo purmo''' — ''We grind wheat into flour.''
:Related words: '''daspo''', '''purmo''', '''marxa''', '''pulce''', '''canre''', '''molki'''</notes></valsi>
<valsi word="zanru" type="verb"><definition>x<sub>1</sub> entity approves of x<sub>2</sub> event</definition><notes>
:'''mi zanru lo se platu be do''' — ''I approve of your plan.''
:Related words: '''zau''', '''natfe'''</notes></valsi>
<valsi word="zarci" type="verb"><definition>x<sub>1</sub> entity is a market selling x<sub>2</sub> entity</definition><notes>
:'''lo zarci''' — market (trading site)
:'''lo zarci be lo rectu co'u akti de'i li vo''' — ''The butchery closes at 4 o'clock.''
:Related words: '''vecnu''', '''canja''', '''dinju''', '''banxa'''</notes></valsi>
<valsi word="zargu" type="verb"><definition>x<sub>1</sub> entity is a buttock of x<sub>2</sub> entity</definition><notes>
:'''lo zargu''' — buttocks
:'''le ninmu mo'u batci lo zargu be le nanmu sepi'o lo xance''' — ''She pinched his buttocks with a hand.''
:Related words: '''ganxo''', '''mabla'''</notes></valsi>
<valsi word="zasni" type="verb"><definition>x<sub>1</sub> entity is temporary in property x<sub>2</sub> property of x1</definition><notes>
:'''lo zasni''' — temporary
:'''lo vi dinju ba zasni lo ka mi xabju''' — ''I will temporarily live in this building.''
:Related words: '''vitno''', '''stodi''', '''cenba''', '''galfi''', '''binxo''', '''stika''', '''stali''', '''tcini''', '''vitke'''</notes></valsi>
<valsi word="zasti" type="verb"><definition>x<sub>1</sub> entity exists or is real to x<sub>2</sub> entity under metaphysics x<sub>3</sub> proposition</definition><notes>
:'''lo zasti''' — existing
:'''do zasti mi lo se senva be mi''' — ''You are real for me in my dreams.''
:Related words: '''fatci''', '''xanri'''</notes></valsi>
<valsi word="zbabu" type="verb"><definition>x<sub>1</sub> entity is some soap entity</definition><notes>
:'''lo zbabu''' — soap
:'''lo vi zbabu cu se zbasu fi lo jilka joi lo grasu joi lo djacu''' — ''This soap is made of alkali, fat and water.''
:Related words: '''lumci''', '''fonmo'''</notes></valsi>
<valsi word="zbani" type="verb"><definition>x<sub>1</sub> entity is a bay of coast x<sub>2</sub> entity</definition><notes>
:'''lo zbani''' — bay, '''lo se zbani''' — coast, shore
:'''ti zbani lo tumla pe la nipon''' — ''This is a coast of the Japanese land.''
:Related words: '''lalxu''', '''xamsi'''</notes></valsi>
<valsi word="zbasu" type="verb"><definition>x<sub>1</sub> entity makes or assembles x<sub>2</sub> entity from parts x<sub>3</sub> entity</definition><notes>
:'''lo zbasu''' — assembler
:'''zbasu lo cirla lo ladru''' — ''Cheese is made from milk.''
:Related words: '''cupra''', '''larcu''', '''rutni''', '''finti''', '''gundi'''</notes></valsi>
<valsi word="zbepi" type="verb"><definition>x<sub>1</sub> entity is a pedestal, stand supporting x<sub>2</sub> entity</definition><notes>
:'''lo zbepi''' — pedestal, stand
:'''ti zbepi lo tansi''' — ''This is a stand for the pan.''
:Related words: '''jamfu''', '''jicmu''', '''jubme''', '''tuple''', '''ckana''', '''cpana''', '''loldi''', '''sanli'''</notes></valsi>
<valsi word="zdani" type="verb"><definition>x<sub>1</sub> entity is a home of x<sub>2</sub> entity; x2 inhabits x1 </definition><notes>
:'''lo zdani''' — home, '''lo se zdani''' — inhabitant
:'''lo zdani be mi cu zdani be do''' — ''My home is your home.''
:Related words: '''dinju''', '''ginka''', '''kumfa''', '''se''' '''xabju'''</notes></valsi>
<valsi word="zdile" type="verb"><definition>x<sub>1</sub> event is amusing to x<sub>2</sub> entity in x<sub>3</sub> property of x1</definition><notes>
Comment: '''xajmi''' is for 'funny'
:'''lo zdile''' — amusing, '''lo se zdile''' — amused
:'''lo verba mlatu cu zdile mi lo ka tasmi be lo ka plipe''' — ''The kitten is amusing in how it jumps.''
:Related words: '''cinri''', '''panka''', '''xajmi''', '''kelci'''</notes></valsi>
<valsi word="ze" type="digit/number"><definition>7 (digit) [seven]</definition>
<notes>:'''li ze tcika ti''' — ''It's 7 o'clock.''
</notes></valsi><valsi word="ze'a" type="preposition"><definition>during some time unspecified or known from context. Adverb: ''for some time''</definition>
<notes>:'''mi pu ze'a sipna''' — ''I slept for a while.''
:Related words: '''ze'i''', '''ze'a''', '''ze'u''', '''ze'e'''
</notes></valsi><valsi word="ze'e" type="preposition"><definition>''eternally''</definition>
<notes>:'''mi ba ze'e prami do''' — ''I will always love you.''
:'''mi ze'e prami do''' — ''I loved, love and will love you.''
:Related words: '''ze'i''', '''ze'a''', '''ze'u''', '''ze'e'''
</notes></valsi><valsi word="ze'ei"><definition>being put before two words creates a word with the meaning of the word to the left and the grammar of the word to the right</definition>
<notes>Comment: binds two arbitrary words together to form a nonce word whose semantics are indicated by the left word and whose grammar is the same as that of the right word. Useful for creating function words without having to allocate experimental cmavo forms.
:'''panpi ze'ei coi''' — ''Peace to you! (as a greeting).''
:Related words: '''zei'''
</notes></valsi><valsi word="ze'i" type="preposition"><definition>''during ...'' (a short time). Adverb: ''for a short time''</definition>
<notes>:'''ai mi ze'i sipna''' — ''I'm going to take a nap (to sleep for a short time).''
:Related words: '''ze'i''', '''ze'a''', '''ze'u''', '''ze'e'''
</notes></valsi><valsi word="ze'o" type="preposition"><definition>''outwards, beyond ...''</definition>
<notes>:'''da tricu ze'o le rirxe''' — ''There is a tree across the river.''
</notes></valsi><valsi word="ze'u" type="preposition"><definition>''during a long time''. Adverb: ''for a long time''</definition>
<notes>:'''mi pu ze'u sipna ba lo ka citka''' — ''I took a long nap after eating.''
:Related words: '''ze'i''', '''ze'a''', '''ze'u''', '''ze'e'''
</notes></valsi><valsi word="zei"><definition>makes one single word out of two</definition>
<notes>:'''loi certu pu pilno lo xy zei kantu''' — ''Experts used X-rays.''
:Related words: '''ze'ei'''
</notes></valsi><valsi word="zekri" type="verb"><definition>x<sub>1</sub> event is a crime to x<sub>2</sub> entity</definition><notes>
:'''lo zekri''' — crime
:'''xu lo nu catra lo mabru cu zekri do''' — ''Is killing mammals a crime to you?''
:Related words: '''flalu''', '''sfasa''', '''zungi''', '''palci''', '''lijda''', '''pajni''', '''javni''', '''tcaci''', '''marde''', '''pulji''', '''tinbe'''</notes></valsi>
<valsi word="zenba" type="verb"><definition>x<sub>1</sub> entity increases in x<sub>2</sub> property of x1 by amount x<sub>3</sub> entity</definition><notes>
:'''lo zenba''' — increasing
:'''mi zenba lo ka se cfipu vau lo mutce''' — ''My confusion increased a lot.''
:'''e'o do zenba lo ka masno lo ka tavla i e'o do tavla masno zenba''' — ''Would you please speak more slowly?''
:Related words: '''jdika''', '''zmadu''', '''banro''', '''jmina'''</notes></valsi>
<valsi word="zepti" type="verb"><definition>x<sub>1</sub> entity is 10 to the negative twenty-first of x<sub>2</sub> same type as x1 in x<sub>3</sub> property of x1</definition><notes>
:'''xanore selci be lo marji cu zepti lo molro lo ka se canlu''' — ''One zeptomole (zmol) of substance contains 602 particles.''
:Related words: '''grake''', '''mitre''', '''snidu''', '''stero''', '''delno''', '''molro''', '''kelvo''', '''xampo''', '''gradu''', '''litce''', '''merli''', '''centi''', '''decti''', '''dekto''', '''femti''', '''gigdo''', '''gocti''', '''gotro''', '''kilto''', '''megdo''', '''mikri''', '''milti''', '''nanvi''', '''petso''', '''picti''', '''terto''', '''xatsi''', '''xecto''', '''xexso''', '''zetro'''</notes></valsi>
<valsi word="zetro" type="verb"><definition>x<sub>1</sub> entity is 10 to the twenty-first of x<sub>2</sub> same type as x1 in x<sub>3</sub> property of x1</definition><notes>
:'''lo djacu po lo braxamsi be lo terdi cu zetro lo litce be li ji'i papivo lo ka se canlu''' — ''The volume of seawater in the Earth's oceans is approximately 1.4 zettalitres (ZL).
''
:Related words: '''grake''', '''mitre''', '''snidu''', '''stero''', '''delno''', '''molro''', '''kelvo''', '''xampo''', '''gradu''', '''litce''', '''merli''', '''centi''', '''decti''', '''dekto''', '''femti''', '''gigdo''', '''gocti''', '''gotro''', '''kilto''', '''megdo''', '''mikri''', '''milti''', '''nanvi''', '''petso''', '''picti''', '''terto''', '''xatsi''', '''xecto''', '''xexso''', '''zepti'''</notes></valsi>
<valsi word="zgana" type="verb"><definition>x<sub>1</sub> entity observes x<sub>2</sub> entity using sense x<sub>3</sub> property of x1</definition><notes>
:'''lo zgana''' — observer, spectator
:'''mi zgana lo zgike gi'e lo filme''' — ''I'm listening to the music and watching a film.''
:'''mi zgana lo tcini lo ka tirna''' — ''I'm monitoring the situation by listening.''
:'''le ctuca pu jai se zgana fai lo ka bu'u lo barja''' — ''The teacher was spotted in a bar.''
:Related words: '''ga'a''', '''ganse''', '''viska''', '''catlu''', '''tirna''', '''pencu''', '''sumne''', '''kurji''', '''canci''', '''catlu''', '''jarco''', '''lanli''', '''pinka''', '''simlu'''</notes></valsi>
<valsi word="zgike" type="verb"><definition>x<sub>1</sub> sound is music performed by x<sub>2</sub> entity</definition><notes>
:'''lo zgike''' — music
:'''lo zgike be lo za'u na cladu''' — ''The music of birds isn't loud.''
:Related words: '''damri''', '''dansu''', '''flani''', '''janbe''', '''jgita''', '''pipno''', '''rilti''', '''tabra''', '''tonga''', '''xagri''', '''siclu'''</notes></valsi>
<valsi word="zgipli" type="verb"><definition>x<sub>1</sub> entity plays musicx<sub>2</sub> entity on a musical instrument x<sub>3</sub> entity</definition><notes>
:'''lo zgipli''' — musician, '''lo te zgipli''' — musical instrument
:'''do certu lo ka zgipli lo melbi lo flani''' — ''You are a pro in playing beautiful melodies on the flute.''
:Related words: '''zgike''', '''pilno'''</notes></valsi>
<valsi word="zi" type="preposition"><definition>''a short time ago''</definition>
<notes>:'''mi ba volve bazi lo cacra be li pa''' — ''I will return soon, in an hour.''
:Related words: '''zi''', '''za''', '''zu'''
</notes></valsi><valsi word="zi'e" type="connective for relative clauses"><definition>''and''</definition>
<notes>Comment: in Modern Lojban dialects a simple '''je''' is used instead of this word.
:'''le prenu poi pu tavla do zi'e noi blondino cu bruna mi vau uepei''' — ''The man that talked to you and who is blond is my brother, surprised?''
:Related words: '''je''', '''e''', '''gi'e'''
</notes></valsi><valsi word="zi'evla" type="verb"><definition>x<sub>1</sub> text is a free-form word</definition><notes>
Comment: zi'evla is a type of Lojban verb defined by the form of the word
:'''lo zi'evla''' — zi'evla
:'''zo zigzagi zi'evla''' — ''zigzagi is a zi'evla word.''
:Related words: '''selbrivla''', '''gismu''', '''lujvo''', '''cmavo'''</notes></valsi>
<valsi word="zi'o" type="pronoun"><definition>marks the place as deleted from the place structure thus forming a new verb</definition>
<notes>:'''zi'o traduki zo coi zoi gy. Hello! .gy.''' — ''Hello! is a translation of '''coi'''.''
:'''loi jmive cu se zbasu zi'o lo selci''' — ''Living beings are made from cells.''
</notes></valsi><valsi word="zifre" type="verb"><definition>x<sub>1</sub> entity is at liberty or free to do or be x<sub>2</sub> property of x1</definition><notes>
:'''mi zifre lo ka zukte lo se nelci be mi''' — ''I am free to do what I like.''
:Related words: '''pinfu''', '''rinju''', '''bilga''', '''permite''', '''kakne''', '''frili'''</notes></valsi>
<valsi word="zigzagi" type="verb"><definition>x<sub>1</sub> entity is a line with the shape of a zigzag</definition><notes>
:'''lo zigzagi''' — zigzag
:'''lo pluta be lo cmana pu zigzagi''' — ''The route to the mountain zigzagged.''
:Related words: '''boxna''', '''linji'''</notes></valsi>
<valsi word="zildukse" type="verb"><definition>x<sub>1</sub> entity is in excess, is too much for x<sub>2</sub> property of x1 to take place event</definition><notes>
:'''lo zildukse''' — excess
:'''lo nu mi tatpi cu zildukse lo nu mi sidju do''' — ''I'm too tired to help you.''
:Related words: '''bancu''', '''banzu''', '''ricfu''', '''zmadu'''</notes></valsi>
<valsi word="zinki" type="verb"><definition>x<sub>1</sub> entity is a quantity of zinc</definition><notes>
:'''lo zinki''' — zinc
:'''lo cidja cu vasru lo zinki''' — ''The food contains zinc.''
:Related words: '''jinme'''</notes></valsi>
<valsi word="zirpu" type="verb"><definition>x<sub>1</sub> entity is purple</definition><notes>
:'''lo zirpu''' — purple
:'''lo taxfu cu zirpu''' — ''The dress is purple.''
:Related words: '''skari''', '''blabi''', '''xekri''', '''kandi''', '''carmi''', '''nukni''', '''blanu''', '''xunre'''</notes></valsi>
<valsi word="zivle" type="verb"><definition>x<sub>1</sub> entity invests resources x<sub>2</sub> entity into x<sub>3</sub> entity, property of x1 expecting profit x4 entity</definition><notes>
:'''lo zivle''' — investor, '''lo se zivle''' — invested, '''lo ve zivle''' — expected profit of an investment
:'''ra pu zivle lo jdini lo ka sidju lo cnino sanga''' — ''He invested money in a new singer.''
:'''ai mi zivle lo nejni lo ka prami do vau lo nu do prami mi''' — ''I take a chance on loving you so that you will love me.''
:Related words: '''prali''', '''canja''', '''jbera''', '''dejni''', '''ponse'''</notes></valsi>
<valsi word="zmadu" type="verb"><definition>x<sub>1</sub> entity exceeds or is more than x<sub>2</sub> entity in x<sub>3</sub> property of x1 and x2 with '''kau''' by amount x4 entity</definition><notes>
:'''lo zmadu''' — more, '''lo se zmadu''' — less
:'''ra zmadu mi lo ka tilju vau lo ki'ogra be li pano''' — ''He weighs ten more kilograms than me.''
:Related words: '''mau''', '''mleca''', '''zenba''', '''jmina''', '''bancu''', '''dukse''', '''traji'''</notes></valsi>
<valsi word="zmiku" type="verb"><definition>x<sub>1</sub> entity is automatic in function x<sub>2</sub> property of x1</definition><notes>
:'''lo zmiku''' — robot, automatic, '''lo se zmiku''' — function of a robot
:'''lo vorme ci zmiku lo ka co'a kalri''' — ''The door opens automatically.''
:Related words: '''macnu'''</notes></valsi>
<valsi word="zo"><definition>verb > noun that is a quote</definition>
<notes>Comment: '''zo''' and one single Lojban word after it make a quotation, it works as a noun. To quote compound particles, compound verbs and phrases use '''lu''' ...'''li'u'''. To quote arbitrary sequences of words use '''lo'u''' ... '''le'u'''..
:'''zo gleki cmene mi''' — ''Gleki is my name.''
:Related words: '''zo'oi''', '''zoi''', '''la'o''', '''la'oi''', '''zo''', '''lu''' ... '''li'u''', '''lo'e''', '''lo'u''', '''me'oi'''
</notes></valsi><valsi word="zo'e" type="pronoun"><definition>noun unspecified or known from context</definition>
<notes>:'''zo'e carvi''' — ''It's raining.''
:'''la eduard pu cusku zo'e ne le pa gerku''' — ''Eduard said something about the dog.''
</notes></valsi><valsi word="zo'ei"><definition>''something about ...'', ''something associated with ...''</definition>
<notes>Comment: equivalent to '''zo'e''' '''pe'''.
:ends with: '''lu'u'''
:'''mi pu na djuno zo'ei le nabmi''' — ''I didn't know of the problem.''
:Related words: '''tu'a'''
</notes></valsi><valsi word="zo'i" type="preposition"><definition>''on the same side as ...''</definition>
<notes>:'''mi sanli bu'u lo klaji zo'i le muzga''' — ''I'm standing on the street on the same side as the museum.''
:'''mi zutse lo lalxu korbi zo'i le laldo cindu''' — ''I'm sitting by the river on the same side as the old oak.''
</notes></valsi><valsi word="zo'o" type="interjection modifier"><definition>''Kidding...'' (humorously), '''zo'ocu'i''' — without paying attention to seriousness or humor, '''zo'onai''' — ''seriously''</definition>
<notes>:'''zo'opei''' — ''Are you kidding?''
:'''e'u zo'o renro la kevin lo vi kevna''' — ''Let's throw Kevin into this hole (kidding ...) I might be able to jump from the hill.''
:'''mi kakne lo ka plipe fi lo ve'i cmana vau zo'ocu'i i zo'onai do fanza''' — ''Seriously, you are annoying.''
:Related words: '''xajmi''', '''junri'''
</notes></valsi><valsi word="zo'oi"><definition>foreign word > noun that is a quote</definition>
<notes>Comment: '''zo'oi''' and one single word after it make a quotation, it works as a noun. The word after '''zo'oi''': might be from any language and written in any script, it is delimited by pauses (in speech) or whitespaces (in writing) from both sides, it can't have pauses inside if pronounced, nor dots when written. To quote several words or one word with pauses inside use '''zoi'''.
:'''zo'oi again se traduki fi lu za'ure'u li'u''' — ''"Again" is translated as '''za'u re'u'''.''
:Related words: '''zo'oi''', '''zoi''', '''la'o''', '''la'oi''', '''zo''', '''lu''' ... '''li'u''', '''lo'e''', '''lo'u''', '''me'oi'''
</notes></valsi><valsi word="zo'u"><definition>separates topic and comment</definition>
<notes>:'''lo danlu zo'u mi nelci lo mlatu''' — ''As for animals, I like cats.''
:'''vo da poi gerku vau re de poi prenu zo'u da batci de''' — ''There are four '''da''' (that are dogs) and there are two '''de''' (that are men) such that each dog ('''da''') bites the two men ('''de''').''
:Related words: '''zo'oi''', '''zoi''', '''la'o''', '''la'oi''', '''zo''', '''lu''' ... '''li'u''', '''lo'e''', '''lo'u''', '''me'oi'''
</notes></valsi><valsi word="zoi"><definition>foreign text > noun that is a quote</definition>
<notes>Comment: quotes a text that can be not Lojbanic. The quotation is to be wrapped with pauses from both sides and with an additional Lojbanic word around them from both sides. Usually the separating Lojbanic word is the first letter of the language in the quotation..
:'''lu coi ro do li'u se traduki fi zoi gy. Hello, everyone! .gy. noi glico''' — '''''coi ro do''' is translated to English as "Hello, everyone!"''
:Related words: '''zo'oi''', '''zoi''', '''la'o''', '''la'oi''', '''zo''', '''lu''' ... '''li'u''', '''lo'e''', '''lo'u''', '''me'oi'''
</notes></valsi><valsi word="zu" type="preposition"><definition>''a long time ago''</definition>
<notes>:'''la alis pu cliva zu lo nanca be li pano''' — ''Alice left ten years ago (a long time).''
:Related words: '''zi''', '''za''', '''zu'''
</notes></valsi><valsi word="zu'a" type="preposition"><definition>''leftwards'', ''to the left of ...''</definition>
<notes>:'''ko catlu lo pa karce pe zu'a do''' — ''Look at a car to the left of you.''
</notes></valsi><valsi word="zu'e" type="preposition from '''zukte'''"><definition>''via a free will'', ''with an actor ...''</definition>
<notes>Comment: actor case tag. x1 of the clause corresponds to '''lo zukte''', the clause itself corresponds to '''lo se zukte'''.
:'''zu'enai je fa mi viska lo dinju''' — ''A building caught my eye.''
:'''zu'e je fa mi tirna lo zgike''' — ''I listened to the music.''
</notes></valsi><valsi word="zu'i" type="pronoun"><definition>noun typical for this place</definition>
<notes>:'''mi pu penmi zu'i bu'u zu'i''' — ''I met the usual people at the usual place.''
</notes></valsi><valsi word="zu'u" type="discursive"><definition>''on the one hand'', '''zu'unai''' — ''on the other hand''</definition>
<notes>:'''zu'u le jufra cu satci lo ka se smuni''' — ''On the one hand, the sentence is exact in meaning.''
:'''zu'unai du'eva'e clani''' — ''On the other hand it is too long.''
:Related words: '''karbi''', '''frica''', '''dukti'''
</notes></valsi><valsi word="zukte" type="verb"><definition>x<sub>1</sub> entity takes action x<sub>2</sub> property of x1 for purpose x<sub>3</sub> property of x1</definition><notes>
:'''lo zukte''' — actor, '''lo se zukte''' — taken action, '''lo te zukte''' — purpose of action
:'''i mi zukte lo me mi moi tu'a lo me mi moi''' — ''I'm doing my own work for myself.''
:'''xu do ca'o zukte lo cipra''' — ''Are you performing a test?''
:'''mi zukte lo ka darxi le nakni''' — ''I intentionally hit him.''
:'''mi ba zukte roda lonu do nelci mi''' — ''I would do everything so that you like me.''
:Related words: '''zu'e''', '''bapli''', '''gunka''', '''jalge''', '''krinu''', '''mukti''', '''rinka''', '''snuti''', '''gasnu''', '''fasnu''', '''minji''', '''prenu''', '''ciksi''', '''jibri''', '''pilno''', '''pluta''', '''tadji''', '''tutci'''</notes></valsi>
<valsi word="zumri" type="verb"><definition>x<sub>1</sub> entity is some corn or maize of species x<sub>2</sub> taxon</definition><notes>
:'''lo zumri''' — maize
:'''mi sombo lo samcu je lo zumri''' — ''I plant yams and maize.''
:Related words: '''gurni'''</notes></valsi>
<valsi word="zungi" type="verb"><definition>x<sub>1</sub> entity feels guilty about x<sub>2</sub> event, property of x1</definition><notes>
:'''mi zungi lo ka pu cusku lo jitfa''' — ''I feel guilty about having told a lie.''
:Related words: '''u'u''', '''cinmo''', '''xenru''', '''zekri'''</notes></valsi>
<valsi word="zunle" type="verb"><definition>x<sub>1</sub> entity is to the left of x<sub>2</sub> entity in frame of reference x<sub>3</sub> entity</definition><notes>
:'''lo zunle''' — left (in direction)
:'''lo dinju cu zunle lo rokci ti''' — ''The house is to the left of the rock if viewed from here.''
:Related words: '''zu'a''', '''pritu''', '''mlana''', '''crane''', '''trixe''', '''farna'''</notes></valsi>
<valsi word="zunti" type="verb"><definition>x<sub>1</sub> entity interferes with or disrupts x<sub>2</sub> entity due to x<sub>3</sub> property of x1</definition><notes>, '''lo se zunti''' — hindered, disrupted
:'''lo gerku cu zunti lo nu mi lumci lo kumfa vau lo ka plipe''' — ''The dog leaping hinders me from cleaning the room.''
:Related words: '''fanta''', '''dicra''', '''fliba''', '''fanza''', '''raktu''', '''klina''', '''bandu''', '''cfipu''', '''ganlo'''</notes></valsi>
</direction></dictionary>
